long_desc: A dark grim figure beckons you towards the gates.
description:
An astonishingly large figure stands here cloaked in robes that are black as
the eternal abyss.  One of it's skeletal hands beckons you forward, as the
other clutches its grim look scythe.  You look beneath the creature's hood to
see it's face, only to discover it has none!
Someone has abandoned a placeholder mob here.

long_desc: This small brightly colored fish swims with the current.
description:
This small fish is incredibly colored with yellow, gold, silver, and the
deepest black.  It swims along with the current, enjoying the warm water and
completely immune to the humidity or the insects.  It is peaceful to watch.

long_desc:
This muddy colored fish appears to walk on the rocks for short
periods of time.
description:
This muddy colored fish blends right in with the river banks and rocks of the
river.  It is somehow able to breathe out of the water for a small ount of
time. It is a medium sized fish, it is not small but it is not the size of a
grouper.   It appears to be gathering small twigs for a nest of some type.

long_desc: This bright green lizard is actually running across the surface of the water.
description:
This brightly colored lizard is running across the water somehow.  It is
amazing to see the creature skip across the surface of the water as if it is
doing something completely natural.  It ignores you for the most part, content
to jump from rock to rock or run across the water.

long_desc: This large spotted lizard has an odd fin on its back.
description:
This large aquatic lizard is happily swimming along with the current.  The
large fin on its back seems to keep it from being sucked under for too long
when the current grows heavy.  It seems to be stalking the large insects that
hover around the surface of the water.

This fish is a neon shade of yellow.  It is massive and appears to be food for
the higher level predators of the river.  It creates its own wake, even in the
current of this massive river.  The smaller fish seem to cling to its belly
for transportation.

long_desc: This simple wooden boat is manned by several goblins.
description:
This small boat is quite simple in design.  It floats, it is big enough for
three goblins and their catches.  The goblins seem constantly on the look out
for a juicy Arapaima or even a fat Hyla Toad.  Yet, it is also clear that the
crew are on the lookout for something else.

heavy spears and are ignoring the smaller game.  They are even ignoring you as
they pass by, it is clear that searching for something specific and by the
size of their spears, it is something big.

the surface of the water, its eyes and snout the only thing visible.  It seems
that even this massive beast, with an odd set of hard ridges all over its
back, is sluggish is the heat.

but its teeth are sharp enough to shred metal and it looks like it is pretty
hungry. It also does not seem to travel alone as its brothers and sisters look

long_desc: This massive serpent is actually damming the river with its body.
description:
This serpent is one of the largest creatures you have ever seen.  It dwarfs
dragons and somehow it is managing to stop the flow of the water in this
river.  It ignores for the most part, it seems content to just sleep and sun
itself. It would not be wise to engage this creature, not wise at all.

long_desc: A priest of thunder roams the area tending to the temple.
description:
This noble being has dedicated his life to the worship of Thor.  He spends his
time here tending the up keep of the temple, though there are few visitors
here.  He is also here to tend to the followers of Thunder, and pass their
prayers onto Thor...  Well he would if there were any other followers.

long_desc: This thin blonde boy is trying to block out the dreams.
description:
The boy is thin, some may gaunt, others would say lithe. His limbs and refined
and slender.  His eyes are a pale and haunting green. His blonde hair falls
over his face.  He is hunched over, hugging his knees and black crystal tears
fall from his eyes, cutting his cheeks as they fall.  His fingers are nails
and his teeth are broken glass.  He mutters to himself and cannot tell if you
are real or just his nightmares. He lunges at your throat, screaming his curses
to the gods and to fate.

long_desc: This spider is made of broken glass and light.
description:
This creature moves back and forth with the lightest of steps by its eight
legs.  It is made entirely of shards of glass, each one holding the image of a
tortured man or woman.  Some are being slowly sawed in half, others are having
their teeth removed with pieces of bone, and others are being tortured in ways
you cannot imagine.  All you can see in some is blood.  The spider watches you
and waits to add another piece of glass to it's body.

long_desc: This screaming man has been impaled on two pikes.
description:
This man is screaming his last breath, but by the look of the dried blood and
the blood that is flying from his mouth, he has been screaming for some time
now.  He has been impaled from the bottom up, entering through the rectum and
emerging from behind his back. Yet, a thinner pike has been inserted through
his shoulders.  In a sickening half hop, half limb, he makes his way towards
you to share his pain.

short_desc: a man encased in barbed wire
long_desc: This man is rolling around trying to free himself from a suit of barb wire.
description:
This man is encased in an entire suit of barbed wire.  Each strand cuts into
him as every moment he makes pierces the small barbs into his body.  Yet as
each pierce goes deeper, it only pushes him to pull at the wires more. He
seems you and screams for you to help him, entangling you with him!

long_desc: Every bone in this woman's body must be broken, yet she pulls her mangled form.
description:
This woman is mangled behind anything you have seen. Her head is looking at
her back, her left shoulder is twisted to connect with her right, her legs are
bent in the wrong way, and her jaw has been completely removed.  The few
sounds she can make are distorted by pieces of bone in her throat and blood
dripping from her mouth.  She manages to pull herself across the ground with a
single arm, her fingers gnawed to the bone.

long_desc: These dreams float upon the breeze, seeking others to torture.
description:
The air is ripped by their presence.  You can see no true shape, save that
they have multiple arms and smooth bodies.  If not for the constant sound of
weeping that seems to rise off them you would have no way of tracking them.
They slowly make their way to you, in no rush, waiting for you to beg them to
leave.

long_desc: This creature is circling some poor boy.
description:
This creatures are flesh and blood yet you can hear them screaming in your
head. Their bodies are made of blue-black flesh, smooth and sleek. The have no
eyes but a hundred mouths and eight long tentacles, each with a row of hooks.
They seem to serve this Nightmare Magnet, and torture him at the same time.

long_desc: This beautiful girl is eating her own hand.
description:
This girl would be beautiful. Her hair is long, dark as night, and stained
with blood.  Her eyes are coins and her mouth are full of crooked teeth that
tear her own flesh as she constantly devours herself. Her breasts are exposed
and bleeding, her posture provocative. She stares at you and screams for a
taste.

long_desc: This raven-haired boy is lost inside his own mind.
description:
This boy is not a boy at all but rather a man that has no idea of what he is.
He wanders around, mumbling incoherently.  His eyes are black serpents and his
tongue is a collection of razors that cut through his lips and mouth as he
speaks. He is clawing at himself in confusion, his fingers tearing through his
flesh to reveal a blood made out of maggots.  He suddenly stops and looks at
you, a moment of clarity, and in this clarity he realizes that he is damned.
He runs screaming at you, his hands buried into his own flesh.

long_desc: A strange monk is tending to the temple.
description:
This monk is ghostly pale, fingers thin and face sunken. Yet they move with a
subtle strength and you wonder if it would be that wise to bother them.

long_desc: This monk is still and silent in concentration.
description:
This monk is meditating, their thin body balancing a large stone on their
head. Dressed in rags, the monk seems to be oblivious to your presence.

long_desc: This large monk is guarding something.
description:
This monk is HUGE! He is obviously not human, Hi skin is a faded purple and
his eyes a sharp yellow. He looks you up and down and makes no indication he
is going to move out of your way.

knives. Its thick skin and long limbs move with a disconcerting grace as it
attacks. It looks as if it lost several limbs on numerous occasions yet it
shows no sign of weakness or pain.

battle that must have shaken the very earth. It watches you closely and seems
to applaud the fact you have survived so long. It is screaming in rage at the
memories of it's defeat flood it's mind.

long_desc: An incredibly powerful ghoul watches you.
description:
This ghoul is massive and simply radiates power. It carries many scars from a
battle that must have shaken the very earth. It watches you closely and seems
to applaud the fact you have survived so long. It does not seem interested in
hurting you, perhaps it is still weary from whatever battle trapped it here.

long_desc: A strange monk is tending to the temple.
description:
This monk is ghostly pale, fingers thin and face sunken. Yet they move with a
subtle strength and you wonder if it would be that wise to bother them.

long_desc: A large hare hops along playfully.
description:
This hare is HUGE. It is the size of a normal dog and it's legs look strong
enough to break bone. It seems cute and friendly enough but it is constantly
vigilante for a large raptor or hungry lynx.

long_desc: This monk is still and silent in concentration.
description:
This monk is meditating, their thin body balancing a large stone on their
head. Dressed in rags, the monk seems to be oblivious to your presence.

long_desc: An immense creature with a lion's head watches you.
description:
This creature is watching you but you notice it has no eyes and no mouth! Yet
the claws it carries seem sharp enough. It's head is that of a Lion without
any features, it's body that of a lizard and it's tail is made out of living
snakes. Each one watches you with hungry eyes.

long_desc: A strange looking swordsman reclines against the wall.
description:
This man, if it is man, is dressed in a tattered black cape and tarnished but
beautiful ebony armor. He carries a huge Nohdachi but seems to care less about
you. He finally looks up, his eyes a blazing yellow and his face heavily
scarred. "Nothing can kill me, not the Elders, not the new Gods, nothing.  You
want to try?"

long_desc: This Ancient rests on a makeshift throne of bone.
description:
This must be the creature known as Synot Lodhal. It is bathed in an aura of
fire and seems quite impressed by the fact you stand before it. It is dressed
in a liquid suit of armor that seems to harden into crystal at will.  The
creature is missing two of its five eyes, and it's one arm out of four. It
smirks as if it can hear your thoughts.

long_desc: A strange monk is tending to the temple.

This monk is ghostly pale, fingers thin and face sunken. Yet they move with a
subtle strength and you wonder if it would be that wise to bother them.

long_desc: This monk is quietly eating her dinner.
description:
This monk is silent as she eats.  She dips a piece of bread into her soup but
her eyes never leave the candle on the table.

long_desc: This monk is quietly eating his meal.
description:
This monk makes no noise as he eats. He stares at the candle on the table as
he slowly places a thin soup of rice and carrots into his mouth.

claws look particularly sharp and it's eyes are bright with intelligence. It's
faded wings seem to be as long as your arms.

long_desc: A wildcat is stalking some prey here.
description:
This small cat like creature is low to the ground and scanning the  area for a
hare or unlucky bird. Its color is that of creme and milk with yellow eyes and
black stripes on its face. Although it is small, this lynx looks like it could
do some damage.

scrolls and seems to be busy trying to figure something out. His face is
slanted slightly and his skin is a light shade of gray.  He is definitely not
human but with a hood and cloak, you imagine he could pass. Perhaps he travels
outside of the temple to collect more knowledge.

long_desc: A lizardman Ancient bellows a battle cry and charges!
description:
This lizard like creature is adorned in armor that you have never seen. It
stands at least 8 feet tall and must weight 300kgs. He screams as it sees you
and charges. Whatever defeated these creatures must have been quite powerful.

long_desc: A strange looking human sees you and leaps at your throat!
description:

skin and the glowing red eyes. Tall for a human and well muscled, it looks as
if this Ancient has dedicated their life to battle. The scars it carries seem
impossible to have survived.

covered in a thick hide that looks stronger than steel. It seems to have an

anything in this world or the next stop a calvary charge of these?

is to take the recently hatched larvae up to its respective caste home until
it is old enough to begin work.  The matron carries food on the hairs of its
legs to feed the larvae before taking it gently away.

choices in his life.  He will either stay inside the colony to be the consort

looking for a suitable female to start a new hive.

This ant is twice the size of the soldier ants.  It is clear that it is the
guardian of the royalty and life blood of the colony.  This ant has only one
role and that is to kill anything that appears to be a threat to the colony.
It leaves you by for the time, but it might not be a good idea to cause
trouble in front of it.

long_desc: This ant's sole responsibility is transporting eggs.
description:
This ant has one clear mission, to transport eggs from the Queen's chamber to
the egg chambers.  It is a simple job but a vital one.  The eggs are soft and
easily destroyed, a careless egg carrier does not live long to regret its
mistake.

long_desc: This massive ant moves to protect her eggs!
description:
This ant is literally ten times the size of all the others, even those these
ants are bigger than any others you have seen.  The queen fills this entire
cavern and it is clear she will not be an easy fight.  Her mandibles are sharp
and  her armor is thick.

description:
This man is wearing a rather heavy suit of armor and wielding some serious
weaponry. It seems that the capitol city of this empire is even more defended
than Sahardin.  He watches everyone that enters with a stern eye.

long_desc: This cityguard is making his rounds around the district.
description:
This man is on the look out for any rebel activity. His scans the crowds,
ignoring the lesser crimes of theft or vandalism.  He is looking for those
that don't belong as well as inspire a sense of fear in the citizens of the
city. You imagine he would only step in if he had to.

long_desc: Gen, Bazabel's master transporter, watches you suspiciously.
description:
Gen runs the Bazabel Transportal.  He was taught in the Imperial Magi
University, where he also picked up a strong suspicion of anyone who is not of
Imperial descent.  Wary of the various thugs who wanders the streets of
Bazabel, he has mastered a few attack spells, as well as his awesome powers of
transport.

long_desc: This man must be the lord of the house.
description:
This man is slight of build and rather small.  Yet by the jewelry on his hands
and the clothes on his back he is definitely the lord of the house. He is
yelling at the servants to hurry up and other such nice things.  He sees you
and smirks.

long_desc: This beautiful lady must be the owner of the house.
description:
This woman must be the lady of the house.  Her clothes are beautiful but you
have seen better on some of the others.  She does not flaunt her wealth as
much as others but by the size of the property it is clear that she does
possess a great deal of it.

long_desc: This guard's only loyalty is to the house that hired him.
description:
This man either did not want or could not join the local police force or the
Imperial army.  Instead he sells his blade to any noble house that wants the
extra protection of their very own guard.

long_desc: This man is offering you a sample of spices.
description:
This man has his hair heavily slicked back and his moustache waxed as well. He
offers you all sorts of spices, most of which you have never heard from. His
accent is thick and it is hard to understand just how much is asking for each
pound of spice.

long_desc: This woman is offering wild stories about each item she sells.
description:
This woman is older, well into her 50's yet still very beautiful. Her almond
eyes and fair skin glimmer as you listen to her explain how she obtained each
item in her stall.  She smiles and asks if you have a loved one who would like
a very special gift.

long_desc: This young woman invites you to stay and read awhile.
description:
This young woman is quite attractive.  She wears a set of thin reading glasses
and has her hair neatly tied up in a bun. She invites you to stay and read for
awhile.  If you could just get a cup of coffee and a nice chair you could sit
here for awhile.

long_desc: This older woman offers you a sample.
description:
This older woman has a bright streak of white in her otherwise ebony hair and
offers you some type of fruit called a date.  The fruits all look freshly
picked and well cared for. It might be nice to get a snack.

long_desc: This man is busy gutting and cleaning an animal.
description:
The smell of dead flesh is heavy on the man as he is busy preparing another
slab of meat to be cured and ready to go for sale.  The meat is all very dry
and heavily spiced but he assures you that not only is it safe to eat but will
last for months on the road.

long_desc: This man offers you a small taste of a rare wine.
description:
This man has taken great pride in his ability to raise and sell the finest
drinks in Bazabel.  He offers wine for a good meal or a small flask of whiskey
for the cold nights out on the road.

long_desc: This person is busy looking through the various items.
description:
This person is looking and asking others what they have for sale.  They
seem intent on finding something good for a small amount of gold. They
even ask you if you have anything you'd like to sell.

long_desc: This person is busy trying to sell their wares.
description:
This person calls out the name of their items and sees if anybody is
interested. They look at you and whisper they have a few things not exactly
cleared by the Trade Board for sale too.

wings much.

its stinger a deep red.  It patrols the hive, making sure that no curious
squirrel or  thieving wasp has entered in an attempt to steal honey.  It seems
to ignore you, although it is keeping a close eye on your movements towards
all the other bees.

description:
This bee is easily the largest you have ever seen, reaching the size of a
jungle cat.  Its stinger looks sharp and quite lethal.  The queen just
continues to lay eggs and eat royal honey in order to keep her strength up.
Her body is covered in a fine layer of hair, she is the color of a painter's
yellow and a demon's red. It may be a good idea to leave her alone.

long_desc: A large group of insects annoy all comers.
description: Where's the damn bug zapper when you need it?

long_desc: A small bat shrieks and flies around.
description: Need some earplugs? These boogers are annoying!

long_desc: A young, stout looking creature is here.
description: This sucka means business.

long_desc: A young vampire wanders around aimlessly.
description: One of the newly birthed vampires.

description:
This raven flies high upon the icy winds of the mountains.  It hopes to see a
mouse, or perhaps a dead climber.

description:
You see in front of you a mighty warrior, who strides out of the icy mists.
You spy the large axe slung over his back, and remember the story of Kyle
Lockhart, warrior of the mountain.  He strides the Bitter Pass, trying to keep
it safe for travelers.

long_desc: A young frost giant towers over you.
description:
A young frost giant, not nearly as large as other frost giants found in these
parts, ignores you as he searches for another yeti.

long_desc: A small worker ant searches for food.
description:
The smallest of the ants, even this worker ant looks big to you now!  A bit
bigger than a large dog, it clicks while it moves about and looks for seeds or
other food.

long_desc: A big fat caterpillar inches its way along the blades.

the trunk of an elder oak.  It ignores you as it inches its way about the
blades.

long_desc: A small brownie smiles at you from the stone.
description:
Sitting on top of the standing stone is a small brownie.  You have heard tales
of their control of magic and insects...now you have felt that power in
person!  Above him, a strange vortex swirls, and he winks at you as he notices
you watching the vortex.

long_desc: A fluttering gray moth flits about the grass.
description:

You hope it decides you don't look tasty!.

the stone castle.  He doesn't care for intruders...mostly dwarves, but he's
not too picky when it comes to the killing.  You notice the blood covering the
tip of his huge stone club, and hope you don't add yours to the collection.

description:
It's impossible to miss the passing of this small bird, for the bright red
stands out against the dull brown and greens of the swampland.  The cardinal
grabs a small bug from the mud, and flies off again.

long_desc: A lizardman patrols his swampland home.
description:
A strong looking lizardman walks about the bog, keeping an eye out for any
trouble, or anything strange.  He stops when he see's you, and wonders why you
are here.

long_desc: The chieftess of the lizardmen stands thinking in her hut.
description:
As you enter the chieftess's hut, a large lizardwoman looks up at you.  She
scowls as she loses the thought in her head, and stares at you with reptilian
eyes.

long_desc: A large lizardman practices with a strange spear.
description:
This large lizardman concentrates on some interesting combat maneuvers, mixing
between spear usage and attacking with his tail.  He ignores your presence.

long_desc: An elderly lizardwoman witchhuntress studies some bones.
description:
The elderly lizardwoman shakes some bones in an old hollow gourd, and tosses
them on the ground.  She studies their locations and positions, then begins to
chuckle softly to herself.

long_desc: A lizardman stands here, stitching together leather and metal plates.
description:
Hard at work creating a new piece of armor, the lizardman armorer stitches
small metal plates onto a sturdy piece of armor.  He nods in your direction
when he notices you.

long_desc: An old lizardman sits bent over some scraps of parchment.
description:
This old lizardman pays you no attention as you approach.  He scratches at
some old parchment with a bright red quill.  You see what appears to be some
sort of runes written on the old scroll.

long_desc: The huntress of the lizardmen sharpens her spear.
description:
Making long strokes with a stone, the lizardmen huntress sits here sharpening
her spear.  Hanging about the small hut are various dead animals, stored here
for hungry lizardmen.

long_desc: A tall lizardman carrying a huge battle axe stops and flicks his tongue at you.
description:
There is no mistaking this mighty figure before you.  This can only be Sazrn
Delyn, the heroic lizardman warrior.  Many tales have been told over pints of
ale about his battles with dragons and demigods alike.  His strange reptilian
glare and flicking tongue give him a hostile look, but some have said he is
quite kind.

long_desc: A robed minotaur travels along the road.
description:
A young, robed minotaur travels down the road.  She nods politely as she
passes you, but doesn't seem to have much interest in your doings.

long_desc: A heavily armed minotaur snorts in your direction.
description:
Heavily armed and armored, this huge minotaur warrior glares at you.  He has
golden spikes fitted to the end of his horns, making him look even meaner than
a regular minotaur.  He apparently doesn't think much of you, from the sound
of his derisive snort.

long_desc: A timber wolf from the Spearfang Forest hunts for an easy meal.
description:
Leaving the safety of the forest in hopes of finding an easy meal on the road,

hoping to bring in a few fish for his dinner.

and his armor is dirty and tarnished.  He holds his weapon like a pro, and
walks with an easy grace.  He seems to be taking a good amount of enjoyment
out of scaring the new soldiers.

long_desc: This knight looks quite eager to get some combat time.
description:
This large man is heavily armored and is more than ready to bash a few skulls.
 He paces eagerly, waiting the order for him and his squad to move into the
village.  He yells at the new soldiers to enjoy this moment, because it is the
anticipation that makes the battle worth it.

long_desc: This knight is eagerly killing anything in range.
description:
This large man is heavily armored and using that to his advantage. He doesn't
care who he strikes down, he simply walks up and down through the wreckage of
the great city killing whatever he can.  He sees you and grins before he
charges forward.

long_desc: This sarge is yelling at his soldiers to kill whatever they can.
description:
This man is definitely in charge.  He orders the younger soldiers to get nasty
and just kill what they can.  He barks out his orders in a booming voice and
the way he strikes down the few rebels that dare get close to him you know
this is not his first combat situation. He sees you and decides the honor
should be his.

long_desc: This man is in charge of the destruction of this rebel city.
description:
This tall man looks like a noble and a drill instructor.  He yells to the men
to keep formation and pulls arrows out of his thick armor.  He surveys the
battle and yells to keep the flank tight and to watch for snipers. He yells
for a squad to come after you but then decides to it himself.

long_desc: This huge rebel is tearing through the Imperial soldiers in a rage.
description:
This half-ogre is lightly armored but wielding two huge weapons.  He is
tearing through the Imperial soldiers that get close enough to crush. His body
is bleeding but he seems to ignore the massive wounds in his stomach and
chest.  He seems you and cries out a call of war.

description:
This mercenary is definitely earning their pay.  They are quickly and easily
dispatching the Imperial conscripts, taking their dogtags or anything else
that would identify them as an Imperial kill to take back to headquarters to
earn their reward.  They see you and decide to try and get a bonus.

long_desc: This huge ogre is clubbing any Imperial he sees.
description:
This ogre must have been a chieftain or leader of the village before it was
attacked. Now he is one of the last rebel leaders left alive, charged with
defending this village until the last of the civilians can safely escape
somewhere.  He roars in rage and triumphant as he breaks the back of another
Imperial before charging after you.

long_desc: This lithe elf is using her magiks against the Imperials.
description:
This beautiful elven woman is one of the rebel commanders.  A powerful
warrior and mage, she uses her magik to destroy the Imperial soldiers before
they even get within a sword's reach of her.  She turns and sees you and asks
no questions, attacking any who she doesn't recognize as a rebel.

long_desc: This villager is trying to gather what they can and run.
description:
This poor half-ogre is trying to gather what they can and run with the others.
They are visibly very frightened and upset, but do what they can to gather the
loved ones they still have and make their way to a safer place.  They watch
with sorrow as their home burns to the ground.

description:
This woman is tall and graceful.  Her ears and her pale skin give a hint to
her ghoulish heritage.  She watches over her troops, knowing that many will
not be coming back.  The barricade is failing, and not all the supplies and
the civilians have been given enough time to escape the Imperials. She looks
at you and wonders where your allegiance lies.

long_desc: This beautiful creature is patrolling with a sword of flame.
description:
This creature is a mixture of light and humanity.  They have a human form,
a skin that seems to create light and you notice that they cast no shadow.
Their great eagle wings are a dark brown and their hunter's eyes watch
everything for any sign of the forces of the Nightmare or damnation.

their back and wear pearl and diamond armor that seems unbreakable. They watch
everything in sight, constantly vigilant for any sign of the forces of decay
and darkness.

description:
This creature floats just above the soft floor of light.  It has three sets of
wings down it's back.  Two wings cover it's legs and feet, two wings cover
it's body, while two more cover it's face.  The other celestials bow in
reverence to it as they make their way past, truly a creature of great power.

long_desc: This winged creature is holding a key of songs.
description:
This massive Celestial is carrying a great key that seems to sing great songs
you have never heard.  The creature seems to have masculine features, and the
other Celestials that pass refer to him by name.  He smiles at you and makes a
great bow, his dove wings stretching out slightly.

long_desc: This massive Celestial carries a Scythe and a key of souls.
description:
This Celestial has a solemn look on his face.  His armor is a dark grey and
his wings are that of a raven.  His carries a great scythe and looks out among
the other celestials.  They bow in respect to him but seem just the slightest
bit put off by him.  He radiates an aura of power and for the first time, you
feel threatened by one of these creatures.

long_desc: This beautiful woman is offering her blessings and holds a key of love.
description:
This woman is one of the most beautiful things you could ever imagine. Her
face is a dark porcelain, olive toned with the deepest brown eyes you have ever
seen.  Her robe reveals a body out of the sweetest dreams and her smile sends
a shiver into your soul.  She offers you a blessing and a kiss.

long_desc: This great winged creature seems to be locked in a sleep like meditation.
description:
This Celestial seems to be asleep, if they need sleep.  He holds a great key
of sacrifice in his hands.  His voice speaks in your head, yet you saw no
indication that he could have known you were here.  His body is massive and he
looks to be a creature of amazing power.

long_desc: This massive guardian watches you closely.
description:
This creature has one purpose in all of it's existence, to guard the Voice of
All.  It's job involves neither glory nor gain, yet it does it's duty with a
single-minded zeal that is frightening.  Why would a being of such love and
goodness need such a protector?

light, it is impossible to see if it has a solid form at all. It's light fills
the room, almost blinding.  You hear a voice that is not a voice at all in
your soul, it speaks its kindness and its wonder to you in a language that
cannot be expressed in words.

long_desc: This muddy dog prowls the swamp for anything edible.
description:
This mangy wolf is some type of dog, but from the huge fangs and the almost
scale like tail, this wolf has been corrupted by something in this swamp.  It
stalks the muddy waters, looking for any living or dead creature that has some
sort of meat.  The creature is looking dead at you.

bones are beginning to rot, yet it moves with grace and an uncanny strength.

long_desc: This large lizardwoman was once the proud all-mother of this tribe.
description:
The lizardwoman is by the largest you have encountered in this damned
place.  She stands eight feet tall and must weight three hundred pounds,
even though half her skin and muscle seems to have rotted away.  She
sits proudly in her decayed throne, regal even in undeath.

long_desc: A brightly-colored parrot lands on a branch.
description:
Colored in brilliant reds, yellows, and blues, this large parrot lands on a
branch and gives you the eye.  Its powerful beak looks like it could snap
right through a large tree-limb or perhaps an arm.

about, looking for food, but stops and watches you as it catches your scent.

description:
A sleek jaguar comes prowling stealthily through the leaves of the jungle,
stalking its prey.  Its bright eyes flash over you, and the cat pauses,
wondering if you might be a threat.

Hoping to find some carrion left behind by the larger predators, this wild dog
looks like it has seen better days.  Its coat is dirty and tangled, and it
bears the scars of many fights.  It growls deep in its throat when it notices
you.

this one is the size of a horse!  It clicks its sharp mandibles together, and
its eyestalks wiggle about as it watches you closely.

thick jungle growth.  It zooms about the branches, looking for smaller insects
to eat.

description:
Colored in brilliant reds, yellows, and blues, this large parrot lands on a
branch and gives you the eye.  Its powerful beak looks like it could snap
right through a large tree-limb or perhaps an arm.

long_desc: A small raccoon-like critter scurries about the undergrowth.
description:
A small critter, the lemur looks like a raccoon, with it's long striped tail
and pointed snout.  It looks for grubs and bugs in the wet earth of the
jungle.

long_desc: A bright green snake slides through the leaves.
description:
This bright green snake was hard to see amongst the leaves until it began to
move.  Hopefully there aren't others right above you!

long_desc: A man covered in strange inks watches you closely.
description:
This strange man must be one of the members of the local jungle tribe.  He is
covered in mystical designs made with bright inks.  A large hunting spear is
held at the ready.

long_desc: A woman covered wearing a wooden mask searches the brush.
description:
This woman must be one of the members of the local jungle tribe.  She is
wearing a large mask made of wood.  She digs under the brush, looking for
edible plants and small creatures to use for dinner.

long_desc: This man is cautiously surveying the land for signs of trouble.
description:
This man is nervous.  He is watching the road in hopes of spotting a war party
while there is still time to flee.  He knows that if the Imperial council or
Lord Zanzen himself found them that death would be all too sweet of a release.

long_desc: This non-military cleric is taking care of the wounded.
description:
This man is trying to heal the wounds of the soldiers. Magic and supplies are
running low but he is doing what he can.  He doesn't seem to be a soldier or
even a field medic but a cleric from the private world here on the order of
someone else.

long_desc: This woman is taking names of soldiers for her roster.
description:
This woman is calling out to the soldiers to rise against those that  sent
them to die for no reason.  She cries out that too many have died and that the
Empire of Zanzen must be toppled.  This elf carries a horrid scar across her
eye and throat.

long_desc: This doctor has the grisly job of amputations.
description:
This doctor's clothes are covered in blood and gore. His job is a thankless
one.  From his eyes you can see he takes no joy in his work but it must be
down if these men have any hope of survival.

long_desc: This large man surveys maps and soldier reports.
description:
The Field Marshal is a large man and you can imagine a great warrior as well.
He is busy trying to determine how many of his men are wounded, dead,
or missing.  He must be the one who organized this desertion. He is solemn
and quiet.

long_desc: This wizard was wounded in battle.
description:
This proud wizard was carried off of the battlefield by his bodyguards. His
wound is healing yet it is obvious he is not at full strength. He seems almost
angry that he is here.  He mumbled that honor dictated he should have died on
the battle field in glory rather than sit here in defeat.

long_desc: Jerald, the lowly Pitboy, sits here and puts donated items in the pit.
description:
Jerald is a big-time loser.  Unable to fight, he now attends to the needs of
the numerous militia that have come for arms and armor.  He sighs and hands
out spears to the militia or puts donated items into the pit for whomever is
brave enough to use them.

long_desc: Joey, the Questmaster of Alden, shakes his head.
description:
Good ol' Joey, he does nothing now but wait to die.  Use the command "AQUEST"
to see what he can do for you.  "If you are curious about what my items might
do for you, ask me about them, and I'll share the tales."  Tell or say to Joey
the exact name of the item in the list to hear his tales.

long_desc: Kallista, the Healer of the Temple smiles at you.
description:
This beautiful ghoul has a large gash across his cheek and another one across
her stomach.  She tends to the wounded as best she can, her gown drenched in
the blood of a dozen races of the world.  She tells you to use the heal
command if you require her services.

long_desc: Carlyle, the teller of the bank, counts piles of coins.
description:
Carlyle learned how to manage money at a young age, when he was the accountant
for the local Thieves Guild.  He was arrested and spent some time in Drazuk's
hellish prison, before repenting and promising to respect the material wealth
of others.  You had no idea he was such an accomplished mage that he is
capable of keeping his bank safe.

long_desc: Khent, the weaponsmith, stares at you with dull eyes.
description:
Khent is a simple man, born with the intelligence of an ogre child dropped at
birth.  But his ability in combat is rare and despite his age, he is still
fighting to keep his shop and his city free from the evil of the spawn.

long_desc: Franklin watches you closely, making sure you don't steal anything.
description:
A short and dark man, Franklin used to be the quartermaster for the local
Thieves Guild, until he had made enough money to open his own shop.  Now,
sanctioned by the Guild, he sells items to the thieves of the Realm.  Whatever
you need, if he doesn't have it, he can probably find it for you.

long_desc: Garth, the armorer, stops pounding at plate armor and looks up at you.
description:
A mountain of a man, Garth is famous for his protective gear.  From the
supplest leather armor to the stoutest steel plate, he creates and sells some
wonderful armor.

long_desc: Kar'tanth the Sorcerer looks up from his book as you enter.
description:
Shrouded in dark robes, Kar'tanth used to be the Master Mage of the Ghoul
Kingdom.  He stepped down from the position when Drazuk offered him the chance
to run a store of magic in Alden.  Now he provides adventurers with the
magical tools of their trade.

long_desc: This former cityguard is doing his best to take back the city!
description:
Being a cityguard of Alden is a thankless profession.  Being a defender
of Alden is even less rewarding.  He fights hard, despite the wounds he
has already suffered, and hopes that he will live to see Alden restored
to peace and wealth.

long_desc: A wounded templar continues to fight against the spawn!
description:

been outshined by the Battlesisters.  This man is older, obviously one of the
templars stationed close to home.  It seems this is the first battle he's been
in for a dozen winters.  His body is starting to shutting down from the large
wounds on his stomach and back.

hooks all over.  It somehow hovers and its large beak is lined with dozens of
teeth.  It feasts on what ever flesh is available, dead or alive.

long_desc: This creature of tentacles and hooks come right at you!
description:
This creature is essentially a squid with a fleshy body of a rhino and barbed
hooks all over.  It somehow hovers and its large beak is lined with dozens of
teeth.  It feasts on what ever flesh is available, dead or alive.

long_desc: The leader of the daemon army is here, laying waste to the city.
description:
This creature is neither humanoid nor a nightmare, neither real or an insane
illusion.  Azathoth is more than that, he is not flesh, nor blood, nor energy,
he simply is the hatred that consumes, beyond words for avarice or hunger.
There is no way to understand his will, he is beyond simple definitions.

long_desc: This giant fish like creature seems perfectly fine on dry land.
description:
This creature is the size of a whale and shaped as one as well.  However, its
body is made of eyes, it has teeth made of granite, and eyes of marble. It
swims in the air, somehow keeping its massive body floating in the air.

long_desc: This froglike creature is flying right at you!
description:
The deep ones are the basic shock troops of Azathoth.  Blessed with a heavy
hide and blind ferocity, these creatures will fight til death with no remorse,
no hesitation, and eternal hunger.   They appear to be frogs, given a vaguely
human form yet they still move by hopping and their mouths are lined with
curved teeth.

long_desc: This froglike creatures flies right at you!
description:
The deep ones are the basic shock troops of Azathoth.  Blessed with a heavy
hide and blind ferocity, these creatures will fight til death with no remorse,
no hesitation, and eternal hunger.   They appear to be frogs, given a vaguely
human form yet they still move by hopping and their mouths are lined with
curved teeth.

long_desc: This twisted man of shadows is looking for new creatures to experiment on.
description:
This man is made of darkness, his skin absorbs light, his eyes are simply two
dots of malice among a shadow.  His hands are bloodied, he seems to kill
simply for the joy of looking at the parts of his victim.  He laughs as the
blood grows thick and the intestines spread out.

long_desc: This creature is feeding itself to spawn more of the Mi-Gos.
description:
The Shoggoth is one of the main breeders of Azathoth's army. It is a
collection of wings, crab or lobster claws, tentacles, eye stalks, and claws.
It looks for anything edible, even stone and mortar, anything to feed the
infinite amount of Mi-Gos that seem to swirl under its skin.

long_desc: This twisted woman is the bride of Azathoth.
description:
The Shub-Niggurath is the mother of all the spawn, the consort and wife of
Azathoth.  She is a vicious creature, one who proudly gives birth to chaos,
despair, and madness.  She kills only for pleasure, only for the darkest
reasons that are unknown to man or ghoul, unknown even to the gods of the
world.

long_desc: This creature of bone and bile charges you!
description:
One of the unseen elder spawn, the slaanyeshi are the reanimated corpses of
those that fall to the elder spawn's taint.  Mostly a collection of bones from
various creatures and the bile they spill in death, they are none the less
effective soldiers for Azathoth.

long_desc: This creature of bone and bile charges you!
description:
One of the unseen elder spawn, the slaanyeshi are the reanimated corpses of
those that fall to the elder spawn's taint.  Mostly a collection of bones from
various creatures and the bile they spill in death, they are none the less
effective soldiers for Azathoth.

long_desc: This demonic horse with bat wings feasts on the dead!
description:
The nightgaunts in their true form are terrible to behold.  They have the body
of a horse except their mouth is a beak with several black tongues and
they have a massive wing span.  The creature eats whatever flesh is
available, although it prefers its meat dead.

long_desc: This demonic horse is looking for its next meal.
description:
The nightgaunts in their true form are terrible to behold.  They have the body
of a horse except their mouth is a beak with several black tongues and
they have a massive wing span.  The creature eats whatever flesh is
available, although it prefers its meat dead.

long_desc: This citizen of Alden has managed to survive somehow!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  He scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find his way to the temple.

long_desc: This citizen is desperately trying to get back to the Temple!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  He scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find his way to the temple.

long_desc: This citizen of Alden is trying to outrun the spawn!
description:
This citizen goes about his normal business.  Perhaps he is shopping, perhaps
running an errand.  All he cares about is getting his work done, and then
heading home.

long_desc: This citizen has somehow managed to survive!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  He scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find his way to the temple.

long_desc: This citizen is desperately trying to flee the city!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  He scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find his way to the temple.

long_desc: This citizen is trying to find her way back to the Temple!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  She scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find her way to the temple.

long_desc: This citizen is trying her best not to be hunted down by the Spawn!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  She scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find her way to the temple.

long_desc: This young woman is trying to get home!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  She scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find her way to the temple.

long_desc: This citizen cannot seem to find her way back to the Temple!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  She scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find her way to the temple.

long_desc: This woman is trying to find her missing brother!
description:
This citizen of Alden has managed to survive the onslaught of the elder
spawn, but not for long.  She scans the deserted and burning streets for any
sign of the spawn and desperately tries to find her way to the temple and find
her brother who has joined up with the local militia.

long_desc: Mistress Leah smiles at you with a broke jaw, hungry for fresh meat!
description:
Once a mighty cleric, Mistress Leah put down her mace and holy symbol, and
picked up fine cloth and needle, but now she is a twisted and warped
Slaanyeshi.  She looks for fresh meat to feed her form, growing stronger with
the various limbs she sticks into her own twisted form.

long_desc: Joseph the Tailor sighs and looks over what is left of his supply.
description:
When Joseph moved to Alden, the first thing he noticed was that
adventurers tended to wear the same battered and bloody armor to parties and
dinners that they would wear to fight orcs.  He knew that the problem was the
lack of fine outfits, so he opened his own store to serve the needs of the
more refined adventurer.  Yet now, he is trapped inside the Temple, his
shop burned and he has resorted to selling only a small collection of what he
has left.

long_desc: Ranger Richard defends his shop til last breath!
description:
Richard the Ranger used to be one of the top rangers in the Realm, until a
pack of wild boars nearly ended his life.  But now all he has is his shop,
and with its position right next to the temple, he fights hard to make sure the
militia and defenders have a solid defensive point.

long_desc: This massive toad creature is the god of the frozen ones.
description:
This creature is much akin to the deep ones, but even more twisted, more
massive, with skin that seems to be frozen, yet it moves and slithers as if it
had a mind of its own.  Its tongue spits out at blazing speed, taking a
survivor into its mouth.  The ground freezes as it moves, blood becomes
crystal as soon as its jaws close down.

long_desc: This plain man touch seems to create Slaanyeshi from the scores he kills.
description:
This man is neither large nor fearsome.  His face is vaguely human, yet with
sharper features and a large brow.  He has no eyes, only two small mouths that
seem to lick the blood from his face.  He kills without mercy and without
hesitation.  He has the heads of dozens of masked hunters trailing behind him,
all of them with faces frozen in terror.  Nameless, the one great hunter of
Drazuk, the most feared soldier alive, has fallen, and will take the world
with him.

long_desc: This gnome engineer is doing his best to keep the Raptor flying.
description:
This gnome is one of the most skilled of the kintertown mechanics. He has come
from the technological rebel hideaway to aid Alden in the hour of their
greatest need.  He is the only demi-human alive who still holds the knowledge
necessary to operate a war zepplin.

long_desc: This dwarf manipulates the huge gears and levers of the cannons.
description:
This dwarven warrior is thick with muscle earned from manning the gigantic gun
batteries. He manipulates levers and pedals with small movements which are
magnified into precise arcs by the strata of the cannon suspension. His eyes
are the same cold hard metal as his guns, and they move with the same sweeping
grace as he selects the next target.

long_desc: An ethernaught is here, acting as further artillery.
description:
This machine stands nearly twice as tall as the biggest ogre you have ever
seen. It is humanoid in shape, built out of overlapping metal plates of armor
covered in runic wards. The small shape of a gnome pilot can be seen in its
bowels, outlined by the flickering green light of a magical furnace.

long_desc: This ghostly sarge once stood beside Cahel himself.
description:
This is the ghost of the Sarge, Cahels faithful second in command from the
days of the Ogre ways. He has overseen the care and preparation of the Raptor
for centuries, awating this very day. The deeply etched lines in his grizzled
face speak volumes. Hes seen all this before and he knows exactly what needs
to be done.

long_desc: Jeeves, the Royal Butler, stands at attention here.
description:
Jeeves, the butler of the Royal family, stands at attention here.  If you need
anything at all, he will get it for you.

long_desc: Sarah, the ghoul chef, wonders why you are in her kitchen.
description:
Before you stands Sarah, the famous chef of the ghoul Royal family.  She runs
the small kitchen of the hideaway, for it allows her the chance to dedicate
herself to taking care of the few people who come here.

long_desc: The Warrior Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Fargo, the local real estate agent, smiles at you.
description:
Fargo moved to Alden when it was quite small, and purchased most of the
surrounding land.  Now the land is tainted with elder spawn and his shop is
most probably a graveyard.  He has settled now to waiting for the war to end,
one way or another

long_desc: Joyce stands by the bar, cleaning some mugs.
description:
Joyce is the owner and barmistress of The Nightgaunt's Tickler, a popular
tavern in Alden.  She will not let her life's work be destroyed by the
elder spawn and years of running a tavern have made her quite the  fighter.

long_desc: Thornton travels about, offering his banking services.
description:
Thornton had always wanted to work for the First Bank of Alden, but
hated the idea of sitting around in a bank all day long.  He now travels the
realms, offering his services to all who can track him down.  He has an
agreement to work with the First Bank of Alden only, and he keeps in
contact with Carlyle with a special spell they crafted.

long_desc: An old warrior travels about the realms.
description:
Malaclypse, the great human warrior, travels about the realms looking for
adventure.  You were raised on tales of his awesome battles with mystical
beings.  Perhaps one day you will be as famous as he is!

long_desc: Thalen, the portalmaster, stands quietly.
description:
Thalen stands quietly, concentrating on the portal, and helping shape its
mysterious transport magic.

long_desc: The Monk Guildmaster bows as you enter.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Thug Guildmaster sneers back at you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A bleeding masked hunter is here, hunting spawn and being hunted.
description:
Wearing a black hood and mask, this must be one of the famous Alden
assassins.  Hired by Drazuk to hunt down the killers who prey upon the weak,
they are very deadly.  No target of theirs has lived very long to tell the
tale of meeting one in combat. But this hunter is scarred, bleeding and has
obviously met something stronger, darker, a better killer.  You shudder to
think what could strike fear into this creature.

long_desc: Samuel, the repairsmith, polishes up an old bit of armor.
description:
Samuel wipes an oiled rag over a spot on some plate mail, buffing out the
scratch it gained in some sort of battle.  He looks up as you enter.  "Ahh,
messing with dragons again?  I can make that armor look as good as new!"

keywords: Lilyan recharger charger wizard elder spawn
long_desc: Lilyan stalks the city, looking for blood.
description:
Lilyan looks around, searching for the correct ingrediants to recharge her
wands and staves, except she figures that blood and souls would work better.
Her eyes are hollow and her mouth is torn apart, she searches for the right
ingrediants.

long_desc: A scaly man with a tail tends to the bar.
description:
What appears to be half man, half dragon, stands here in a tuxedo (with a hole
for his tail at the back).  Serving drinks to his guests, LIST what kind of
drink you want.

long_desc: A redhaired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and flaming red hair, you recognize this woman as Tressa,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: Hmm...you thought you saw something, but its gone now...
description:
There it is again...strange, like maybe just the edge of a shadow moved.  How
bizarre...you must be imagining things.

long_desc: Hey...you shouldn't be able to see Yoyoman!
description: This is bad...you should not be able to see Yoyoman!

long_desc: A scrawny rat with strangely glowing teeth squeaks at you!
description:
This squeaky rat has teeth that glow a brilliant blue...they look awfully
sharp also!  Maybe you should leave him alone...

long_desc: A succubus ransomed by Vash packs a pipe of opium hash with long thin fingers.
description:
This succubus was purchased by Vash on one of the many misadventures he has
undertaken into the demon homeland to rid himself of his addiction to magic.
She dresses herself in tight scarlet robes which stretch tightly over her kohl
skin.  Her breasts are small but firm and her clothing does little to hide it,
her stomach is flat and also exposed in a long flawless swoop towards her
hips, which swell gently and subtly from her frame and seem to accentuate her
long and shapely legs. She eyes everyone who looks at her in the hopes that
maybe they will not remember that she feeds upon sex. A small piece of
spidersilk is knotted carefully around her ankle in gossamer webwork that is
almost lace. She is a fearsome demon, and this is the only chain which can
hold her to her service.

long_desc: The Diabolist Guildmaster stares intently at you.
description:
A darkly robed figure watches you closely, a small grinning imp perched on his
shoulder.  A leather-bound book hangs at his side from a platinum chain, its
surface covered in demonic runes.

long_desc: The grand artificer Vorthan bows as you approach.
description:
Famous for his creation of powerful artifacts for the court of Drazuk, Vorthan
now makes his living buying those artifacts that adventurers find are no
longer useful to them.

long_desc: Look!  It's Testboy!
description: This is Testboy.

long_desc: A curly haired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and curly blond hair, you recognize this woman as Sara,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A muscular woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and solid muscles, you recognize this woman as Amy,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A beautiful, pale skinned woman stands here holding a silver tray.
description:
This beautiful young woman, about five and a half feet in height, stands
dressed in a tight, black gown that sweeps the marble floor as she walks.
Her long, slightly curled black hair falls just below her shoulders, a few
bangs draping over her onyx black eyes.  Thin straps hold her dress on her
petite body, the front showing a decent amount of her milky white skin, the
back dipping down to just above her waist.  On her outstretched hands she
holds a thin silver tray, offering you glasses of an unfamiliar red liquid.  A
small amulet hangs from her neck, a beautiful ruby surrounded by smaller
diamonds attached to a silver chain.  Following the band up the side of her
neck, you see what appears to be two small puncture wounds on the side of her
throat.  Full, pouty lips cover two longer-than-average teeth, which you
notice as she flashes you a mischievous smile, catching your gaze upon her.

long_desc: The Jester Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A small ugly man in a dark cloak grins back at you.
description:
Grimwald is the local undertaker of Alden.  He does a dirty job that
noone else wanted, but it is important none the less.  For a fee, he can
recover the corpses of the younger, less-deadly adventurers. He has been quite
busy since the spawn arrived, even though he lost his shop.

long_desc: The Shaman Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Conjurer Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Talesha, the transporter for Alden, smiles as you arrive.
description:
Master of the arts of transport, Talesha figured she could make a killing
transporting those to lazy to make the long treks across the realm.  For a
price, she can sell you a ticket that will take you to various locations
around the realm.

long_desc: This spirit helps contain the powers of the transportal.
description: This glowing spirit is necessary to ensure that the transportal works properly.

short_desc: the Spirit of the Black Sable Dragon
long_desc: A mass of shadow lurks within the room.
description:
A mass of shadow lurks within the room. Suddenly your mind is filled with a
strange voice.  "Leave now or be destroyed."

long_desc: A beautiful house maid stands here.
description:
The most beautiful woman ever seen, except for perhaps the
Goddesses themselves, stands here, clad in silk from head to
toe.  Just gazing at her has led many men to envy. After being
rescued from horrible ogres by Soloman, she now waits on him
with gratitude. Not a servant this one but a volunteer, she readily
assists in anyway she can, selling numerous supplies bought from
town and cleaning the quarters for her hero.

long_desc: This strange creature is dressed in zipper-covered leathers.
description: Muahaha!

long_desc: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

long_desc: Jerald, the lowly Pitboy, sits here and puts donated items in the pit.
description:
Jerald is a big-time loser.  He did nothing during the War Of The Seal, he
stuck to his duties despite the fact citizens younger than him did their best
to defend the city.  Unable to do anything worthwhile, he now spends all his
time in the temple, just making sure items that get donated end up in the pit.

long_desc: Joey, the Questmaster of Alden, smiles at you.
description:
Good ol' Joey, Drazuk liked him so much, he gave him a job as the Questmaster
of Alden.  Use the command "AQUEST" to see what he can do for you.  "If
you are curious about what my items might do for you, ask me about them, and
I'll share the tales."  Tell or say to Joey the exact name of the item in the
list to hear his tales.

long_desc: Kallista, the Healer of the Temple smiles at you.
description:
The Healer of the Temple of Drazuk, Kallista smiles at you. She has a large
scar over her eye, ruining some of the magnificent beauty of her face.  She
fought hard during The War but also spent her time healing the many wounded.
She tells you "Use the HEAL command to see what I can do for you."

long_desc: Carlyle, the teller of the bank, counts piles of coins.
description:
Carlyle learned how to manage money at a young age, when he was the accountant
for the local Thieves Guild.  He was arrested and spent some time in Drazuk's
hellish prison, before repenting and promising to respect the material wealth
of others.

long_desc: Khent, the weaponsmith, stares at you with dull eyes.
description:
Before you stands Khent, the mighty warrior, who's strength in battle only
just barely surpasses his stupidity.  He limps about the store, many of his
weapons look dirty and stained with the ichor of some foul creature.  He
proved his strength once again when the Seal broke, although his brains are
still a little less than that of a stone.

long_desc: Franklin watches you closely, making sure you don't steal anything.
description:
A short and dark man, Franklin used to be the quartermaster for the local
Thieves Guild, until he had made enough money to open his own shop.  Now,
sanctioned by the Guild, he sells items to the thieves of the Realm.  Whatever
you need, if he doesn't have it, he can probably find it for you.

long_desc: Garth, the armorer, stops pounding at plate armor and looks up at you.
description:
A mountain of a man, Garth is famous for his protective gear.  From the
supplest leather armor to the stoutest steel plate, he creates and sells some
wonderful armor. Many of the armors he sells were used to equip the brave
defenders of Alden.  Judging by the scars, Garth saw plenty of action
himself.

long_desc: Kar'tanth the Sorcerer looks up from his book as you enter.
description:
Shrouded in dark robes, Kar'tanth used to be the Master Mage of the Ghoul
Kingdom.  He stepped down from the position when Drazuk offered him the chance
to run a store of magic in Alden.  Now he provides adventurers with the
magical tools of their trade.  He has fallen from grace in the eyes of the
other  ghouls for choosing to hide in the temple and "distribute" supplies
rather than fight.

long_desc: This wounded man is still patrolling the city.
description:
Being a cityguard of Alden is a thankless profession.  Attempting to
keep the peace in a land of monsters and adventurers is a tough job, and the
turnover rate in Alden is extremely high.  The pay is good however, and
they get some pretty nice armor.  He has several bandages on his face and

description:
This small ugly dog searches about the streets for food.  It is dirty and
skinny.  It looks up at you and barks, hoping you might hand it a bit of
something to eat.  It is rather fat after feasting off the corpses of so many
defenders of Alden.

description:
This man was once a janitor of Alden but now instead of removing garbage
he is trying to help rebuild her by gathering any discarded materials or scrap
he can.  It is hard and sullen work but a necessary one to rebuild
Alden.

long_desc: This dwarf is doing her best to rebuild the numerous buildings of the city.
description:
This young dwarf woman is doing her best to repair, or in most cases,
completely rebuild the many stone buildings of Alden.  She inspects the
buildings, doing her best to identify which parts are worth saving and what
must be  redone.

long_desc: This dwarf is doing her best to repair and rebuild the city.
description:
This young dwarf woman is doing her best to repair, or in most cases,
completely rebuild the many stone buildings of Alden.  She inspects the
buildings, doing her best to identify which parts are worth saving and what
must be  redone.

long_desc: This older elf uses his magik's to turn rubble into useable materials.
description:
This older elf is one of the rare stone-shapers, a small and mostly shunned
association of elven conjurers who pride themselves on turning any material
into granite, steel, and other essential building supplies.  With the sheer
amount of damage to the city, he will be busy for quite some time.

long_desc: A citizen of Alden wearily makes his way through the city.
description:

Spawn have been Sealed away once more.  He is injured, it seems he managed to
survive the attack but not unscathed.  There is a great amount of fear and
sorrow in his eyes.

description:
This citizen is doing her best adjust to life inside Alden.  The market
doesn't quite have the selection it once did, nor are there many places for
her children to play.  But the city still stands and she still lives, and
that's what matters to her.

long_desc: Mistress Shilea attends to her sister's shop.
description:
Once an adventurer throughout the realm, Mistress Shilea returned to
Alden after her sister Leah was killed during the war with the Spawn.
She is beautiful and proud, her full lips scarred from several cruel attacks.
She seems quite at home with a needle and cloth, but she looks uneasy at
taking over his sister's occupation.

long_desc: Joseph the Tailor bows, and offers to show you around the shop.
description:
When Joseph moved to Alden, the first thing he noticed was that
adventurers tended to wear the same battered and bloody armor to parties and
dinners that they would wear to fight orcs.  He knew that the problem was the
lack of fine outfits, so he opened his own store to serve the needs of the
more refined adventurer.  He looks sullen as his shop is still in the process
of being repaired, judging by the graffiti on the walls, the other residents
of the city are unhappy that he chose to hide inside the Temple rather than
fight.

long_desc: Ranger Richard looks up as you enter, nods, then goes back to his book.
description:
Richard the Ranger used to be one of the top rangers in the Realm, until a
pack of wild boars nearly ended his life.  Deciding to change professions
before something worse happened, he took his gathered wealth and opened a
string of outdoor-gear shops.  The scars on his face, arms, and the heavy limp
show that there are worse things in the world than boars, and Richard fought
them proudly and without fear.

long_desc: A dirty rat pokes about the streets looking for food.
description:
This small dirty rat patrols the streets, looking for the scraps of the fallen
that might still litter the street.  It is much larger than other rats, the
past few months have been a feast for the rats, and this one looks none to
happy that the city has returned to some sense of normalacy.

description:
This man was once a beggar in the streets of Alden but now he has a
difficult but rewarding job of rebuilding the city.  He has had a bath, a
clean set of clothes from Joseph, and a lot of work to do.

long_desc: Jeeves, the Royal Butler, stands at attention here.
description:
Jeeves, the butler of the Royal family, stands at attention here.  If you need
anything at all, he will get it for you.

long_desc: Sarah, the ghoul chef, wonders why you are in her kitchen.
description:
Before you stands Sarah, the famous chef of the ghoul Royal family.  She runs
the small kitchen of the hideaway, for it allows her the chance to dedicate
herself to taking care of the few people who come here.

long_desc: The Warrior Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Fargo, the local real estate agent, smiles at you.
description:
Fargo moved to Alden when it was quite small, and purchased most of the
surrounding land.  He can sell you various deeds to plots of land, where you
can have your own residence constructed, for a fee of course.  Land is cheaper
now than it was, but you still have to build everything.

long_desc: Joyce stands by the bar, cleaning some mugs.
description:
Joyce is the owner and barmistress of The Nightgaunt's Tickler, a popular
tavern in Alden.  She had it built when she realized that for all the
people who came to the city, there originally wasn't anywhere to find food and
drink.  Knowing the large profits to be made, the Tickler was put up in record
time.  She is missing an eye and her left leg, all so she could defend what is
left of her beautiful tavern.

long_desc: Thornton travels about, offering his banking services.
description:
Thornton had always wanted to work for the First Bank of Alden, but
hated the idea of sitting around in a bank all day long.  He now travels the
realms, offering his services to all who can track him down.  He has an
agreement to work with the First Bank of Alden only, and he keeps in
contact with Carlyle with a special spell they crafted.

long_desc: An old warrior travels about the realms.
description:
Malaclypse, the great human warrior, travels about the realms looking for
adventure.  You were raised on tales of his awesome battles with mystical
beings.  But the times have changed, he hasn't been as respected since the war
when he prefered to wander the realm rather than fight the Spawn.

long_desc: Thalen, the portalmaster, stands quietly.
description:
Thalen stands quietly, concentrating on the portal, and helping shape its
mysterious transport magic.

long_desc: The Monk Guildmaster bows as you enter.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Thug Guildmaster sneers back at you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A masked hunter looks about, checking for the tracks of a killer.
description:
Wearing a black hood and mask, this must be one of the famous Alden
assassins.  Hired by Drazuk to hunt down the killers who prey upon the weak,
they are very deadly.  No target of theirs has lived very long to tell the
tale of meeting one in combat.  Their numbers are fewer now after the war,
most of them dead at the hands of Nameless.  This one looks to have had a
nasty run in with something.
