long_desc: Samuel, the repairsmith, polishes up an old bit of armor.
description:
Samuel has prospered since the war.  There was quite a bit of armor to fix
after the Spawn were pushed out of Alden and back to the Seal.  However,
most of those that come in only do so because there is no other armorsmith in
Alden.  Most are upset that Samuel disappeared entirely during the war
rather than help fight or supply the militia with fresh armor and weapons.

long_desc: Lilyan specializes in recharging magical items.
description:
Rillian looks over the magic instruments in his shop and watches them glow in
response to each touch.  After his mother was killed, he relocated from
studying in Elenolos to running his mother's shop. He is a gifted enchanter
and well known for his skills, but working in a shop was not his ambition but
to honor his mother Lilyan, he does what he has to do.

long_desc: A scaly man with a tail tends to the bar.
description:
What appears to be half man, half dragon, stands here in a tuxedo (with a hole
for his tail at the back).  Serving drinks to his guests, LIST what kind of
drink you want.

long_desc: A redhaired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and flaming red hair, you recognize this woman as Tressa,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: Hmm...you thought you saw something, but its gone now...
description:
There it is again...strange, like maybe just the edge of a shadow moved.  How
bizarre...you must be imagining things.

long_desc: Hey...you shouldn't be able to see Yoyoman!
description: This is bad...you should not be able to see Yoyoman!

long_desc: A scrawny rat with strangely glowing teeth squeaks at you!
description:
This squeaky rat has teeth that glow a brilliant blue...they look awfully
sharp also!  Maybe you should leave him alone...

long_desc: A succubus ransomed by Vash packs a pipe of opium hash with long thin fingers.
description:
This succubus was purchased by Vash on one of the many misadventures he has
undertaken into the demon homeland to rid himself of his addiction to magic.
She dresses herself in tight scarlet robes which stretch tightly over her kohl
skin.  Her breasts are small but firm and her clothing does little to hide it,
her stomach is flat and also exposed in a long flawless swoop towards her
hips, which swell gently and subtly from her frame and seem to accentuate her
long and shapely legs. She eyes everyone who looks at her in the hopes that
maybe they will not remember that she feeds upon sex. A small piece of
spidersilk is knotted carefully around her ankle in gossamer webwork that is
almost lace. She is a fearsome demon, and this is the only chain which can
hold her to her service.

long_desc: The Diabolist Guildmaster stares intently at you.
description:
A darkly robed figure watches you closely, a small grinning imp perched on his
shoulder.  A leather-bound book hangs at his side from a platinum chain, its
surface covered in demonic runes.

long_desc: The grand artificer Vorthan bows as you approach.
description:
Famous for his creation of powerful artifacts for the court of Drazuk, Vorthan
now makes his living buying those artifacts that adventurers find are no
longer useful to them.

long_desc: Look!  It's Testboy!
description: This is Testboy.

long_desc: A curly haired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and curly blond hair, you recognize this woman as Sara,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A muscular woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and solid muscles, you recognize this woman as Amy,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A beautiful, pale skinned woman stands here holding a silver tray.
description:
This beautiful young woman, about five and a half feet in height, stands
dressed in a tight, black gown that sweeps the marble floor as she walks.
Her long, slightly curled black hair falls just below her shoulders, a few
bangs draping over her onyx black eyes.  Thin straps hold her dress on her
petite body, the front showing a decent amount of her milky white skin, the
back dipping down to just above her waist.  On her outstretched hands she
holds a thin silver tray, offering you glasses of an unfamiliar red liquid.  A
small amulet hangs from her neck, a beautiful ruby surrounded by smaller
diamonds attached to a silver chain.  Following the band up the side of her
neck, you see what appears to be two small puncture wounds on the side of her
throat.  Full, pouty lips cover two longer-than-average teeth, which you
notice as she flashes you a mischievous smile, catching your gaze upon her.

long_desc: The Jester Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A small ugly man in a dark cloak grins back at you.
description:
Grimwald is the local undertaker of Alden.  He does a dirty job that
noone else wanted, but it is important none the less.  For a fee, he can
recover the corpses of the younger, less-deadly adventurers.

long_desc: The Shaman Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Conjurer Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Talesha, the transporter for Alden, smiles as you arrive.
description:
Master of the arts of transport, Talesha figured she could make a killing
transporting those to lazy to make the long treks across the realm.  For a
price, she can sell you a ticket that will take you to various locations
around the realm.

long_desc: This spirit helps contain the powers of the transportal.
description: This glowing spirit is necessary to ensure that the transportal works properly.

short_desc: the Spirit of the Black Sable Dragon
long_desc: A mass of shadow lurks within the room.
description:
A mass of shadow lurks within the room. Suddenly your mind is filled with a
strange voice.  "Leave now or be destroyed."

long_desc: A beautiful house maid stands here.
description:
The most beautiful woman ever seen, except for perhaps the
Goddesses themselves, stands here, clad in silk from head to
toe.  Just gazing at her has led many men to envy. After being
rescued from horrible ogres by Soloman, she now waits on him
with gratitude. Not a servant this one but a volunteer, she readily
assists in anyway she can, selling numerous supplies bought from
town and cleaning the quarters for her hero.

long_desc: This ancient ghoul woman will sell you the rarest relics in the world.
description:
This ghoul woman is by far the oldest living creature you have laid eyes upon,
save for perhaps some of the ancient lizards of the world.  She runs this
small shop in the hero's hideout, her personal collection of the rarest items
in the world.

long_desc: This strange creature is dressed in zipper-covered leathers.
description: Muahaha!

long_desc: A dread wolf is hunting here.
A slimy slug is here scrounging up a meal.
A bone naga rears up on its tail, ready to strike at you.
description:
Possessing the lower body of a snake and the upper body of a skeleton,
this creature is something to be careful of.

can see of it is more like a transparent mist.

long_desc: Agape, Lord of Knowledge, sits here reading, waiting for students.
description:
Agape, the Lord of Knowledge, smiles at you.  He knows all and sees all, so is
the perfect person to learn your lessons from.  He carries the Book of
Knowledge with him everywhere, and it contains the secrets of the Realms.

long_desc: A marble statue of a dark Diabolist stands here.
description:
This Diabolist is carved from the finest of marbles.  The artist seems to have
caught the vitality of his subject, so much so that the statue seems alive.

long_desc: Lord Kell, Master of Healing stands before you.
description:
The mighty Lord Kell greets you as you enter, and begins the incantations that
will prepare your body and mind for the challenges ahead of you.  You feel
like you should grovel towards such a figure.

long_desc: A strong ranger is here, selling his wares.
description:
This mighty ranger has a few things for sale that might help you out.  You
should check what he has for you, and maybe make a few purchases.

long_desc: A dragonsnake is here, venomous saliva dripping from its jaws.
description:
This is a small, but vicious dragon. His body is long and serpentine.
This will be quite a battle, but the prize is well worth the effort.

long_desc: An automaton stands here, generated so you can practice combat on it.
description:
The clay reproduction of a man, the automaton stands here, magical given just
enough life to simulate combat with you.

long_desc: An elven woman sits here, waiting to assist you into the proper portals.
description:
This young elf is here to direct you towards the proper guilds.  She enjoys
her duties in the University, aiding the new adventurers to the training area
of their chosen class.

long_desc: A marble statue of an ancient mage.
description:
This is a statue of an wizened old mage. Made of fine marble that is magical
and contains the spirit of the subject after which it was fashioned.

long_desc: A marble statue of an ancient cleric.
description:
This is a statue made of fine marble, depicting a cleric. She is done
in a lifelike manner, like she was a real person dipped in the marble.

long_desc: A marble statue of an ancient thief.
description:
This statue is made from the darkest black marble you have ever seen.
It depicts a shadowy cloaked thief. You feel his eyes on you, like it is
a living person and not a statue at all.

long_desc: A marble statue of an ancient warrior.
description:
This warrior is carved from the finest of marbles. The artist seems to
have caught the vitality of his subject, so much so that the statue seems
alive.

long_desc: A marble statue of a streetwise thug.
description:
This is a marble carving of a streetwise thug.  He stands tall and holds a
large club at the ready.  A sneer crosses his face and a menacing look fills
his eye.

long_desc: A marble statue of an ancient druid.
description:
This is a finely carved statue of an old druidess in ceremonial white
robes. She is made to look so natural, you are sure she is alive.

long_desc: A marble statue of an ancient ranger.
description:
This statue was made with excellent details. This ranger stands proud.
Then you notice a movement, you are sure it is alive.

description:
Eager to test his prowess in battle, this young gnoll bares his fangs at you.
He is trying to strike fear in your heart.

description:
This small pixie flits about on little wings, and casts suspicious glances in
your direction.

long_desc: A beautiful lady stands here, waiting for her students.
description:
This has to be one of the most beautiful women in these Realms, both inside
and out. Her eyes have a sparkle of amusement and her face an easy smile.
She knows you are admiring her, and she does not seem to mind. She is
comfortable and confident that the picture she makes is breath taking. Her
voice at last breaks the spell. Her voice is like satin, you can hardly
wait for your lessons to begin. Any reason to hear her speak the tongues
foreign to your ears.

long_desc: A spirit naga glides towards you and attacks!
description:
Dragged back from their eternal rest, these nagas were Queen Asp's personal
bodyguards.  Known to be fierce fighters in their past lifetime, they now
possess an "undying" loyalty to their Queen.

long_desc: Asp, Queen of the Nagas, bares her fangs at your intrusion.
description:
Standing before you is a woman of flawless beauty, looking down you gasp in
shock horror. From the waist down Asp has the form of a snake! Skilled with
a sword and possession of a keen intellect are but a few of the traits that
have allowed her to rise in power among her people.

long_desc: An apprentice of Drazuk is here studying his spellbook.
description:
Don't let appearances fool you, this young one possesses great magical
skill beyond his years. He one days hopes to fill the position of his
master Drazuk in his role as Archmage of the Realm's.

long_desc: The illustrious University Headmaster stands here to greet you.
description:
You have heard tales of the warrior known as Eganrac, and none of them were
pleasant.  He has mastered every combat skill and wields much magical power.
That must be the reason Drazuk gave him a job as Headmaster of the University.

long_desc: A marble statue of an active monk stands here.
description:
This Monk is carved from the finest of marbles.  The artist seems to have
caught the vitality of his subject, so much so that the statue seems alive.

description:

of the spectre is constantly shifting in and out of existence, what you
can see of it is more like a transparent mist.

lower half is that of a snake, while the upper part is that of a
woman.  She does not look happy to see you.

looks rather small compared to others of its kind you have encountered.

description:
Eager to test his prowess in battle, this young gnoll bares his fangs at you
as he tries to strike fear in your heart.

description:
It looks back at you with beady little eyes.  With a snarl he attacks, but
you are sure you can beat in combat.

long_desc: A large fire ant wanders here, cautious of your intrusion.
description:
This ant is almost as tall as you are!  You cannot believe you are looking
at a insect of this size.  Its body is tense with aggravation as it
ponders your intrusion.  You have interrupted its food collecting, perhaps
you will now be its next meal.

the nerve to walk across your feet as if you existence means nothing to
it. You watch in awe as those one hundred legs move in rhythm.

Jerald, the lowly Pitboy, sits here and puts donated items in the pit.
description:
Jerald is a big-time loser.  Unable to do anything worthwhile, he now spends
all his time in the temple, just making sure items that get donated end up in
the pit.

long_desc: Joey, the Questmaster of Alden, smiles at you.
description:
Good ol' Joey, Drazuk liked him so much, he gave him a job as the Questmaster
of Alden.  Use the command "AQUEST" to see what he can do for you.  "If
you are curious about what my items might do for you, ask me about them, and
I'll share the tales."  Tell or say to Joey the exact name of the item in the
list to hear his tales.

long_desc: Kallista, the Healer of the Temple smiles at you.
description:
The Healer of the Temple of Drazuk, Kallista smiles at you.  An
extraordinarily gorgeous ghoul, she has studied many years under the Tutors of
Knowledge, and has gained great powers of healing.  "Use the command "heal" to
see what I can offer you," she says in a musical voice.

long_desc: Carlyle, the teller of the bank, counts piles of coins.
description:
Carlyle learned how to manage money at a young age, when he was the accountant
for the local Thieves Guild.  He was arrested and spent some time in Drazuk's
hellish prison, before repenting and promising to respect the material wealth
of others.

long_desc: Khent, the weaponsmith, stares at you with dull eyes.
description:
Before you stands Khent, the mighty warrior, who's strength in battle only
just barely surpasses his stupidity.  Tales have been told about how he was
born with much muscle, but no brains.  He stares at you dully, waiting for you
to buy something.

long_desc: Franklin watches you closely, making sure you don't steal anything.
description:
A short and dark man, Franklin used to be the quartermaster for the local
Thieves Guild, until he had made enough money to open his own shop.  Now,
sanctioned by the Guild, he sells items to the thieves of the Realm.  Whatever
you need, if he doesn't have it, he can probably find it for you.

long_desc: Garth, the armorer, stops pounding at plate armor and looks up at you.
description:
A mountain of a man, Garth is famous for his protective gear.  From the
supplest leather armor to the stoutest steel plate, he creates and sells some
wonderful armor.

long_desc: Kar'tanth the Sorcerer looks up from his book as you enter.
description:
Shrouded in dark robes, Kar'tanth used to be the Master Mage of the Ghoul
Kingdom.  He stepped down from the position when Drazuk offered him the chance
to run a store of magic in Alden.  Now he provides adventurers with the
magical tools of their trade.

long_desc: A cityguard of Alden keeps the peace around here.
description:
Being a cityguard of Alden is a thankless profession.  Attempting to
keep the peace in a land of monsters and adventurers is a tough job, and the
turnover rate in Alden is extremely high.  The pay is good however, and
they get some pretty nice armor.

long_desc: A small scruffy dog searches the streets for bits of food.
description:
This small ugly dog searches about the streets for food.  It is dirty and
skinny.  It looks up at you and barks, hoping you might hand it a bit of
something to eat.

description:
A member of the Janitors Guild of Alden, this man strives to keep the
streets clean of debris.  He has a hard time, since adventurers always seem to
be leaving bits of armor and weapons lying around.  He grumbles as he pushes
his broom along.

long_desc: A young female dwarf, dressed for travelling, strolls past you.
description:
Dressed for adventuring, this young female dwarf smiles at you as your walk
past her.  She has the tough look that most dwarves have, and her axe has many
notches in its handle.  She has probably slain quite a few monsters in her
time.

long_desc: An elven mage looks down his nose at you.
description:
This elven mage stares at you haughtily.  He is dressed in robes covered with
arcane runes.  You notice that his feet don't touch the ground; obviously the
effect of some spell he has cast on himself.

description:
This citizen goes about his normal business.  Perhaps he is shopping, perhaps
running an errand.  All he cares about is getting his work done, and then
heading home.

long_desc: Mistress Leah smiles at you, and shows you around her shop.
description:
Once a mighty cleric, Mistress Leah put down her mace and holy symbol, and
picked up fine cloth and needle, and now designs wonderful clothes for the
female adventurer who isn't currently battling dragons.  She knows that
sometimes armor and travel-stained cloaks aren't appropriate for certain
situations, so she's here to fill that gap.  Leah tells you, "We base our line
on a basic pattern.  Just ask an Immortal and they can customize the look to
your preferences."

long_desc: Joseph the Tailor bows, and offers to show you around the shop.
description:
When Joseph moved to Alden, the first thing he noticed was that
adventurers tended to wear the same battered and bloody armor to parties and
dinners that they would wear to fight orcs.  He knew that the problem was the
lack of fine outfits, so he opened his own store to serve the needs of the
more refined adventurer.  Joseph mentions to you, "Although everything you see
comes from a basic pattern, talk to an Immortal and they can help you
customize your clothing to fit your own special look."

long_desc: Ranger Richard looks up as you enter, nods, then goes back to his book.
description:
Richard the Ranger used to be one of the top rangers in the Realm, until a
pack of wild boars nearly ended his life.  Deciding to change professions
before something worse happened, he took his gathered wealth and opened a
string of outdoor-gear shops.

long_desc: A dirty rat pokes about the streets looking for food.
description:
Yuck!  This rat is looks bad, even for a rat!  I wouldn't let it bite me if I
were you, who knows what diseases it is carrying about.

long_desc: A shabby beggar sits here and looks at you expectantly.
description:
This beggar looks pretty shabby.  His clothes are torn and he smells like he
hasn't bathed in months.  He looks up from where he is sitting and hopes you
toss him a few coins.

long_desc: Jeeves, the Royal Butler, stands at attention here.
description:
Jeeves, the butler of the Royal family, stands at attention here.  If you need
anything at all, he will get it for you.

long_desc: Sarah, the ghoul chef, wonders why you are in her kitchen.
description:
Before you stands Sarah, the famous chef of the ghoul Royal family.  She runs
the small kitchen of the hideaway, for it allows her the chance to dedicate
herself to taking care of the few people who come here.

long_desc: The Warrior Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Fargo, the local real estate agent, smiles at you.
description:
Fargo moved to Alden when it was quite small, and purchased most of the
surrounding land.  He can sell you various deeds to plots of land, where you
can have your own residence constructed, for a fee of course.

long_desc: Joyce stands by the bar, cleaning some mugs.
description:
Joyce is the owner and barmistress of The Nightgaunt's Tickler, a popular
tavern in Alden.  She had it built when she realized that for all the
people who came to the city, there originally wasn't anywhere to find food and
drink.  Knowing the large profits to be made, the Tickler was put up in record
time.

long_desc: Thornton travels about, offering his banking services.
description:
Thornton had always wanted to work for the First Bank of Alden, but
hated the idea of sitting around in a bank all day long.  He now travels the
realms, offering his services to all who can track him down.  He has an
agreement to work with the First Bank of Alden only, and he keeps in
contact with Carlyle with a special spell they crafted.

long_desc: An old warrior travels about the realms.
description:
Malaclypse, the great human warrior, travels about the realms looking for
adventure.  You were raised on tales of his awesome battles with mystical
beings.  Perhaps one day you will be as famous as he is!

long_desc: Thalen, the portalmaster, stands quietly.
description:
Thalen stands quietly, concentrating on the portal, and helping shape its
mysterious transport magic.

long_desc: The Monk Guildmaster bows as you enter.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Thug Guildmaster sneers back at you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A masked hunter looks about, checking for the tracks of a killer.
description:
Wearing a black hood and mask, this must be one of the famous Alden
assassins.  Hired by Drazuk to hunt down the killers who prey upon the weak,
they are very deadly.  No target of theirs has lived very long to tell the
tale of meeting one in combat.

long_desc: Samuel, the repairsmith, polishes up an old bit of armor.
description:
Samuel wipes an oiled rag over a spot on some plate mail, buffing out the
scratch it gained in some sort of battle.  He looks up as you enter.  "Ahh,
messing with dragons again?  I can make that armor look as good as new!"

long_desc: Lilyan specializes in recharging magical items.
description:
Lilyan carefully studies a long oaken wand.  Running a finger along one side
slowly, she finally smiles and places it on the counter.  "Is there anything I
can help you with?" she asks you.

long_desc: A scaly man with a tail tends to the bar.
description:
What appears to be half man, half dragon, stands here in a tuxedo (with a hole
for his tail at the back).  Serving drinks to his guests, LIST what kind of
drink you want.

long_desc: A redhaired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and flaming red hair, you recognize this woman as Tressa,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: Hmm...you thought you saw something, but its gone now...
description:
There it is again...strange, like maybe just the edge of a shadow moved.  How
bizarre...you must be imagining things.

long_desc: Hey...you shouldn't be able to see Yoyoman!
description: This is bad...you should not be able to see Yoyoman!

long_desc: A scrawny rat with strangely glowing teeth squeaks at you!
description:
This squeaky rat has teeth that glow a brilliant blue...they look awfully
sharp also!  Maybe you should leave him alone...

long_desc: A succubus ransomed by Vash packs a pipe of opium hash with long thin fingers.
description:
This succubus was purchased by Vash on one of the many misadventures he has
undertaken into the demon homeland to rid himself of his addiction to magic.
She dresses herself in tight scarlet robes which stretch tightly over her kohl
skin.  Her breasts are small but firm and her clothing does little to hide it,
her stomach is flat and also exposed in a long flawless swoop towards her
hips, which swell gently and subtly from her frame and seem to accentuate her
long and shapely legs. She eyes everyone who looks at her in the hopes that
maybe they will not remember that she feeds upon sex. A small piece of
spidersilk is knotted carefully around her ankle in gossamer webwork that is
almost lace. She is a fearsome demon, and this is the only chain which can
hold her to her service.

long_desc: The Diabolist Guildmaster stares intently at you.
description:
A darkly robed figure watches you closely, a small grinning imp perched on his
shoulder.  A leather-bound book hangs at his side from a platinum chain, its
surface covered in demonic runes.

long_desc: The grand artificer Vorthan bows as you approach.
description:
Famous for his creation of powerful artifacts for the court of Drazuk, Vorthan
now makes his living buying those artifacts that adventurers find are no
longer useful to them.

long_desc: Look!  It's Testboy!
description: This is Testboy.

long_desc: A curly haired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and curly blond hair, you recognize this woman as Sara,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A muscular woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and solid muscles, you recognize this woman as Amy,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A beautiful, pale skinned woman stands here holding a silver tray.
description:
This beautiful young woman, about five and a half feet in height, stands
dressed in a tight, black gown that sweeps the marble floor as she walks.
Her long, slightly curled black hair falls just below her shoulders, a few
bangs draping over her onyx black eyes.  Thin straps hold her dress on her
petite body, the front showing a decent amount of her milky white skin, the
back dipping down to just above her waist.  On her outstretched hands she
holds a thin silver tray, offering you glasses of an unfamiliar red liquid.  A
small amulet hangs from her neck, a beautiful ruby surrounded by smaller
diamonds attached to a silver chain.  Following the band up the side of her
neck, you see what appears to be two small puncture wounds on the side of her
throat.  Full, pouty lips cover two longer-than-average teeth, which you
notice as she flashes you a mischievous smile, catching your gaze upon her.

long_desc: The Jester Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A small ugly man in a dark cloak grins back at you.
description:
Grimwald is the local undertaker of Alden.  He does a dirty job that
noone else wanted, but it is important none the less.  For a fee, he can
recover the corpses of the younger, less-deadly adventurers.

long_desc: The Shaman Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Talesha, the transporter for Alden, smiles as you arrive.
description:
Master of the arts of transport, Talesha figured she could make a killing
transporting those to lazy to make the long treks across the realm.  For a
price, she can sell you a ticket that will take you to various locations
around the realm.

long_desc: This spirit helps contain the powers of the transportal.
description: This glowing spirit is necessary to ensure that the transportal works properly.

description:

strange voice.  "Leave now or be destroyed."

think its on some sort of vacation!  It glances at you and giggles, and
attempts to run away.  Hey!  Maybe if you can catch it, it will have some sort
of gift!

description: Placeholder

long_desc: Jerald, the lowly Pitboy, sits here and puts donated items in the pit.
description:
Jerald is a big-time loser.  Unable to do anything worthwhile, he now spends
all his time in the temple, just making sure items that get donated end up in
the pit.

long_desc: Joey, the Questmaster of Alden, smiles at you.
description:
Good ol' Joey, Drazuk liked him so much, he gave him a job as the Questmaster
of Alden.  Use the command "AQUEST" to see what he can do for you.  "If
you are curious about what my items might do for you, ask me about them, and
I'll share the tales."  Tell or say to Joey the exact name of the item in the
list to hear his tales.

long_desc: Kallista, the Healer of the Temple smiles at you.
description:
The Healer of the Temple of Drazuk, Kallista smiles at you.  An
extraordinarily gorgeous ghoul, she has studied many years under the Tutors of
Knowledge, and has gained great powers of healing.  "Use the command "heal" to
see what I can offer you," she says in a musical voice.

long_desc: Carlyle, the teller of the bank, counts piles of coins.
description:
Carlyle learned how to manage money at a young age, when he was the accountant
for the local Thieves Guild.  He was arrested and spent some time in Drazuk's
hellish prison, before repenting and promising to respect the material wealth
of others.

long_desc: Khent, the weaponsmith, stares at you with dull eyes.
description:
Before you stands Khent, the mighty warrior, who's strength in battle only
just barely surpasses his stupidity.  Tales have been told about how he was
born with much muscle, but no brains.  He stares at you dully, waiting for you
to buy something.

long_desc: Franklin watches you closely, making sure you don't steal anything.
description:
A short and dark man, Franklin used to be the quartermaster for the local
Thieves Guild, until he had made enough money to open his own shop.  Now,
sanctioned by the Guild, he sells items to the thieves of the Realm.  Whatever
you need, if he doesn't have it, he can probably find it for you.

long_desc: Garth, the armorer, stops pounding at plate armor and looks up at you.
description:
A mountain of a man, Garth is famous for his protective gear.  From the
supplest leather armor to the stoutest steel plate, he creates and sells some
wonderful armor.

long_desc: Kar'tanth the Sorcerer looks up from his book as you enter.
description:
Shrouded in dark robes, Kar'tanth used to be the Master Mage of the Ghoul
Kingdom.  He stepped down from the position when Drazuk offered him the chance
to run a store of magic in Alden.  Now he provides adventurers with the
magical tools of their trade.

long_desc: A cityguard of Alden keeps the peace around here.
description:
Being a cityguard of Alden is a thankless profession.  Attempting to
keep the peace in a land of monsters and adventurers is a tough job, and the
turnover rate in Alden is extremely high.  The pay is good however, and
they get some pretty nice armor.

long_desc: Mistress Leah smiles at you, and shows you around her shop.
description:
Once a mighty cleric, Mistress Leah put down her mace and holy symbol, and
picked up fine cloth and needle, and now designs wonderful clothes for the
female adventurer who isn't currently battling dragons.  She knows that
sometimes armor and travel-stained cloaks aren't appropriate for certain
situations, so she's here to fill that gap.  Leah tells you, "We base our line
on a basic pattern.  Just ask an Immortal and they can customize the look to
your preferences."

long_desc: Joseph the Tailor bows, and offers to show you around the shop.
description:
When Joseph moved to Alden, the first thing he noticed was that
adventurers tended to wear the same battered and bloody armor to parties and
dinners that they would wear to fight orcs.  He knew that the problem was the
lack of fine outfits, so he opened his own store to serve the needs of the
more refined adventurer.  Joseph mentions to you, "Although everything you see
comes from a basic pattern, talk to an Immortal and they can help you
customize your clothing to fit your own special look."

long_desc: Ranger Richard looks up as you enter, nods, then goes back to his book.
description:
Richard the Ranger used to be one of the top rangers in the Realm, until a
pack of wild boars nearly ended his life.  Deciding to change professions
before something worse happened, he took his gathered wealth and opened a
string of outdoor-gear shops.

long_desc: A dirty rat pokes about the streets looking for food.
description:
Yuck!  This rat is looks bad, even for a rat!  I wouldn't let it bite me if I
were you, who knows what diseases it is carrying about.

description:
This beggar looks pretty shabby.  His clothes are torn and he smells like he
hasn't bathed in months.  He looks up from where he is sitting and hopes you
toss him a few coins.

long_desc: Jeeves, the Royal Butler, stands at attention here.
description:
Jeeves, the butler of the Royal family, stands at attention here.  If you need
anything at all, he will get it for you.

long_desc: Sarah, the ghoul chef, wonders why you are in her kitchen.
description:
Before you stands Sarah, the famous chef of the ghoul Royal family.  She runs
the small kitchen of the hideaway, for it allows her the chance to dedicate
herself to taking care of the few people who come here.

long_desc: The Warrior Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

description:

surrounding land.  He can sell you various deeds to plots of land, where you
can have your own residence constructed, for a fee of course.

long_desc: Joyce stands by the bar, cleaning some mugs.
description:
Joyce is the owner and barmistress of The Nightgaunt's Tickler, a popular
tavern in Alden.  She had it built when she realized that for all the
people who came to the city, there originally wasn't anywhere to find food and
drink.  Knowing the large profits to be made, the Tickler was put up in record
time.

long_desc: Thornton travels about, offering his banking services.
description:
Thornton had always wanted to work for the First Bank of Alden, but
hated the idea of sitting around in a bank all day long.  He now travels the
realms, offering his services to all who can track him down.  He has an
agreement to work with the First Bank of Alden only, and he keeps in
contact with Carlyle with a special spell they crafted.

long_desc: An old warrior travels about the realms.
description:
Malaclypse, the great human warrior, travels about the realms looking for
adventure.  You were raised on tales of his awesome battles with mystical
beings.  Perhaps one day you will be as famous as he is!

long_desc: Thalen, the portalmaster, stands quietly.
description:
Thalen stands quietly, concentrating on the portal, and helping shape its
mysterious transport magic.

long_desc: The Monk Guildmaster bows as you enter.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Thug Guildmaster sneers back at you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A masked hunter looks about, checking for the tracks of a killer.
description:
Wearing a black hood and mask, this must be one of the famous Alden
assassins.  Hired by Drazuk to hunt down the killers who prey upon the weak,
they are very deadly.  No target of theirs has lived very long to tell the
tale of meeting one in combat.

long_desc: Samuel, the repairsmith, polishes up an old bit of armor.
description:
Samuel wipes an oiled rag over a spot on some plate mail, buffing out the
scratch it gained in some sort of battle.  He looks up as you enter.  "Ahh,
messing with dragons again?  I can make that armor look as good as new!"

long_desc: Lilyan specializes in recharging magical items.
description:
Lilyan carefully studies a long oaken wand.  Running a finger along one side
slowly, she finally smiles and places it on the counter.  "Is there anything I
can help you with?" she asks you.

long_desc: A scaly man with a tail tends to the bar.
description:
What appears to be half man, half dragon, stands here in a tuxedo (with a hole
for his tail at the back).  Serving drinks to his guests, LIST what kind of
drink you want.

long_desc: A redhaired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and flaming red hair, you recognize this woman as Tressa,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: Hmm...you thought you saw something, but its gone now...
description:
There it is again...strange, like maybe just the edge of a shadow moved.  How
bizarre...you must be imagining things.

long_desc: Hey...you shouldn't be able to see Yoyoman!
description: This is bad...you should not be able to see Yoyoman!

long_desc: A scrawny rat with strangely glowing teeth squeaks at you!
description:
This squeaky rat has teeth that glow a brilliant blue...they look awfully
sharp also!  Maybe you should leave him alone...

long_desc: A succubus ransomed by Vash packs a pipe of opium hash with long thin fingers.
description:
This succubus was purchased by Vash on one of the many misadventures he has
undertaken into the demon homeland to rid himself of his addiction to magic.
She dresses herself in tight scarlet robes which stretch tightly over her kohl
skin.  Her breasts are small but firm and her clothing does little to hide it,
her stomach is flat and also exposed in a long flawless swoop towards her
hips, which swell gently and subtly from her frame and seem to accentuate her
long and shapely legs. She eyes everyone who looks at her in the hopes that
maybe they will not remember that she feeds upon sex. A small piece of
spidersilk is knotted carefully around her ankle in gossamer webwork that is
almost lace. She is a fearsome demon, and this is the only chain which can
hold her to her service.

long_desc: The Diabolist Guildmaster stares intently at you.
description:
A darkly robed figure watches you closely, a small grinning imp perched on his
shoulder.  A leather-bound book hangs at his side from a platinum chain, its
surface covered in demonic runes.

long_desc: The grand artificer Vorthan bows as you approach.
description:
Famous for his creation of powerful artifacts for the court of Drazuk, Vorthan
now makes his living buying those artifacts that adventurers find are no
longer useful to them.

long_desc: Look!  It's Testboy!
description: This is Testboy.

long_desc: A curly haired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and curly blond hair, you recognize this woman as Sara,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A muscular woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and solid muscles, you recognize this woman as Amy,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A beautiful, pale skinned woman stands here holding a silver tray.
description:
This beautiful young woman, about five and a half feet in height, stands
dressed in a tight, black gown that sweeps the marble floor as she walks.
Her long, slightly curled black hair falls just below her shoulders, a few
bangs draping over her onyx black eyes.  Thin straps hold her dress on her
petite body, the front showing a decent amount of her milky white skin, the
back dipping down to just above her waist.  On her outstretched hands she
holds a thin silver tray, offering you glasses of an unfamiliar red liquid.  A
small amulet hangs from her neck, a beautiful ruby surrounded by smaller
diamonds attached to a silver chain.  Following the band up the side of her
neck, you see what appears to be two small puncture wounds on the side of her
throat.  Full, pouty lips cover two longer-than-average teeth, which you
notice as she flashes you a mischievous smile, catching your gaze upon her.

long_desc: The Jester Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A small ugly man in a dark cloak grins back at you.
description:
Grimwald is the local undertaker of Alden.  He does a dirty job that
noone else wanted, but it is important none the less.  For a fee, he can
recover the corpses of the younger, less-deadly adventurers.

long_desc: The Shaman Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Conjurer Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Talesha, the transporter for Alden, smiles as you arrive.
description:
Master of the arts of transport, Talesha figured she could make a killing
transporting those to lazy to make the long treks across the realm.  For a
price, she can sell you a ticket that will take you to various locations
around the realm.

long_desc: This spirit helps contain the powers of the transportal.
description: This glowing spirit is necessary to ensure that the transportal works properly.

short_desc: the Spirit of the Black Sable Dragon
long_desc: A mass of shadow lurks within the room.
description:
A mass of shadow lurks within the room. Suddenly your mind is filled with a
strange voice.  "Leave now or be destroyed."

long_desc: A fat wild turkey shivers and shakes, hoping you aren't going to slice its neck!
description:
This wild turkey looks plump and juicy.  It backs up slowly, wondering if you
are hiding a hatchet in your hands.  It looks left and right, hoping to find
some way of escape...

description: Placeholder

long_desc: Jerald, the lowly Pitboy, sits here and puts donated items in the pit.
description:
Jerald is a big-time loser.  Unable to do anything worthwhile, he now spends
all his time in the temple, just making sure items that get donated end up in
the pit.

long_desc: Joey, the Questmaster of Alden, smiles at you.
description:
Good ol' Joey, Drazuk liked him so much, he gave him a job as the Questmaster
of Alden.  Use the command "AQUEST" to see what he can do for you.  "If
you are curious about what my items might do for you, ask me about them, and
I'll share the tales."  Tell or say to Joey the exact name of the item in the
list to hear his tales.

long_desc: Kallista, the Healer of the Temple smiles at you.
description:
The Healer of the Temple of Drazuk, Kallista smiles at you.  An
extraordinarily gorgeous ghoul, she has studied many years under the Tutors of
Knowledge, and has gained great powers of healing.  "Use the command "heal" to
see what I can offer you," she says in a musical voice.

long_desc: Carlyle, the teller of the bank, counts piles of coins.
description:
Carlyle learned how to manage money at a young age, when he was the accountant
for the local Thieves Guild.  He was arrested and spent some time in Drazuk's
hellish prison, before repenting and promising to respect the material wealth
of others.

long_desc: Khent, the weaponsmith, stares at you with dull eyes.
description:
Before you stands Khent, the mighty warrior, who's strength in battle only
just barely surpasses his stupidity.  Tales have been told about how he was
born with much muscle, but no brains.  He stares at you dully, waiting for you
to buy something.

long_desc: Franklin watches you closely, making sure you don't steal anything.
description:
A short and dark man, Franklin used to be the quartermaster for the local
Thieves Guild, until he had made enough money to open his own shop.  Now,
sanctioned by the Guild, he sells items to the thieves of the Realm.  Whatever
you need, if he doesn't have it, he can probably find it for you.

long_desc: Garth, the armorer, stops pounding at plate armor and looks up at you.
description:
A mountain of a man, Garth is famous for his protective gear.  From the
supplest leather armor to the stoutest steel plate, he creates and sells some
wonderful armor.

long_desc: Kar'tanth the Sorcerer looks up from his book as you enter.
description:
Shrouded in dark robes, Kar'tanth used to be the Master Mage of the Ghoul
Kingdom.  He stepped down from the position when Drazuk offered him the chance
to run a store of magic in Alden.  Now he provides adventurers with the
magical tools of their trade.

long_desc: A cityguard of Alden keeps the peace in the city streets.
description:
Being a cityguard of Alden is a thankless profession.  Attempting to
keep the peace in a land of monsters and adventurers is a tough job, and the
turnover rate in Alden is extremely high.  The pay is good however, and
they get some pretty nice armor.

long_desc: A small scruffy dog searches the streets for bits of food.
description:
This small ugly dog searches about the streets for food.  It is dirty and
skinny.  It looks up at you and barks, hoping you might hand it a bit of
something to eat.

long_desc: A small scruffy dog searches the streets for bits of food.
description:
This small ugly dog searches about the streets for food.  It is dirty and
skinny.  It looks up at you and barks, hoping you might hand it a bit of

long_desc: A mangy mutt wanders the city looking for garbage to eat.
description:
This dog's fur is all matted and has all kinds of bits of garbage tangled up
in it. It limps around as it walks, sniffing everything as it goes.

long_desc: A mangy mutt wanders the city looking for garbage to eat.
description:
This dog's fur is all matted and has all kinds of bits of garbage tangled up
in it. It limps around as it walks, sniffing everything as it goes.

long_desc: A Alden janitor attempts to keep the streets clean.
description:
A member of the Janitors Guild of Alden, this man strives to keep the
streets clean of debris.  He has a hard time, since adventurers always seem to
be leaving bits of armor and weapons lying around.  He grumbles as he pushes
his broom along.

Dressed for adventuring, this young female dwarf smiles at you as your walk
past her.  She has the tough look that most dwarves have, and her axe has many
notches in its handle.  She has probably slain quite a few monsters in her
time.

This elven mage stares at you haughtily.  He is dressed in robes covered with
arcane runes.  You notice that his feet don't touch the ground; obviously the
effect of some spell he has cast on himself.

This citizen goes about her normal business.  Perhaps she is shopping, perhaps
running an errand.  All she cares about is getting her work done, and then
heading home.

long_desc: Mistress Leah smiles at you, and shows you around her shop.
description:
Once a mighty cleric, Mistress Leah put down her mace and holy symbol, and
picked up fine cloth and needle, and now designs wonderful clothes for the
female adventurer who isn't currently battling dragons.  She knows that
sometimes armor and travel-stained cloaks aren't appropriate for certain
situations, so she's here to fill that gap.  Leah tells you, "We base our line
on a basic pattern.  Just ask an Immortal and they can customize the look to
your preferences."

long_desc: Joseph the Tailor bows, and offers to show you around the shop.
description:
When Joseph moved to Alden, the first thing he noticed was that
adventurers tended to wear the same battered and bloody armor to parties and
dinners that they would wear to fight orcs.  He knew that the problem was the
lack of fine outfits, so he opened his own store to serve the needs of the
more refined adventurer.  Joseph mentions to you, "Although everything you see
comes from a basic pattern, talk to an Immortal and they can help you
customize your clothing to fit your own special look."

long_desc: Ranger Richard looks up as you enter, nods, then goes back to his book.
description:
Richard the Ranger used to be one of the top rangers in the Realm, until a
pack of wild boars nearly ended his life.  Deciding to change professions
before something worse happened, he took his gathered wealth and opened a
string of outdoor-gear shops.

long_desc: A dirty rat pokes about the streets looking for food.
description:
Yuck!  This rat is looks bad, even for a rat!  I wouldn't let it bite me if I
were you, who knows what diseases it is carrying about.

long_desc: A shabby beggar sits here and looks at you expectantly.
description:
This beggar looks pretty shabby.  His clothes are torn and he smells like he
hasn't bathed in months.  He looks up from where he is sitting and hopes you
toss him a few coins.

long_desc: Jeeves, the Royal Butler, stands at attention here.
description:
Jeeves, the butler of the Royal family, stands at attention here.  If you need
anything at all, he will get it for you.

long_desc: Sarah, the ghoul chef, wonders why you are in her kitchen.
description:
Before you stands Sarah, the famous chef of the ghoul Royal family.  She runs
the small kitchen of the hideaway, for it allows her the chance to dedicate
herself to taking care of the few people who come here.

long_desc: The Warrior Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Fargo, the local real estate agent, smiles at you.
description:
Fargo moved to Alden when it was quite small, and purchased most of the
surrounding land.  He can sell you various deeds to plots of land, where you
can have your own residence constructed, for a fee of course.

long_desc: Joyce stands by the bar, cleaning some mugs.
description:
Joyce is the owner and barmistress of The Nightgaunt's Tickler, a popular
tavern in Alden.  She had it built when she realized that for all the
people who came to the city, there originally wasn't anywhere to find food and
drink.  Knowing the large profits to be made, the Tickler was put up in record
time.

long_desc: Thornton travels about, offering his banking services.
description:
Thornton had always wanted to work for the First Bank of Alden, but
hated the idea of sitting around in a bank all day long.  He now travels the
realms, offering his services to all who can track him down.  He has an
agreement to work with the First Bank of Alden only, and he keeps in
contact with Carlyle with a special spell they crafted.

long_desc: An old warrior travels about the realms.
description:
Malaclypse, the great human warrior, travels about the realms looking for
adventure.  You were raised on tales of his awesome battles with mystical
beings.  Perhaps one day you will be as famous as he is!

long_desc: Thalen, the portalmaster, stands quietly.
description:
Thalen stands quietly, concentrating on the portal, and helping shape its
mysterious transport magic.

long_desc: The Monk Guildmaster bows as you enter.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Thug Guildmaster sneers back at you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A masked hunter looks about, checking for the tracks of a killer.
description:
Wearing a black hood and mask, this must be one of the famous Alden
assassins.  Hired by Drazuk to hunt down the killers who prey upon the weak,
they are very deadly.  No target of theirs has lived very long to tell the
tale of meeting one in combat.

long_desc: Samuel, the repairsmith, polishes up an old bit of armor.
description:
Samuel wipes an oiled rag over a spot on some plate mail, buffing out the
scratch it gained in some sort of battle.  He looks up as you enter.  "Ahh,
messing with dragons again?  I can make that armor look as good as new!"

long_desc: Lilyan specializes in recharging magical items.
description:
Lilyan carefully studies a long oaken wand.  Running a finger along one side
slowly, she finally smiles and places it on the counter.  "Is there anything I
can help you with?" she asks you.

long_desc: A scaly man with a tail tends to the bar.
description:
What appears to be half man, half dragon, stands here in a tuxedo (with a hole
for his tail at the back).  Serving drinks to his guests, LIST what kind of
drink you want.

long_desc: A redhaired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and flaming red hair, you recognize this woman as Tressa,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: Hmm...you thought you saw something, but it's gone now...
description:
There it is again...strange, like maybe just the edge of a shadow moved.  How
bizarre...you must be imagining things.

long_desc: Hey...you shouldn't be able to see Yoyoman!
description: This is bad...you should not be able to see Yoyoman!

long_desc: A scrawny rat with strangely glowing teeth squeaks at you!
description:
This squeaky rat has teeth that glow a brilliant blue...they look awfully
sharp also!  Maybe you should leave him alone...

long_desc: The Diabolist Guildmaster stares intently at you.
description:
A darkly robed figure watches you closely, a small grinning imp perched on his
shoulder.  A leather-bound book hangs at his side from a platinum chain, its
surface covered in demonic runes.

long_desc: The grand artificer Vorthan bows as you approach.
description:
Famous for his creation of powerful artifacts for the court of Drazuk, Vorthan
now makes his living buying those artifacts that adventurers find are no
longer useful to them.

long_desc: Look!  It's Testboy!
description: This is Testboy.

long_desc: A curly haired woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and curly blond hair, you recognize this woman as Sara,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A muscular woman, bearing the mark of the Battle Sisters, walks the path.
description:
By the special mark, and solid muscles, you recognize this woman as Amy,
a member of the Battlesisters, a group of female adventurers who serve the
Gods of Good.  She nods at you, but is obviously headed somewhere, and has no
time to chat.

long_desc: A beautiful, pale skinned woman stands here holding a silver tray.
description:
This beautiful young woman, about five and a half feet in height, stands
dressed in a tight, black gown that sweeps the marble floor as she walks.
Her long, slightly curled black hair falls just below her shoulders, a few
bangs draping over her onyx black eyes.  Thin straps hold her dress on her
petite body, the front showing a decent amount of her milky white skin, the
back dipping down to just above her waist.  On her outstretched hands she
holds a thin silver tray, offering you glasses of an unfamiliar red liquid.  A
small amulet hangs from her neck, a beautiful ruby surrounded by smaller
diamonds attached to a silver chain.  Following the band up the side of her
neck, you see what appears to be two small puncture wounds on the side of her
throat.  Full, pouty lips cover two longer-than-average teeth, which you
notice as she flashes you a mischievous smile, catching your gaze upon her.

long_desc: The Jester Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: A small ugly man in a dark cloak grins back at you.
description:
Grimwald is the local undertaker of Alden.  He does a dirty job that
noone else wanted, but it is important none the less.  For a fee, he can
recover the corpses of adventurers.

long_desc: The Shaman Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:
This individual must be mighty indeed to have risen to the top of the guild.
They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: The Conjurer Guildmaster stands tall before you.
description:

They are here to help you practice your skills.  If you practice hard enough,
perhaps one day you too can be the top of your Guild!

long_desc: Talesha, the transporter for Alden, smiles as you arrive.
description:
Master of the arts of transport, Talesha figured she could make a killing
transporting those to lazy to make the long treks across the realm.  For a
price, she can sell you a ticket that will take you to various locations
around the realm.

long_desc: This spirit helps contain the powers of the transportal.
description: This glowing spirit is necessary to ensure that the transportal works properly.

long_desc: A beautiful house maid stands here.
description:
The most beautiful woman ever seen, except for perhaps the
Goddesses themselves, stands here, clad in silk from head to
toe.  Just gazing at her has led many men to envy. After being
rescued from horrible ogres by Soloman, she now waits on him
with gratitude. Not a servant this one but a volunteer, she readily
assists in anyway she can, selling numerous supplies bought from
town and cleaning the quarters for her hero.

long_desc: Petro is cleaning up a few small messes.
description:
Never resting for a moment, Petro is always on his toes watching over and
caring for the various animals he houses in his shop. He is usually seen,
with a few rags and a pale of water, cleaning up various messes left behind
by an animal or two.

long_desc: A battle wolf looks for his master.
description:
Domesticated over the course of time, this vicious animal has become a loyal
pet worthy companion to many adventurers.

long_desc: A large griffon awaits its master's commands.
description:
Part lion, part eagle, this fierce hunter will stop at nothing to get to its
prey. Bound to its master by a magical force, this beast and its master are
a pair not to be taken lightly.

long_desc: A large black steed awaits its master's command.
description:
At first glance, appears to be nothing more than a handsome black steed, but
upon closer examination the burning hooves, glowing back eyes, flaming
nostrils and fiery mane of the nightmare become obvious.

long_desc: A small rodent squeeks its way around its master.
description:
It's a very common rodent to find in city streets. There is no doubt why these
rats make good pets for new adventurers.

long_desc: A long-eared pack animal awaits his master's command.
description:
With his large dark-brown eyes, long ears and strong back, this 'beast' makes
a fine pack animal and companion on long travels. However, because of his
loud mouth, we thank the Gods he cannot speak.

long_desc: A small dragon awaits its master's command.
description:
Raised from birth by Petro, these minature dragons have been bred to aid
adventurers and will gain great power as it grows. However, it is not likely
to exceed the average size of a horse. They make great adventuring companions.

long_desc: This strange creature is dressed in zipper-covered leathers.
description: Muahaha!

long_desc: A lion awaits his master's command.
description:
Raised from a cub by Petro, this lion will risk his own life to save his
master's life.

long_desc: A small newt looks for a cool place to rest.
description:
This small amphibian has somehow been trained to obey commands. They may not
make good combat partners but they do make for good pets and travelling
companions.

description: Placeholder

long_desc: A small fish swims about the caves.
description:
This small fish seems to be lost.  It swims about the caves, sometimes
nibbling at the strange glowing algae growing on the walls.

long_desc: A small fish swims about the caves.
description:
This small fish seems to be lost.  It swims about the caves, sometimes
nibbling at the strange glowing algae growing on the walls.

long_desc: A male sea-elf swims about the town.
description:
This young sea-elf swims about the town.  He looks at you curiously, wondering
how you manage not to drown, or how you swim without webbed hands and feet.

long_desc: The King of the Sea Elves watches you closely.
description:
This large sea-elf has a coral crown perched on his head, marking him as the
King of their kind.  He paces about his great hall, pondering the issues that
affect the sea-elves.

long_desc: Koren, the sea-elf armorer, works with some scales.
description:
Koren has mastered the art of crafting armor from the supple scales of the sea
dragon.  He is now too old to collect the scales himself, but there is no
shortage of sea-elf warriors who wish to prove themselves against such a
beast.

long_desc: Taklaugh chips away at a large piece of obsidian.
description:
The sea-elf weaponsmith, Taklaugh, works diligently at chipping a sharp edge
into a large piece of obsidian rock.  His non-metal weapons are famous
throughout the realms.

long_desc: The storemaid, Terlissan, looks up from her stitching at you.
description:
Terlissan sews away at a large scrap of fishskin, crafted the supple leather
into a fine pouch.  She looks at you expectantly, hoping you buy some of her
items.

long_desc: Jenrath moves about the room, keeping an eye on her chemicals.
description:
Jenrath moves about the various concoctions in her laboratory.  She lowers the
heat on one, and adds some reagents to another.  She finally notices you
watching her, and approaches you.

long_desc: A female sea-elf guard patrols this area.
description:
A young sea-elf guard swims by you, her seadragon scale armor glimmering in
the strange light.  She watches you closely, hoping you aren't here to cause
trouble.

long_desc: A female sea-elf guard patrols this area.
description:
A young sea-elf guard swims by you, her seadragon scale armor glimmering in
the strange light.  She watches you closely, hoping you aren't here to cause

long_desc: A male sea-elf guard stands watch here.
description:
This young sea-elf stands guard in the temple.  His seadragon armor shines
under the strange lights.  He watches you closely, not happy with your
intrusion of the temple.

long_desc: A female sea-elf guard stands watch here.
description:

long_desc: A huge serpent, covered with fins and shiny scales blows bubbles at you!
description:
You stare back at a huge silvery serpent.  It watches you with large yellow
eyes, and slowly blows tiny bubbles through its thin snout.  The faint light
in this cavern shimmers off of the dragon's silvery scales.

long_desc: A tall sea-elf mage walks slowly down the path.
description:
From the power emanating from this magnificent sea-elf, you know it can only
by Kalter Coralbrow.  Many stories have you heard late at night about his
adventures under the blue sea, and the strange creatures he has fought and
befriended.

long_desc: A lifeguard is in a chair overlooking all pool activities.
description: The lifeguard is here to make sure noone drowns and tries to sue Bouddica.

long_desc: A tall daemon servant is busy behind the round bar.
description:
A tall daemon stands behind the bar....his four arms can surely mix and sling
drinks like no other!

description: Placeholder

long_desc: A large, whiskered fish swims past.
description:
This fish would make a tasty meal. It must way a good 10 kgs and it looks like
it is all good meat. It has an odd set of whisker like feelers at the sides of
its face.

description:
This odd creature seems to made entirely of tissue and jelly.  It seems
harmless enough until you realize that most of it is underwater and out of
sight. You also notice the multiple stingers that are starting to make their
way towards you.

description:
This bird seems to be far too fat to fly.  It's wings are small but it's belly
is nice and large. It's legs look good for frying as well. It doesn't seem to
mind your presence too much.

description:
This is a pretty big rat. It must weight at least 5kgs and looks pretty tough
as far as rats go. It seems to be well-fed, probably eating the eggs of the
dodo's and whatever small fish it can catch in the warm waters.

description:
By the fine quality and exquisite design of this nomad's robes, you deduce he
must be the leader of this small tribe.  His dark eyes watch you from under
the wraps of cloth.

long_desc: A tall nomad walks about the camp.
description:
Wrapped in the clothes and robes of the desert people, this tall nomad stalks
about the camp, gathering water and food for his journey through the desert.

long_desc: A tall man, dressed in desert garb, looks you over as you approach.
description:
This man is formidable indeed...all you can see is his eyes peeking out of a
desert cowl.  Dressed and robed in the style of the Talon nomads, he has
various pouches and bags hanging from his waist, right next to the large
scimitar.  Upon sighting the large blade, you notice the strange green gem in
the hilt, and all those tavern tales come rushing back to you....this is
Darrel Zel'hir, Master Nomad of the East, and is not to be trifled with.

long_desc: A lonely spirit floats through the trees.
description:
A dreary looking spirit floats through the trees.  It does not pay any
attention to you.  One of the gravesites scattered about must be its home.

long_desc: The wailing and moaning of this spirit is quite unnerving.
description:
This spirit floats about, wailing and moaning.  The sound is a little spooky,
and makes you feel a deep sense of sadness.

long_desc: A ghost floats about above a grim corpse.
description:
This ghost must belong to the corpse lying on the ground here.  It watches you
closely...perhaps it wishes you to release it from this unlife.

long_desc: This squirrel leaps for your throat!
description:
Oh no!  This squirrel has flaming red eyes and a snarly, foaming mouth!  It
leaps for you, hoping to take you with it into madness!

long_desc: A bandit scout leaps from his hiding spot!
description:
This scout is dressed in forest colored leathers.  You barely have time to
ready yourself before he leaps out of the woods at you!

long_desc: A bandit scout leaps from her hiding spot!
description:
This scout is dressed in forest colored leathers.  You barely have time to
ready yourself before she leaps out of the woods at you!

long_desc: A snarling badger protects her territory by attacking you!
description:
You don't know if there is a den nearby or what, but something has this badger
in a pretty aggressive mood!  Whatever the problem is, you better fight for
your life!

long_desc: This dragon is very upset that you disturbed him!
description:
Not used to having dinner come to him, the dragon is more than happy to end
your life for you!  He even likes your armor...crunchy on the outside, chewy
in the middle!

long_desc: A wise old barn owl looks at you with disinterested eyes.
description:
This large owl stares down at you from his perch with a look of complete
disinterest.  He preens his feathers a bit, but is always watching you, to
make sure you behave.

long_desc: A scruffy bandit looks up and wonders why you are here.
description:
This bandit looks like he has spent one to many days sleeping in the woods.
His rough leathers are scratched and torn from the briars.  He watches you
closely, wondering if your goods are worth the trouble to kill you.

long_desc: A scruffy bandit looks up and wonders why you are here.
description:
This bandit looks like she has spent one to many days sleeping in the woods.
Her rough leathers are scratched and torn from the briars.  She watches you
closely, wondering if your goods are worth the trouble to kill you.

long_desc: A haughty looking bandit stands and stares at you.
description:
This bandit has a slightly better looking appearance, so you assume he is the
leader.  He stares back at you, wondering if he should call over his band to
help relieve you of your valuables.

long_desc: A large gray wolf resents your intrusion!
description: This wolf is very protective of its den, as you are quickly discovering!

long_desc: A snarling dog snaps at you!
description:
This medium-sized dog has a large spiked collar around his neck.  It would
make it look quite vicious, but its teeth and claw already do that.

long_desc: This woman leaps to protect her family from you!
description:
Don't let the dress fool you, this woman knows you are an intruder and leaps
up to protect the rest of her family from you!

long_desc: A gypsy man draws his dagger to protect the caravan!
description:
This gypsy turns from chatting with his buddies, spies you, snarls, draws a
dagger, and leaps for your throat!

long_desc: A swirl of silks mesmerizes you as this dancer twists and turns.
description:
Wearing naught but a cleverly designed silk sash, this athletic dancer twists
and spins about you, weaving around the campfire.

long_desc: This gypsy looks up from her crystal ball and watches you closely.
description:
Dressed in purple robes, covered in runes and multi-colored patches, this
elderly gypsy woman watches you over the top of her crystal ball.  You wonder
what she was divining before your arrival.  She must be one tough woman to
have survived to such an advanced age.

long_desc: The wailing ghost of a young female, badly mutilated, floats above the bodies.
description:
This ghost must be the remnants of one of the mutilated corpses.  Even though
she is made up of wisps of ether, you can see the ragged gash across her
throat.  It may be best to release her to the afterlife.

long_desc: A small demon, probably a servant, scurries about.
description:
This small ugly creature looks at you and gapes...not many mortals dare enter
this realm.  One of the more cowardly demons, this underling tries to avoid
you.

long_desc: This demon does not hesitate to jump at the chance to slay you!
description:
This young demon princeling knows that if it can slay you and contain your
spirit, it will grow stronger, and that is the only way to advance in the
demon realm.

long_desc: This mighty looking demon doesn't want to let you proceed further!
description:
This demon is big and ugly.  It stands in the middle of the path, blocking
your way any further.  It knows you are not on the list to see the Prince, so
he decides here and now to finish your life!

long_desc: A princely looking demon towers above you, lightning crackling about him.
description:
There aren't many demons out there bigger than this one, and you hope you
don't meet any of them anytime soon.  This particular Prince stares back at
you, lightning bolts crackled about him and twisting around his arms and
hands.

long_desc: This finely-dressed man gets up from his throne to confront you.
description:
This man must be the lord of the keep, since he's dressed in rich clothes and
sitting on the throne.  He gets up when you enter, and frowns at your
intrusion.  His hand reaches for the blade at his side as he considers your
actions.

long_desc: This bandit patrols the keep, attacking any intruders.
description:
This bandit sure does look in better shape than the ones stuck out living in
the woods.  His armor is in better condition, and he looks well fed.  His job
is to stop any intruders from entering the grounds, and he's going doing a
pretty good job at it.

long_desc: This bandit patrols the keep, attacking any intruders.
description:

the woods.  Her armor is in better condition, and she looks well fed.  Her job
is to stop any intruders from entering the grounds, and she's going doing a
pretty good job at it.

long_desc: This burly man stops his cooking and watches you.
description:
This burly old bandit must be the cook for the keep.  He moves about the
kitchen with the ease of one who knows what he's doing, then he notices you
standing there and stops, wondering who you are and what you are doing.

long_desc: This young woman is busy stacking books.
description:
This young lady moves about the library, humming a song and stacking books on
the various shelves.  She is quite occupied with her duties, and doesn't pay
you much attention at all.

long_desc: This human slave sits in the corner and ignores you.
description:
This poor slave, he sits in the corner with a faraway look in his eye.
Numerous scars and bruises cover his body, signs of very bad treatment.  He is
too far past caring to want to continue living.

long_desc: This dwarven slave sits in the corner and ignores you.
description:

long_desc: This young lady lounges in the lord's bed, awaiting his return.
description:
As you enter, this young woman gasps and covers herself up with the bedsheets.
 "You better leave now!" she screams.  "If the Boss catches you in here, he
will have your head!"

long_desc: This strong warrior practices with a long spear.
description:
This man must be the trainer for the bandits.  He stands in the middle of the
practice room, and is going through various combat maneuvers with a long
spear.  He is quite impressive!

This old man must be the groundskeeper for the keep.  Despite his age and his
gnarled hands, he must still have the knack of gardening, because the grounds
are beautiful.

long_desc: The guardian fire elemental is here fueling the great inferno.
description: Someone has abandoned a new mob here

keywords: sage elder old man elf elven
long_desc: An old man, dressed in an old robe.
description:
The robes of the elder sage seem to slowly shift from white through gray to
black and then back again.  He looks at you sternly, as if weighing your soul.
 "I can change your inner self, but it will cost you 25,000 coins.  You can
switch your alignment by TELLing me "Sage, change me to (align)", using good,
evil or neutral for the (align).  I will change your alignment, and take your
money.  I do not check which alignment you are first, so be careful!"

keywords: Lephan elf elven smith armor elven
long_desc: Lephan, the armorsmith, is hard at work.
description:
Lephan is a master armorsmith, and makes some of the finest elven chain in the
whole realm.  He nods at you as you enter, but keeps busy at work until you
need something specific.

long_desc: The weaponsmith, Elenesta, smiles at you.
description:
Elenesta makes some of the finest bows and long swords in the western realms.
Even a few dwarven smiths would venture to Elenolos to watch and learn her
skills.

long_desc: Ataran, the elven alchemist, works amongst many tubes and bottles.
description:
You have heard tales about the wonderful potions Ataran can provide for you.
From simple recall potions to amazing healing potions, he has a magical liquid
for every need.

long_desc: Vollesta the enchanter flips through a small book.
description:
Vollesta watches you closely as you enter his magical shop, a slight smile on
his face when he notices your amazed looks at the items he has created.

long_desc: A young elven child runs about, playing in the trees.
description:
This young child runs about happily, climbing the large trees of the forest,
and trying to catch the sparrows.  He smiles at you as he runs past.
