keywords: elf druid elven Lethys Greenvine female
long_desc: A tall elven female, wearing a plain tan robe, smiles as you approach.
description:
Pretty golden elven eyes peer back at you from under the hood of this tall
woman.  The familiar symbol of the elven druids is pinned into the cloak she
wears.  This one seems a little more...mystical...as it were, as the small
brooch of vines and branches actually seems to move as if growing and dancing
in the breeze.  You suddenly realize you are in the presence of the grand
elven druid, Lethys Greenvine.

long_desc: A tall elven ranger hums as he walks the path.
description:
That happy smile...that strange tune...those long blades...

The tune triggers the memory.  That old man in the tavern was telling the tale
of an elven ranger, who had mastered both the art of hunting and cooking the
wild and exotic game he had tracked down.  Daot the Steakmaster they called
him, and although he seems a jovial fellow, its rumored he had a shady past.

muscle and bone yet it's skin seems to nothing but solid flame. It is twice
the size of an ogre and just as inviting.  Luckily its sheer size keeps it
from moving too quickly inside the cavern.

be frost. It lumbers towards you, creating shards of ice from its breath and
it grins with a mouth of yellow and broken teeth as it gets close.

battlecry in the old tongue.  His armor is adorned in the skulls of his
victims.

description:
This creature is made of air and whispers. It seems to sniff and lick the air
in your direction and you have the sick feeling it is reading something out of
it.  It looks at you and looks at the surroundings, judging from the claw
marks, it is has been stuck here awhile and doesn't fancy your company.

long_desc: This wicked creature is a mixture of blades and piercings.
description:
This creature has blades of steel for arms and spears for legs.  It's face is
thin and narrow, it's skin pale and cold.  It stares at you and licks its
mouth at the sight.  From the chewed bones and mangled corpses of knights,
celestials, and anything else, this creature lives simply to hate.

long_desc: You notice this woman is standing next to her reflection, until both charge you!
description:
At first glance it would seem this woman is simply standing next to a great
mirror yet it becomes all too clear that the reflection is indeed coming at
you. Her hair is a sweet honey blonde and her eyes an ice blue.  She is
gorgeous.  Her armor is a highly polished silver and she see and her
reflection seem intent on staining it with your blood.

by how much silk and opium they can harvest in a day.  She pushes other
workers out of the way in order to get to the next ripe plant.

This porty fellow is a wealthy merchant.  He looks through the raw silk and
opium and is trying to decide how much to buy to transfer over to Sahardin or
maybe this new rumored continent to the west.

long_desc: This turkey is walking around, laughing hysterically.
description:
This large turkey is laughing as if they'll die tomorrow.  It half walks, half
skips by as it laughs and sings and then laughs again.  It's bright yellow and
orange body sways with an unheard music and seems to be laughing at you.

long_desc: This turkey is walking around, laughing hysterically.

long_desc: This brightly colored cat has a turtle shell on it's back.
description:
This animal is just, odd. It moves like a cat, with whiskers, ears, and feline
eyes but it's back is a rainbow colored turtle shell.  You try to rub the
smoke from your eyes but it seems like the creature is looking at you.  It
suddenly says "Yo? Whats the matter with you?"

long_desc: This cat looking bunny is casually walking by.
description:
This creature seems like a mix between a cute fluffy bunny and a housecat.
It's legs and body are that of a tabby cat, but it's head is that of a rabit
with feline eyes and teeth.  It walks by on two legs and seems to stop and
give you a short bow and tip of it's cap before whistling back down the way.

long_desc: This turtle is busy dancing the time away.
description:
This turtle seems pretty normal, except that is currently waltzing with an
invisible partner right by you.  It makes a few elaborate dips and steps, it's
actually a better dancer than you.

long_desc: This weasel is busy soaring through the skies.
description:
This weasel would be your average annoying varmit, except for the fact it is
zooming by in mid air.  You wonder how on earth a weasel learned to fly other
than a bored magician decided to play a cruel joke on a neighbor.

long_desc: This shrub is busy belting out a merry tune.
description:
This shrub is swaying back and forth and singing a drinking song. It's voice
is loud and all together pleasant but you wonder how in the dark gods does a
plant make a sound let alone sing? It stops and asks if you if you have a
request.

long_desc: This young yellow girl is shouting that she is the Lizard Queen.
description:
This young girl has starfish hair and bright yellow skin.  She waves her hands
in the air and you notice she only has 4 fingers.  She dances and sways to an
unheard music and screams constantly that she is the Lizard Queen. How odd.

long_desc: A huge dragon, black as the blackest night, lets out a loud roar!
description:
A huge black dragon, green acidic fumes curling up from its nose, lifts its
mighty head and lets out a roar that echos throughout the caves.  It's
swordlike horns gleam in the darkness.

long_desc: A large black panther with multiple tentacles appears out of nowhere!
description:
Hard enough to see in the inky blackness of the caves, this strange beast also
has the ability to disappear and reappear at will, making it very tough to
strike in combat.  It jumps at you, seemingly from different directions at
once!

backside.  He patrols the parade grounds, the halls, and anywhere else a
sneaky rebel might try to hide.  He is more heavily armoured than the wall
sentries, but he doesn't get the luxury of being 500 ft. from the enemy he
faces.

make sure the ballistae are working, loaded, and ready to be fired at all
times.  He is smoking a pipe and munching on some bread he managed to steal
away from the kitchens.

long_desc: This heavily armoured knight stares at the others with contempt.
description:
This knight is a veteran of numerous wars.  His armour is thick and shield is
brawn. He watches as the other soldiers slack off while on shift, or the few
off duty soldiers that are busy drinking themselves into a stupor. He doesn't
seem to be in the best of moods. Perhaps he is bitter he hasn't been sent to
fight Alden or crush the few scattered camps of the half-breed rebels.

long_desc: This man's job is to make sure the soldiers all have armour and weapons.
description:
This man has a thankless job. He spends all day inside the armoury, handing
out armour, repairing damaged armour, and dealing with the abuse of the
various soldiers and knights.  He's not a small man by far and by the look of
his arms, not a weak one either.  Perhaps he has another reason for not being
part of the active service.

long_desc: A heavy set man is hearing, cooking up some grub.
description:
It seems like this fellow eats as much as he cooks.  He is twice the girth of
a normal man and judging by the paws he calls hands, he has the appetite of an
ogre.  He is busy stirring some stew while he crushes a handful of pepper
leaves for flavor.

long_desc: This young boy is here to learn the ways of war.
description:
This boy is no more than 14 or 15. From the uniform he has to wear and the
constant obscenities hurled at him by the soldiers, he must be a cadet that
just entered the service. He is quite strapping for a lad and it seems the
constant abuse at the hands of the soldiers had hardened him already.

long_desc: This loud man is trying to keep the man on their guard.
description:
This man is loud and large. He is constantly yelling, kicking, and spitting
on the soldiers to stand up, hold their weapons like men, and stop looking
like a damn fool.  He most be the positive motivator in the place.

long_desc: This man has been trusted with the defense of this Fort.
description:
His face is scarred in a manner that only a hardened soldier knows about.  His
body is solid and he is quite broad.  From his swagger, his familiarity with
each inch of the fort, and the look of pride on his face you wager that he was
one of the soldiers to first take this Fort from the Dwarves.

long_desc: Taz the Slasher roams here.
description:
It's Taz the Slasher!!!!!!! Taz is a short dwarf with a long beard and a heavy
build. Upon his side is a large dagger with a golden embroidered handle.

long_desc: This long limbed man is dancing under the rainbow stars.
description:
This man is incredibly lithe and graceful.  He moves and twists his body as he
dances to the joyous music in the air.  He looks completely content with his
situation.  He ignores you as he continues to spin around, yet you notice from
his feet that they are raw and bleeding.  You wonder how long it has been
since he last stopped.

description:
This bull is the largest you have ever seen.  It stands eight feet at the
shoulder and looks as if it weights the same as ten orcs.  Yet, it is made of
nothing but ash and ice.  The ground shakes with the force of its hooves and
horns but the strips of ribbon in the air pass through it with ease.

description:

colors and music.  It is nothing yet it is form.  It has one mission: To
contain Delirium.   It must contain insanity yet it is made of such.  It is
not a creature of rules. It does not distiniguish between up or down.  It only
knows its mission and you are not part of the mission.

soul that has ever doubted themselves.  Every suicide, every act of pain and
hatred towards ones own self is the result of this creature and its only goal
in existence.

long_desc: This pale and bloated woman is all pain and suffering.
description:
This woman is grotesque and horrific.  She is bloated as if she has been dead
for months in a swamp.  She cuts her own leatherly flesh with a set of razor
hooks on her fingers.  She does not smile at you, oh no. She does not smile.

long_desc: This creature of living fire looks to consume you.
description:
At first glance this creature is no more than a moving collection of burning
timbers and bodies.  Yet, you notice the smouldering flame moves like muscle
and the pieces of sulfur that fall from its body burn through the already
destroyed floor.

long_desc: This man has been dead in the water for an eternity.

He heard the sound of his lungs collapsing from the pressure.  He felt each
moment of pain as his heart slowed and his blood grew chilled.   This man felt
every moment of death and then more.

long_desc: This beautiful woman is the personal guard of Destruction.
description:
This woman is adorned in immaculate battle armor.  It has been torn apart,
bled on, repaired in cheap fashion.  It is the perfect set of battle armor.
She moves through the eternal war only for the joy of the slaughter and the
delight that comes with the destruction of others.

long_desc: This mighty soldier has been dead for years, but that has not stopped him!
description:
This massive humanoid warrior must have been a most feared soldier when he was
alive.  But now that he has been fighting the same enemy in the same battle
for an untold amount of time, he is nothing.  However, he sees you and sees
fresh meat to meet his blades.

long_desc: This large man has a jovial face and a crown of fire.
description:
This man has a heavy beard of bright red with eyes to match.  He laughs in a
most sincere way, his smile is warm and you feel no animosity from him. Yet,
his fists destroy entire cities and his entire being is based on the death of
everything and anything.

long_desc: This child is dreaming she can fly, and that she is a dragon!
description:
This child appears so innocent.  She is wearing a simple cotton sleeping gown
and has her hair braided.  She is flying through the air, giggling and
dreaming of a world that can never be.  The only problem is that she is also
dreaming that she is a dragon and the flames from her mouth appear to be quite
real.

short_desc: A Dream Of A Thousand Cats
long_desc: This scattered and massive orb is the collected prayers of a forgotten race.
description:
This massive ball of energy appears to be the collected dreams and prayers of
a thousand cats.  You see images of cats laying in the sun in green fields,
some of mice being hunted, and of course of mating.  You also notice that the
most prominent dream is of a monstrous cat devouring all humanoids.

long_desc: This odd Librarian is incredibly upset you are here.
description:
This man is long and gaunt.  He is elf in appearance but dressed in clothes
you have never seen before.  He looks furious that you have disturbed his
library.  It is odd but it is apparent that he is made entirely of ink and
words.

long_desc: This bird is made entirely of paper.
description:
This strong bird must be the servant of the Librarian.  It is made entirely of
paper, even its claws are stained with ink and poems.  It soars on the wind,
even though you feel no draft.  It sees you and recognizes you are not where
you belong.

long_desc: This Jack-O-Lantern appears to be cleaning up the place.
description:
This strong creature is apparently in charge of keeping the castle in shape.
The body is that of a normal human but the head is a carved pumpkin. The
creature smokes and makes facial expressions as if nothing is out of place.
It sees you and grows very angry for messing up the floor.

long_desc: This burning globe of energy is the dream of a burning star.
description:
This globe of energy is almost humanoid.  It seems to form a shape with legs,
arms, a torso, and a head but it is made of entirely blue flame.  Inside the
fire you can see the dream of globes in an empty blackness with only huge
balls of the brighest fire to keep them warm.  The globe moves towards you to
embrace, but the heat is far too much.

long_desc: This gaunt man with black fire hair is not pleased to see you.
description:
This man is meloncholy and razor thin.  His hair is a wreath of black flame
and he is not happy that he has been distrubed.  In this realm, he is beyond
all question.  He is Dream, master of the sandscape.  He is not the lord of
dreams,  he is simply the very act of Dreaming.

long_desc: This odd particle is the very fabric of time.
description:
This odd...thing appears to be just a wisp of hair, the hair off a creature
the size of a planet.  This strange particle is the only tangible piece of
time.  Its presence weakens you as it moves forward.

time.  Its presence weakens you as it moves forward.

without slightly deforming from its massive weight.  The sand is a crystal
white and each time a single grain falls to the ground of the garden, you hear
a faint boom in the distance.

long_desc: This robed woman spins the thread of all people.
description:
This young woman is holding numerous long strands of some material. She spins
in through her fingers as if the air was a loom.  You attempt to look closer
at the fabric in her hands but she clutches them close and charges you with a
large pair of shears.

spins  in through her fingers as if the air was a loom.  You attempt to look

long_desc: This blind man has a large book chained to his wrist.
description:
This man is dressed in a simple robe.  His eyes are nothing but white and his
face seems ancient.  Attached to his right wrist by a large chain, a massive
book is cradled in his arms.  You are positive that he cannot see you yet he
motions to his two servants and the three began to approach you.

long_desc: This twisted creature spreads death to all life.
description:
This creature is an element of pure disease.  Its only goal in existence is to
destroy.  It is a silent killer, one that festers and grows before it expands
in a single blow, forever corrupting a field, a forest, a lake.

only through the absorption of other life.  It smells of rot and it is clear
that this creature will devour all in its path.

to their deaths.  He has given no quarter, offered no relief.  He has burned
villages for the warmth.  He sees you and wishes to add to his work.

This massive vulture has picked the bones of many a fallen soldier but still
it hungers.  It eats and eats but can never stop because there will always be
fallen soldiers and so this demon will always need to eat.

that collects the souls of those who have simply run out of time.  Whether
it be due to an accident or the body failing, every one has a set time that
they may live out.  The angel takes young and old, the angel knows that
everyone gets the same amount: A Lifetime.

long_desc: This young woman holds a scythe and smiles.

simply beautiful.  She is not the incarnation of death.  She is not the
messenger or the harbinger.  She is death.  Every life that ends is the result
of her.  Even if you manage to kill her, she will be there.  She is the only
true immortal.   She is the only real truth.

quivers with anger at your intrusion, but stays standing in his guard

description: A small black bat flits about the cavern, looking for bugs to eat.

long_desc: A small bat flits around the cavern.

long_desc: A large orc rises from his throne as you approach.
description:
This mighty orc is wearing an iron crown, and must be the chieftain of the
local tribe.  His red eyes burn into you as you approach him, and a low growl
comes from his throat.  He holds a blood-covered mace in one hand.

keywords: halforc thug orc Grazd Bloodburner bulky
long_desc: A bulky half-orc snarls and sneers as you approach.
description:
This tall beast wastes no time in getting down to business with you..."Hey
scum, you know who I am?  I'm Grazd Bloodburner, you're worst nightmare.  If I
were you, I'd be pretty scared right now."  He flashes an ugly toothy grin and
eyes your moneypouch greedily.

keywords: halforc cleric Molikoth robed dark figure
long_desc: A dark-robed figure stops and turns in your direction.
description:
Silent and scary, this dark figure is completely covered in dark robes, from
head to toe.  It stands as still as a statue.  As you stare closer, you
realize there are small symbols sewn into the robes, and with a jolt you
realize who this is.  Molikoth, renegade half-orc Cleric.  You've heard him
referred to as the God-Eater, and the numerous tales of his journeys are dark
and horrible.

fantastic robes, with many arcane runes embroidered about them.  A pointed
wizards hat sits atop his head.  He nods at you as he walks past.

of elves to ambush.  Be careful...he may try to attack you if he gets a good
chance.

its back end lights up, adding a little glow to the world about it.

long_desc: An elven slave girl kneels before you, awaiting your desire.
description:
A slim but shapely figure rests here, elven chain restraining her at the neck,
wrists and ankles. Submissively positioned, this slave girl obeys her
mistress's every whim. All is still until the girl shifts slightly, stirring
her lightly wrought chains, a silvery, musical sound upon the air.

mountains, looking for veins of ore or gems.  They carry a belt of explosive

This goblin has the thankless job of ensuring the city stays safe as well as
making sure the goblins themselves behave.  They carry simple weapons
and from their rather large belly and chubby cheeks, they don't train
themselves too hard.

This goblin has spent most of their life out in the wilds, exploring the
cities of other races and mapping the entire world.  They look quite capable
of taking care of themselves and seem a bit restless lounging back at home.

description:
This poor woman must have near ten kids, all of them running about and causing
trouble.  She does her best to keep them close and from playing on top of
other sleeping goblins but she doesn't seem to be very successful.

keep his children from running amok.  He chases after one or another but never
manages to keep them still.  He looks tired and haggard.

were on fire.  They have dozens upon dozens of playmates but are also stepping
on sleeping miners or running through other's dinners.  Their parents are
trying to chase them down but they are surprisingly quick.

description:
This goblin is taking a leisurely stroll through the commons, stopping to talk
to friends at one make-shift pub before saying hello to another group
huddled around a vendor.  They seem quite content.

long_desc: This goblin is taking a stroll through the commons.
description:
This goblin is hawking his wares.  He has several handmade cloaks, armors, and
even a few weapons for sale to all the wannabe adventurers.  He looks at you
and asks if you would like to get your hands on genuine wolfen-skin pants.

long_desc: This goblin is taking a stroll through the commons.
description:
This goblin is trying to sell a few items he has collected in his time.  He
offers you the chance to try some of his homemade wine or perhaps a bite of
his wife's famous cooking.

long_desc: This goblin works the mines of the city.
description:
This sturdy looking goblin has the glorious job of digging deep into the
mountains, looking for veins of ore or gems.  They carry a belt of explosive
devices and they seem to not consider the fact that one stray flame will bring
the entire cave down on you.

long_desc: This goblin is carefully indexing all the collected works.
description:
This older goblin woman has been working in this library for a long time. She
seems to know where all the books are and where to put each new hand-made copy
that chronicles life outside of the mountains.  She smiles at you and asks you
if you would like to borrow a book.  You notice she has a large collection
of magical items on her small desk.

long_desc: This elderly shaman is wandering the city, muttering.
description:
This old goblin woman is clearly a shaman, judging by the various charms
and baubles she wears.  She is talking to herself as she walks by,
occasionally stopping to read a person's aura before making her way to
where ever it is she thinks she is going.

long_desc: This elderly shaman is wandering the city, muttering.
description:

and baubles she wears.  She is talking to herself as she walks by,
occasionally stopping to read a person's aura before making her way to
where ever it is she thinks she is going.

long_desc: This goblin mixes both science and magic to find new veins.
description:
This young goblin has carefully studied the principles of mining as well as
the magical arts.  He looks over some plans in his hands and then casts an odd
spell to help guide him.  Judging by the scars he has been too close to a few
sappers.

long_desc: This goblin mixes both science and magic to find new veins.
description:
This young goblin has carefully studied the principles of mining as well as
the magical arts.  He looks over some plans in his hands and then casts an odd
spell to help guide him.  Judging by the scars he has been too close to a few
sappers.

long_desc: This regal looking goblin wears a crown of earth and steel.
description:
This Goblin is in charge and he knows it. His small frame and thin hair are
insignificant next to the crown and scepter he proudly displays.  You feel
that he is not a foolish or simple creature but one who preys on those that
believe him to be such.  He watches you and waits for you to bow.

long_desc: A large black crow lands nearby and squawks at you!
description:
A large black crow hops around and stares at you.  Perhaps it wants something
shiny?

long_desc: A large ugly rat sniffs at you as you approach.
description: This rat is enormous!  I'd be careful if I were you...

long_desc: A ghost floats about here restlessly.
description:
This ghost floats about, with no real goal in mind.  Perhaps you should try to
free him from this world.

long_desc: A ghost floats about here restlessly.
description:
This ghost floats about, with no real goal in mind.  Perhaps you should try to
free her from this world.

long_desc: This ghost looks like he was once the priest here.
description:
This ghost is dressed in old tattered priest robes.  It must of been the
caretaker of this church back in the day.

long_desc: A spirit materializes in front of you and attacks!
description: This ghost looks very frightening!  Perhaps you should not have provoked it...

long_desc: A very malnourished ghoul jumps at you!
description:
This ghoul has gone for so long without food, that it is insane.  It jumps at
you, smelling fresh meat!

long_desc: A well-equipped ghoul watches you closely.
description:
This ghoul must be heading somewhere on the surface.  He is well-equipped to
face many dangers.

long_desc: A zombie shuffles down the hallway with a dead look in its eye.
description: This zombie ignores you as it eternally makes the rounds of the catacombs.

long_desc: A skeleton of one of the old priests tends to the dead.
description:
This old priest has seen better days.  It is his curse to eternally walk these
hallways and take care of the dead.

long_desc: An embalmed warrior stands at attention.
description:
A large armored mummy stands before you.  He must of been placed here to
protect the tombs of the royalty.

long_desc: This ghoul protects the door to the Kingdom.
description:
A strong and vicious looking ghoul, this armored creature has been charged
with protecting the Kingdom from any intruders.  Careful dealing with him.

long_desc: This young ghoul stops its chores to watch you.
description:
This young ghoul has many errands to do today.  It stops and stares at you
with wonder, not sure how you got down here, or why you are here.

long_desc: This ghoul is out doing whatever ghouls do.
description:
This ghoul stares back at you, wondering why you would come down so far under
the surface.

long_desc: This ghoul stops working to look up at you.
description:
This ghoul was working hard before you walked in.  She stares at you with a
bit of supervise in her eyes...she hasn't seen many adventurer's venture this
far.

long_desc: A ghoul priestess glares at you for your intrusion.
description:
This ghoul looks young.  She is dressed in the robes of a priestess, which
means she wields some fairly strong powers.  Not many who cross her live to
tell the tale.

long_desc: This ghoul glances up from his book to look at you.
description:
A young male ghoul, this one wears the robes of a magical order.  He has his
nose deep into a copy of the Book of Knowledge, which all ghoul mages must
learn.

long_desc: The High Priestess seems disturbed by your arrival.
description:
The High Priestess of the Ghouls stares at you with an upset look in her eye.
Perhaps she is planning on how to feed you to the Old Ones for your
indiscretions.

long_desc: The Master Mage frowns at your entrance.
description:
The Master Mage of the Ghouls is the holder of the true Book of Knowledge.
Great power comes from the book, and this ghoul must be very strong to lay
claim to it.

long_desc: A large, black, bat-winged creature stalks about.
description:
Shocking and uncouth black beings with smooth, oily, whale-like surfaces,
unpleasant horns that curved inward toward each other, bat-wings whose beating
made no sound, ugly prehensile paws, and barbed tails that lashed needlessly
and disquietingly. And worst of all, they never spoke or laughed, and never
smiled because they had no faces at all to smile with, but only a suggestive
blankness where a face ought to be. All they ever did was clutch and fly and
tickle; that was the way of night-gaunts.  -- H.P. Lovecraft "The Dream-Quest
of Unknown Kadath"

long_desc: A huge, horrifying darkness arises before you!
description:
...that last amorphous blight of nethermost confusion which blasphemes and
bubbles at the centre of all infinity -- the boundless daemon-sultan Azathoth,
whose name no lips dare speak aloud, and who gnaws hungrily in inconceivable,
unlighted chambers beyond time amidst the muffled, maddening beating of vile
drums and the thin, monotonous whine of accursed flutes; to which detestable
pounding and piping dance slowly, awkwardly, and absurdly the gigantic
ultimate gods, the blind, voiceless, tenebrous, mindless Other Gods whose soul
and messenger is the crawling chaos Nyarlathotep. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "The
Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath"

long_desc: A huge fish-like monster roars at you!
description:
Vast, Polyphemus-like, and loathsome, it darted like a stupendous monster of
nightmares to the monolith, about which it flung its gigantic scaly arms, the
while it bowed its hideous head and gave vent to certain measured sounds....
Once I sought out a celebrated ethnologist, and amused him with peculiar
questions regarding the ancient Philistine legend of Dagon, the Fish-God; but
soon perceiving that he was hopelessly conventional, I did not press my
inquiries. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "Dagon"

long_desc: A scaly, half-fish, half-frog creature croaks at you!
description:
I think their predominant colour was a greyish-green, though they had white
bellies. They were mostly shiny and slippery, but the ridges of their backs
were scaly. Their forms vaguely suggested the anthropoid, while their heads
were the heads of fish, with prodigious bulging eyes that never closed. At the
sides of their necks were palpitating gills, and their long paws were webbed.
They hopped irregularly, sometimes on two legs and sometimes on four. I was
somehow glad that they had no more than four limbs. Their croaking, baying
voices, clearly used for articulate speech, held all the dark shades of
expression which their staring faces lacked. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "The Shadow
Over Innsmouth"

long_desc: This crab-like, winged monster jumps around the cavern.
description:
They were pinkish things about five feet long; with crustaceous bodies bearing
vast pairs of dorsal fins or membraneous wings and several sets of articulated
limbs, and with a sort of convoluted ellipsoid, covered with multitudes of
very short antennae, where a head would ordinarily be.... As it was, nearly
all the rumours had several points in common; averring that the creatures were
a sort of huge, light-red crab with many pairs of legs and with two great
bat-like wings in the middle of their back. They sometimes walked on all their
legs, and sometimes on the hindmost pair only, using the others to convey
large objects of indeterminate nature. On one occasion they were spied in
considerable numbers, a detachment of them wading along a shallow woodland
watercourse three abreast in evidently disciplined formation. Once a specimen
was seen flying -- launching itself from the top of a bald, lonely hill at
night and vanishing in the sky after its great flapping wings had been
silhouetted an instant against the full moon. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "The
Whisperer in Darkness"

long_desc: A sinister, black man stands near the strange equipment.
description:
And it was then that Nyarlathotep came out of Egypt. Who he was, none could
tell, but he was of the old native blood and looked like a Pharaoh. The
fellahin knelt when they saw him, yet could not say why. He said he had risen
up out of the blackness of twenty-seven centuries, and that he had heard
messages from places not on this planet. Into the lands of civilization came
Nyarlathotep, swarthy, slender, and sinister, always buying strange
instruments of glass and metal and combining them into instruments yet
stranger. He spoke much of the sciences -- of electricity and psychology --
and gave exhibitions of power which sent his spectators away speechless, yet
which swelled his fame to exceeding magnitude. Men advised one another to see
Nyarlathotep, and shuddered. And where Nyarlathotep went, rest vanished; for
the small hours were rent with the screams of a nightmare. -- H.P. Lovecraft
"Nyarlathotep"

long_desc: This giant monster fills nearly the entire cavern!
description:
We were on the track ahead as the nightmare plastic column of foetid black
iridescence oozed tightly onward through its fifteen-foot sinus; gathering
unholy speed and driving before it a spiral, re-thickening cloud of the pallid
abyss-vapour. It was a terrible, indescribable thing vaster than any subway
train -- a shapeless congeries of protoplasmic bubbles, faintly self-luminous,
and with myriads of temporary eyes forming and unforming as pustules of
greenish light all over the tunnel-filling front that bore down upon us,
crushing the frantic penguins and slithering over the glistening floor that it
and its kind had swept so evilly free of all litter. -- H.P. Lovecraft
"At the Mountains of Madness"

long_desc: A hideous female growls at your entrance...
description:
One squat, black temple of Tsathoggua was encountered, but it had been turned
into a shrine of Shub-Niggurath, the All-Mother and wife of the the
Not-to-Be-Named-One. This deity was a kind of sophisticated Astarte, and her
worship struck the pious Catholic as supremely obnoxious. -- H.P. Lovecraft
"The Mound"

long_desc: A croaking toad-like beast hops towards you!
description:
They've been inside the earth, too -- there are openings which human beings
know nothing of -- some of them are in these very Vermont hills -- and great
worlds of unknown life down there; blue-litten Kn-yan, red-litten Yoth, and
black, lightless Nkai. Its from Nkai that frightful Tsathoggua came -- you
know, the amorphous, toad-like god-creature mentioned in the Pnakotic
Manuscripts and the Necronomicon and the Commoriom myth-cycle preserved by the
Atlantean high-priest Klarkash-Ton. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "The Whisperer in
Darkness"

long_desc: The gate guardian Yog-Sothoth stands before you!
description:
Yog-Sothoth knows the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the gate. Yog-Sothoth is the key
and guardian of the gate. Past, present, future, all are one in Yog-Sothoth.
He knows where the Old Ones broke through of old, and where They shall break
through again. He knows where They have trod earths fields, and where They
still tread them, and why no one can behold Them as They tread. -- H.P.
Lovecraft  "The Dunwich Horror"

long_desc: The shopkeeper looks at you and wonders how much gold you brought.
description:
The shopkeeper hesitates a moment before nodding towards your
direction...perhaps he wasn't sure if you could afford any of his items.

long_desc: A shady looking drow says 'Interested in Drow weapons?'
description:
The drow smith steps out from the shadows.  'I bear fine weapons of my own
design and craft.  They are pricey, but you won't be disappointed'

long_desc: A skeleton of one of the old priests tends to the dead.
description:
This old priest has seen better days.  It is his curse to eternally walk these

long_desc: A small ghoul, dressed as a jester, prances about here.
description:
This small, malformed ghoul is dressed in the clothes of a jester.  He grins
back at you as if there is something he knows that you don't.

tickle; that was the way of night-gaunts.  -- H.P. Lovecraft "The Dream-Quest
of Unknown Kadath"

long_desc: This ghoul is out doing whatever ghouls do.

This ghoul stares back at you, wondering why you would come down so far under
the surface.

long_desc: This ghoul stops working to look up at you.
description:
This ghoul was working hard before you walked in.  She stares at you with a
bit of supervise in her eyes...she hasn't seen many adventurer's venture this
far.

long_desc: A scaly, half-fish, half-frog creature croaks at you!
description:
I think their predominant colour was a greyish-green, though they had white
bellies. They were mostly shiny and slippery, but the ridges of their backs
were scaly. Their forms vaguely suggested the anthropoid, while their heads
were the heads of fish, with prodigious bulging eyes that never closed. At the
sides of their necks were palpitating gills, and their long paws were webbed.
They hopped irregularly, sometimes on two legs and sometimes on four. I was
somehow glad that they had no more than four limbs. Their croaking, baying
voices, clearly used for articulate speech, held all the dark shades of
expression which their staring faces lacked. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "The Shadow
Over Innsmouth"

long_desc: This crab-like, winged monster jumps around the cavern.
description:
They were pinkish things about five feet long; with crustaceous bodies bearing
vast pairs of dorsal fins or membraneous wings and several sets of articulated
limbs, and with a sort of convoluted ellipsoid, covered with multitudes of
very short antennae, where a head would ordinarily be.... As it was, nearly
all the rumours had several points in common; averring that the creatures were
a sort of huge, light-red crab with many pairs of legs and with two great
bat-like wings in the middle of their back. They sometimes walked on all their
legs, and sometimes on the hindmost pair only, using the others to convey
large objects of indeterminate nature. On one occasion they were spied in
considerable numbers, a detachment of them wading along a shallow woodland
watercourse three abreast in evidently disciplined formation. Once a specimen
was seen flying -- launching itself from the top of a bald, lonely hill at
night and vanishing in the sky after its great flapping wings had been
silhouetted an instant against the full moon. -- H.P. Lovecraft  "The
Whisperer in Darkness"

long swords hanging at his side marks this adventurer as Bandek Runewriter,
the ghoul ranger.  Many stories have been sung about Bandek, but his most
famous tale is how he helped craft the runes that seal the Elder Gods in their

ghoul's robes is a dead giveaway.  Aeris of the White Seal is famous
throughout the land for her awesome powers.  She alone was the ghoul who
wrestled Azathoth into his dark prison.  Her powers are near godlike.

description:

approach the throne.  Awaiting your request, he fingers the large axe hanging

long_desc: Kragoth, Mountainmaster of Ironholde, awaits your order.
description:
Supplying the surrounding region with quality climbing gear for some time,
Kragoth is famous for his knowledge of mountains and climbing.  He has
forgotten more about scaling the local peaks than you will ever know.  Some of
the best gear in the realm has his mark on it.

long_desc: Hedge, owner of The Lady, laughs with a roar, and pulls another beer.
description:
Hedge!  Master of dwarven ales...only he knows the secret of the underground
grains grown for his beer.  The only thing he likes better than brewing his
special ale is drinking his special ale.

long_desc: The master smith of the dwarves, Stonesharp, hammers away at a new creation.
description:
Ignoring your presence, Stonesharp, the master smith, pounds away at a huge
chunk of mithril, shaping it into another of his deadly weapons.  Known for
their giant killing capability, many giant-hunters come to him for advice and
weaponry.

long_desc: Lightspear, priest of the dwarves, bows as you enter.
description:

talk too.  Usually found deep in prayer to the rock masters, he also runs a
small shop, specializing in gear for the various clerics of the dwarves.  Even
non-dwarf clerics journey here to find his specialized equipment.

you know who this cleric is.  Karla Lightaxe is the subject of many tales, all
of them glorious.  She wields great power in battle, both her own and her
gods.

This worker is some hundred feet in the air, repairing some of the monstrous
cables that run along the cavern walls and ceiling.  They seem well versed in
both the mechanics of these devices as well as their magikal properties.

long_desc: This gnome is hawking her wares.
description:
This older gnome woman is carrying several baskets of fruit and other snacks.
Several other gnomes or dwarves are browsing her selection.  It is a wonder
how they manage to get fruit in a huge cavern like this.

long_desc: This gnome is hawking his wares.
description:
This older gnome man is carrying two racks of freshly killed and cured
meat. You see some rabbit, some deer, and even some fresh chicken
or turkey.

long_desc: This older dwarf cleric is talking into a mug of ale.
description:
This dwarf is no longer in the heavy armour of the dwarven clergy. Only
his robes and amulets denote his status.  He spends his time here, with
the last of his people, giving spiritual succor and physical remedy.

long_desc: This beautiful elf is carrying numerous healing aids.
description:
This elf must have been sent by the Alliance to make sure that Kinterownt's
soldiers and populous are well shielded for disease, injury, and anything else
the healing arts can protect against.  She looks to have seen battle and
judging by her mannerisms, she was once a field medic.

long_desc: This old dwarf is permanently crippled but still able to make armour.
description:
This old dwarf must have taken a massive blade to his hip. He needs a cane and
several odd gnomish devices just to walk. Yet he still looks capable of
inspecting, repairing, and making armour with very little else. He must have
been a great warrior once but now he is content to make sure that others are
better armed than he was.

long_desc: This ghoul is letting his energy be siphoned off.
description:
This ghoul is in a state of complete detachment from pain or thought. His
entire soul is bent on keeping his magikal energies flowing while they power
the numerous protection spheres that keep the gnome machines stable and
working.

long_desc: This stunning dwarven woman is resting upon a makeshift throne.
description:
She is royalty, any one could see that the moment you look upon her. Yet, the
scars of grief are heavy on her faith.  She has lost her husband and her only
child to a war she did not welcome. Now she must lead what is left of her
people through these dark times.  It will be she that orders them to death or
into shame and dishonor.

long_desc: A lithe yet powerful Gnome rests upon a throne of metal.
description:
This gnome is amazingly lithe and graceful. He seems almost like a human of a
very short disposition.  His movements are fluid, his armor seems to weight
nothing.  His hair is a deep jet that falls over his pale eyes. Judging by the
large scepter or wrench by his side, the dents in his armor, and the scars on
his hands and face, this Gnome has led his people through numerous wars.

long_desc: This kobold works the mineshaft for treasure.
description:
This old kobold works in the dirt of the mineshaft, hoping to find some more
treasure in the walls.  He looks at you as you approach, but ignores you and
turns back to his work.

long_desc: A young kobold whimpers when it see's you.

This young kobold was having a good time, but when it spies you, he begins to
whimper.  He has been raised on tales of evil adventurers that come to slay
kobold for no good reason, and he thinks you could be one of them.

lake. It slides through the water quite easily and seems more interested in
the perch and thorneye than you.  However, judging by the fangs and the fact
it must be eight feet long, it does not seem wise to bother it.

long_desc: This large lizard is swimming along, looking for food.
description:
This lizard is quite large, it is the size of a small alligator.  It swims
along using its tail to propel itself as it tries to pick and choose between
the hundreds of fish that swim by.  The dark blue scales of the lizard seem to
make his intent as several fish pass by within the kill distance of the
lizard's jaw.

with a row of teeth on the bottom.  It is clearly a carnivore although nothing
here seems to be too aggressive.  There is plenty of food to go around for
every creature, even this one.

It is odd to see an eel that should be somewhere in Wulftuft sea in this lake.
It is ten feet long and has a mouth full of tiny knives.  It cuts through the
water with little problem and it seems quite at home in the fresh water lake.

long_desc: You don't believe your eyes to see a dolphin swimming in this lake!
description:
It is amazing to see a dolphin swimming in the water of this lake.  It is a
bit smaller than other dolphins you have seen, but that seems only  natural
that it would grow to be smaller in a smaller space like this lake. It plays
happily in the water, ignoring the eels and water monitors.

its belly scraping the bottom as it literally sucks everything as dry as can

lake with its hind legs and uses its shorter arms to slash and hold the fish
it feeds on.  It is obvious this creature prefers to hide here at the bottom
of the lake, away from the sunlight.

long_desc: A huge man in heavy plate armor of eastern design orders his troops about.
description:
The way the soldiers treat this man marks him as the supreme Warlord over this
army.  He stands at least twice as tall as any other man, and the armor he
wears looks to be crafted from the bones of his enemies.  His cold stare locks
on you, and he whips his blade from the scabbard on his hip.

long_desc: One of the Alden Captains seems lost in the combat.
description:
Captain Nelson lost control of his army soon after the battle started, and he
has fought in chaos and confusion every since.  At this point, battle fear has
consumed him and he is striking out at every one in his range.

long_desc: Captain Stiles cackles and howls as the bloodlust consumes him.
description:
Slashing left and right with his sword, Captain Stiles is lost in combat
madness.  His eyes stare far away and he cackles and drools as he tears into
every around him, friend and foe.

long_desc: An old man dressed in ornate plate armor barks out orders to the men.
description:
It's the mustache that gives it away.  Every tavern tale you've heard about
General Thadius mentions that drooping white mustache.  The ends are stained
red from his habit of drinking the blood of the opposing general after each
combat.  He has never lost a fight, and he's not going to let this be the
first.

description:
This older pixie woman is still quite cute despite her age.  She shuffles
through the papers on her desk and ignores you staring at her.  Her auburn
hair has several sublte hints of gray that only serve to add to her beauty.

long_desc: This pixie is mixing different potions together.
description:
This older pixie is hunched over a concotion of numerous potions and
components in a search for a new thing to sell.  His face is scarred from fire
and acid, leading to the assumption his mixtures aren't always stable.

long_desc: This pixie barmaid is busy mixing drinks.
description:
This beautiful young pixie is mixing up several drinks behind the bar. She
floats up to the top shelf to get the rarer and more expensive bottles of ale
or wine.  She smiles at you and gives a wink.

long_desc: This pixie is relaxing in their home.
description:
This middle-aged pixie is taking a break from whatever work they were doing
and resting in the comfort of their home.  They smoke a small pipe and call
out to their orc-servant for another glass of wine.  They seem quite content.

Imperials, so for the time they are free to play.  They chase around the other

game.

description:
The guardians were formed shortly after the Imperial army destroyed the last
major clan of pure blood orcs.  The bastard children that remained were put to
work under the eye of the faithful pixies and Bazabel pledged a battalion of
soldiers to help defend their city.  This soldier is keeping that pledge.

long_desc: This large half-orc supplies the local community.
description:
This large half-orc's shop is simple as are his clothes.  He caters to the
half-orc population that is forced to live in the ghetto and does his best to
make sure everyone has something to eat and something to keep them warm.  He
smiles at you and welcomes you in, despite your race.

long_desc: This Imperial is busy working on some armor.
description:
This large man is the local blacksmith and the official supplier of all
weapons and armor in the city.  He is busy repairing a breastplate that a
stupid half-orc broke during a training exercise.  He curses his luck to get
landed in a city filled with buck-tooth dullards and flying laughing idiots.

long_desc: Puff the Fractal Dragon is here, contemplating a higher reality.
description: Puff doesn't appreciate you just showing up here.

long_desc: A demon imp hovers nearby...drooling constantly with a fiendish grin.
description:
This demon is clearly something that you don't want to mess with...
It appears to be very agile, and very strong.

long_desc: The supermob is here.  He looks busy as hell.
description: How clever he looks!

long_desc: A horrifying daemon stands close to its master.
description:
This awful creature has been summoned forth by some Diabolist.  It will
protect its master to the death, or until it finds a way to break free of the
binding spells that hold it on this plane.

long_desc: An animated corpse struggles with the horror of its undeath.
description:
Denied its rightful death, this animated corpse has been infused with the
powerful energies of its master.  It exists on the precipice between life
and unlife, even as its physical body rots and decays under the strain of
its tasks.

long_desc: A proud hawk circles about on the breeze.
description:
A large hawk circles about the warm thermals overhead.  It awaits orders from
its Ranger master.

long_desc: A large wolf prowls about restlessly.
description:
A large wolf prowls about restlessly.  It awaits orders from its Ranger
master.

long_desc: A sleek panther prowls about restlessly.
description:
A sleek panther prowls about restlessly.  It awaits orders from its Ranger
master.

long_desc: A large bear prowls about restlessly.
description:
A large bear prowls about restlessly.  It awaits orders from its Ranger
master.

long_desc: A thick mist plays with your senses.
description:
Is it the fog you see?  Or are your eyes playing deadly tricks on you.  The
mist swirls around you and then quickly disappears before you can blink.  You
suddenly find yourself overcome with an unknown power.

long_desc: A bat hovers nearby with bloody fangs.
description:
As this bloodsucking creature flies past you, you notice the tiny black
eyes that stare at your jugular vein.  This little black bat has the
intentions of drinking your blood until there is none left in your body.

long_desc: A hawk watches you with predatory eyes from its perch.
description:
This proud creature stands upon its perch watching you with unblinking
eyes.  Any movement made by you could make it flare its wings in disapproval
and open its beak to scream its intent.  Its long beak open and before you
know what has happened, it comes flying towards you.

long_desc: A black cat has crossed your path with deadly intent.
description:
With a furry black coat, and big yellow eyes, this cat gracefully walks
across your path, bringing you several years of bad luck.  Its tail moves
slowly to tell you that it is laughing at your misfortune.

long_desc: A beautiful dove sings a melancholy melody from its nest.
description:
With feathers the colour of soft grey and soft loving black eyes, this small
delicate creature sings you a tune full of romance.  The tune it sings comes
from the small breast that rises and falls with every chorus it sings.  You
are at peace as you listen to this lovable creature.

long_desc: A fish blows large bubbles as it quickly swims past you.
description:
With fins, teeth and gills, this slippery little thing is hard to catch.
It swims with a speed no beast, human or animal can compete with.  It's
tiny eyes, move with every breath.  It blows several large bubbles as it
quickly swims past you.

long_desc: The avatar of a deity stands before you.
description: Insert avatar description here

long_desc: A conjurer's golem stands here, awaiting orders.
description:
This magical being was called forth by the mystical might of a Conjurer.  It
follows the orders of its master without any question.

long_desc: An ethereal guardian stands here in protection of its master.
description: An ethereal guardian stands here in protection of its master.

long_desc: A shadow stands  here, ready for a fight.
description: A shadow stands  here, ready for a fight.

long_desc: %s is here.
A mirror image of %s stands here.
The spirit of %s floats here.
description: This spirit has been raised from the dead.

long_desc: A vampire is here hiding his face from your light source.
description:
Before you stands a guardian vampire, looking quite evil to say the least.
The hair on your arms is raised by its presence alone, and it seems to you
that he appears too formidable to be a minor minion.

long_desc: A horrible beast drools and growls.
description:
This awful beast has been summoned from the depths of the nether realms by
some Diabolist.  It follows the will of its master.  It would be a good idea
not to provoke it.

long_desc: A sad and pathetic ghost is here, longing to PK newbies.
description:
When he was alive, he took pleasure in being deceitful and dishonest. He would
gloat about being the best player killer around, yet he would only kill the
newbies of the realm. He would never level too high for fear the Avatars would
kill him. His was a sad existance of lies. Still, in the afterlife, he
continues to try.

long_desc: A large, hairy mountain spider creeps along the rocks.
description:
This hairy spider is huge!  It slowly creeps between the rocks, looking for a
good place to spin a web and catch something to eat.

long_desc: A dwarven scout looks for mineral deposits in the 'kore.
description:
This dwarf was sent out from the city of Ironhelm to search for more metal
deposits.  He nods at you as you pass, but is more interested in the
geological makeup of the rocks around him.

long_desc: A dwarven miner hammers away, looking for precious metal.
description:
As you come across this dwarf, they are swinging away at a chunk of rock,
obviously looking for some precious metals to craft their magical goods from.
It looks up at you, nods slightly, then gets back to work.

long_desc: A huge, scruffy giant walks along the path.
description:
You stare up at the hill giant, a creature not known for its intelligence.  He
swings a huge club as he walks down the trail.  As he spots you, a confused
look appears on his face.  He's obviously not used to seeing adventurer's on
this path.

long_desc: A half-starved vulture flaps weakly about the rocks.
description:
This poor vulture looks like it hasn't fed in a while.  That makes sense to
you, since you haven't seen to many creatures about that it could feed upon.
It squawks weakly at you as you stare at it.

long_desc: A dragon hatchling is here hissing at you.
description:
The dragon hatchling is a shiny greenish-silver color.  It has a long
forked tongue it keeps sticking out.  It is about 3 feet long.

long_desc: An ice dragon is here, its claws look very deadly!
description:
The ice dragon has one massive claw made of ice!  If you could manage to slay
the beast it may pose as a good weapon.  It has a large horn that protrudes
from its forehead, it also has two large wings that have a *HUGE* span!

long_desc: The fire dragon stands here.  It blows fire straight at you!
description:
The fire dragon looks quite large.  It has red scales and many spikes in many
locations on its body.  Its fire breath looks very deadly!

long_desc: A green dragon stands here.  It has smooth scales that resemble a snake.
description:
The green dragon has very smooth scales, much like that of a snake.  It has
jungle green scales which make it blend in very well with its surroundings.  It
has two sharp teeth that protrude from its mouth.

long_desc: A brown dragonet flies along here.
description:
The brown dragonet has two very fragile wings and a very frail body.  You look
at its large head and see many teeth that look like daggers protruding from
its mouth.  At the end of its tail are three large spikes, which could inflict
some damage if provoked.

long_desc: A dragon with many spikes is here.  It growls at the sight of you.
description:
The spiked dragon is gray with many large spikes that are found all over its
large body.  It is not able to fly with its small wings, but its spikes could
provide quite the offense and defense.

long_desc: A dragon knight stands here, fully suited for anything.
description:
The dragon knight is wearing the typical dragon slayer's equipment.  It is
wielding a large sword which has seen the body of many dragons.

long_desc: The king of the dragons is here.  It is a dragon too!
description:
The king of the dragons is here.  It too is a dragon, somehow it must have
taken control of the other dragons.  It wears a crown upon its head proudly,
it has a huge cleaver for a weapon.

long_desc: An adventurer seeks dragons here.  It looks like a drow.
description:
The drow adventurer stands at six feet, three inches.  He is very light weight
and could move around quite well.  He is foolishly looking for a fight.

long_desc: Mathasus, the wizard stands before you.
description:
Mathasus is the dragon king's personal wizard.  He is a drow with long black
hair and fair dark skin.  He is dressed in dark clothes.

long_desc: Blathar, the warrior stands before you.
description:
Blathar is the dragon king's personal bodyguard.  He is a half-ogre, and as
the typical half-ogre is bald.  He is unlike most ogres though because of his
smarts.

long_desc: The ancient red dragon is before you in a blaze of fire.
description:
The ancient red dragon is the most powerful dragon known.  He is the true king
of the dragons but he was unable to defeat the dragon king's wizard and body
guard, forcing him to surrender.

time in the pure freedom of life at see.  The gith looks about for any

the ship sea-worthy again.  That means patching holes, getting new rope,
sowing the sails and anything else.

long_desc: This proud minotaur woman is working on a piece of armor.
description:
This minotaur must be considered beautiful by her kind.  She is tall and
proud, the signs on battle written onto her skin and her horns slightly
chipped. She hammers out a new breastplate, complete with well placed spines
that would make close combat a bad idea.

long_desc: This goblin is examining a freshly made rapier.
description:
This goblin is about average size for a goblin but he seems to know his
weapons. He looks at you and grins, showing off his skill with a blade.  He
asks you to look around and find that special item to reach out and touch
someone.   The collection of minotaur horns and wolfen teeth on his belt mark
him as a man with a complex.

long_desc: This wolfen shaman is busy making magical supplies.
description:
This tall wolfen shows his advanced age and his advanced skill.  He looks over
a spell book and mixes a potion that smells of death and pain.  He makes no
sign that he notices you but you get the distinct feeling he watches your
every movement.

long_desc: This goblin is busy tending the bar.
description:
This goblin knows his patrons and knows what to do.  You notice two sleek
crossbows on his hip and his eyes on you.  He pours a quick cup of cheap ale
and throws it to one of the brigands sitting at a table.  He doesn't look too
friendly.

long_desc: This pretty young goblin is busy serving drinks.
description:
This pretty young goblin caters to the upstanding goblin population of the
city.  She smiles and offers you a class of ale or wine.  She mentions that if
you are looking for something a bit stronger, try her brother's inn inside the
alley.  She giggles and bounces away.

long_desc: This young wolfen maid is making supplies.
description:
This young wolfen seems to have some skill with the clerical arts.  She is
busy making basic supplies such as food, water, and beneficial spells that are
a necessity whether you are venturing out in the ocean or deeper into the
untamed wilds.  She smiles at you and offers you a sample of healing balm.

long_desc: This wolfen healer is busy making medical supplies.
description:
This older wolfen woman is busy conjuring up several healing potions to sell
to the constnat stream of sailors and travellers.  She smiles at you and asks
what ails you?  She provides a small list of the supplies she sells.

long_desc: This pale gith is busy tending to the bar.
description:
This gith is blindingly pale and quite tall.  He gets along well enough with
the minotaur and wolfen customers and seems to speak their tongues perfectly.
He looks at you and speaks to you in the common speech, asking what your
pleasure is.

long_desc: This slaver sees you and tries to take you alive!
description:
This man makes his living waiting for some poor fool to venture beyond the eye
of the town militia.  He sees you and immediately lungs for you, trying to
knock you out before you can call for help.

long_desc: This slaver sees you and tries to take you alive!

long_desc: The ogre barbarian charges towards you in a fit of rage!
description:
The ogre barbarian is very big.  He has a bald head and has dark eyes.  He is
very dirty and has a foul stench about him.  He is fully suited in hide and
leather.  He stands at about 6 feet tall and looks to weigh around 300 pounds.

long_desc: The ogre warrior stands here ready for a fight.
description:
The ogre warrior is practically bald, and he doesn't look to have the best
hygiene either.  He is missing multiple teeth and his clothes are very worn
and dirty.  He is quite large and he looks very strong, fighting him may not
be a good idea.

long_desc: A rattle snake is coiled up here.
description: The rattle snake has very sharp fangs, and brown scales.

long_desc: A deadly spider hangs down from a tree here.
description: The spider is big and hairy.  Two tiny fangs protrude from its little head.

long_desc: This woman is working in the fields for quick gold.
description:
This woman is working hard to make as much as she can.  They seem to be paid
by how much silk and opium they can harvest in a day.  She pushes other
workers out of the way in order to get to the next ripe plant.

This man is pulling a large cart of goods.  He is making his way to one of the
great cities at each end of this road. He is among the many that make this
trip almost every month in order to sell their wares.

ensure that the constant source of items between Sahardin and the capitol is
never interrupted. Living out on the road for days on end, this guard looks
tired.

long_desc: This man is making his trip to the orc village to gather more slaves.
description:
This man is in desperate need of a shower, a shave, and a lesson in manners.
He spits as he walks and is constantly scouring the hillside for a runaway
slave. The heavy chains he carries must be how to can transport several
creatures that are each twice as big as he.

long_desc: A huge blue dragon roars as you enter and attacks!
description:
This mighty beast has arcs of lightning crackling up and down her huge body.
Your scent must of woken her up long before you reached this point, for she is
awake and ready to attack!

long_desc: A half-elf, dressed for travelling, walks down the road.
description:

looks up as you approach and stops, hoping you aren't going to be a threat.

circles about on the warm breeze, watching for a small creature to come out of

massive guy is lifting two or three crates of items at one time while the
human workers struggle to lift one on their own.

long_desc: This pixie is trying not to get trampled in the traffic.

dodge through the waves of people as they explore the bazaar. They seem to be
here on pleasure rather than business as you suspect a pixie would bring
someone larger to help them with their purchases.

long_desc: This guard patrols the city for suspicious characters.
description:
This guard seems a bit on edge. He is constantly looking and searching the
crowds as if any minute his death may come.  He stops a random  passerby and
begins to ask questions.  After a moment he lets them pass before scanning the
crowd for another victim.  He doesn't look like he has  been having a good
month.

long_desc: This guard is checking everyone leaving the gate.
description:
This guard is tired of their job, it is plain to see on their sunken face and
their melancholic look.  His job is to check every person and every wagon that
comes in or goes out of the city.  It is a thankless job and one that does not
afford much protection against a possible attack.

their melancholic look.  He is tired of patting down ogres and sailors all day

gives you a cursory pat down and places an odd band around your weapon, making
it impossible to quickly draw it.

long_desc: This heavily armored guard is not the local police.
description:
Adorned with a metal breastplate with a large Z marked on it, this guard
patrols the city for any signs of trouble.  It seems odd that a city would
require the presence of the military.  He doesn't seem to happy about his
assignment either.

long_desc: This person is mulling over a purchase.
description:
This customer is contemplating between two items. They seem deep in thought as
if this was a life and death decision.  They weight each item in their hands
like a scale before placing each one back on the shelf and admiring from afar.
They are so lost in their own world you imagine they get mugged constantly.

They are so lost in their own world you imagine they get mugged constantly.

if this was a life and death decision.  They weight each item in their hands
like a scale before placing each one back on the shelf and admiring from afar.
They are so lost in their own world you imagine they get mugged constantly.

This local man is shouting off color things to the people that walk by.
Slouched and unkempt, it is clear that this man couldn't make it as a dock
worker so he spends his time harassing or swindling the many foreign sailors
and merchants.

long_desc: Jao is busy trying to keep up with the drink orders.
description:
This is an attractive young lady.  Must be one of the reasons so many sailors
choose this particular establishment to waste their paychecks. She is busy
making drinks of all sorts as well as tapping kegs  and pouring wine.  She
smiles at you with a set of deep brown eyes and winks.

long_desc: This former sailor is tending to the bar.
description:
Cole is a big man, a bit past his prime years of working on a ship but still
in great shape.  He laughs with a huge bellow and is constantly keeping the
ale or special drinks flowing.  He seems to be quite happy with the song the
trio of musicians are playing.

long_desc: This scarred man practically ignores you.
description:
This man does not how to run a business.  His display items are in horrible
shapes, he is most enthralled with finding gold in his nose, and the smell of
smoke and some else is heavy in the room.  Perhaps no one taught him that a
store needs to have customers to be successful.

long_desc: This well-dressed guard is inspecting everyone.
description:
The Inspector is cloaked in fine imperial garb and is intent on finding
something.  Each wagon or person that passes his way he turns upside down
looking for anything.  He sighs each time a person goes by without being in
some sort of trouble.

long_desc: This bald man is trying to sell his wagon wheels.
description:
Oku is a big man, most blacksmiths are.  He is trying to sell a customer on
his new metal rimmed wheels that are less likely to break or snap on the road.
 The heavy price tag seems to be keeping the customers from jumping on the
chance but they do look very well made.

long_desc: This pixie alchemist is busy mixing items.
description:
Csanel is busy trying to mix two very extracts together to map out their
magical properties.  She is quiet and is staring intently at her work. The
only sign that she recognizes you are here is her shout to close the door.

long_desc: This cheerful elf with bright red hair is offering you a potion.
description:
Strawberry must have gotten her name from the long bright red curls that fall
to her shoulders.  She smiles sweetly and her musical voice is enough
enticement to try one of her potions or perfumes.

long_desc: This drow is careful making his potions.
description:
The poor drow seems quite over-worked. By no means a pretty one, he is
confined to the back to make the potions.  He is grumbling constantly and
spitting as well.  It seems on his to do list is another "love" potion.

long_desc: This large man is trying to make due in such shabby quarters.
description:
The man is trying to do a hundred things at once in a space that most pixies
would find tight.  The captain of the guard is studying different maps and
reports and is oblivious to your presence.  Is everyone is this town
overworked?

long_desc: This man is busy surfing through inventory reports.
description:
The Harbor Master has a thankless job.  So much comes in and out of Sahardin
and he has to make sure it is all legit. It's obvious some things are going to
get in and out that shouldn't.  Every time he finishes one report another five
seem to fall into his lap.

long_desc: This nervous man is pretending to do work.
description:
The Mayor is spooked. He keeps pretending to read some report or another
when they are upside down.  You know this isn't your homeland but you
are pretty sure people here don't read upside down. He tries to look busy
and ignore your existence.

long_desc: This massive ogre is busy cooking, if you could call it that.
description:
This ogre is about as big as other ogres, so he's huge!  He is taking a lot of
joy in spitting what appears to be an animal and roasting it over the fire.
The smell of strong ogre ale seems to rise off the creature. He sees you and
smiles a toothy, horrifying grin. He motions you to come over to the bar and
take a seat.

long_desc: This old man smiles at you and offers you a drink.
description:
This old man has owned this bar for years. It is named after him after all.
He is a kind old thing, and he doesn't seem to interested in your money.
It seems as the this part of town got rough so did business.  Out of kindness
you contemplate staying for a night or two.

long_desc: This beautiful woman is walking from table to table.
description:
This young woman is gorgeous.  She has deep blue eyes and long blonde hair.
She is wearing next to nothing and seems to be enjoying the entranced stare of
the patrons. Yet, you see a look of sadness in her face.  This is not how a
woman should have to make her way in life.

long_desc: This thin ghoul watches the door for the town watch.
description:
This ghoul is a good seven feet tall but as thin as a rail.  He smiles at you
as you take a look at the numerous illegal weapons that are sold here.
You find it odd that you haven't seen that many ghouls wandering such
a city as this.

long_desc: This short man is watching you very closely.
description:
This man is not in fact a human but a rather tall gnome.  He is  carefully
watching the door and you at the same time.  He keeps his finger on the
trigger of a small crossbow, neatly hidden under his cloak.

long_desc: This old sea dog is offering you free lessons in sailing.
description:
This old man must get a good deal of business. Located right next to the docks
many sailors must stop by to pick up spare supplies. He also panders to the
tourists of the area with sea-sickness pills and fishing lessons.

long_desc: This woman is trying to avoid the pinches and grabs of the drunk customers.
description:
This poor woman has it hard. Most of the people in here look like they would
slap their mother for a gold coin.  Numerous puddles of ale and blood dot the
floor.  She tries to keep up and still keep some semblance of dignity but her
clientele is not that forgiving.

long_desc: This large orc is keeping an eye on the door.
description:
This large orc bouncer is keeping things calm on the outside. He is careful
not to let anyone in that seems like they would cause a stir.  He nods to you
and motions you inside.  Maybe you should tip him?

long_desc: This large orc is keeping an eye on the girls.
description:
This large orc bouncer is keeping things calm on the inside. He watches to
make sure none of the patrons get any funny ideas. He doesn't seem to have a
sense of humor so you figure it would be best not to cause any trouble.

description:

with others of its kind, hoping predators mistake them for a larger fish.
It's worth a try, because they taste pretty good!

sucking in every smaller fish around, for at least a few feet.  Don't get too

description:
A dolphin jumps over your head playfully, then stops and looks back at you,
making a chattering noise.  It chases a few fish around for a couple of
minutes, then moves on.

long_desc: A gray dolphin leaps over you playfully!

long_desc: A huge mass of teeth hurls itself at you!
description:
The first sign that you are in trouble is the huge dorsal fin, suddenly
cutting its way through the water towards you.  The next sign is the huge
mouth with all the sharp teeth appearing quite close to your body!

long_desc: A huge black and white whale swims past you slowly.
description:
A large killer whale swims by you, giving you a closer look.  Not sure if you
are predator or prey, it circles you a few times, trying to make up its mind.

long_desc: A large lobster brandishes its claws towards you!
description:
This large lobster holds its claws before it, hoping to ward you away until it
can back into a safer location.

long_desc: A large lobster brandishes its claws towards you!

This large lobster holds its claws before it, hoping to ward you away until it
can back into a safer location.

long_desc: A long sleek shape glides from rock to rock.
description:
A large eel pokes its head out of a small cave, then swims out cautiously.
You shiver as you realize the thing is almost 6 feet long, and has a mouth
full of sharp teeth.  It eyes a few small fish as it swims about.

long_desc: A long sleek shape glides from rock to rock.

long_desc: This skinny long fish has a mouth full of sharp teeth
description:
A large barracuda comes closer to you, wondering if you are tasty or not.  It
flashes its mouth full of needle-pointed teeth at you as it swims by.

long_desc: This skinny long fish has a mouth full of sharp teeth
description:
A large barracuda comes closer to you, wondering if you are tasty or not.  It
flashes its mouth full of needle-pointed teeth at you as it swims by.

long_desc: A gigantic squid floats about, catching fish in its tentacles.
description:
This giant squid is a monster!  Stretching at least 30 feet long, its powerful
tentacles wrap themselves around large fish, and pull them close to the razor
sharp beak on its underside.  I wouldn't get too close if I were you!

long_desc: A ghostly sailor haunts the waters that claimed his soul.
description:
The victim of some nameless shipwreck, this poor ghost is doomed to wander the
cold sea until the end of time.  Some say it is the cause of all the storms
and wrecks that have happened since his death...

long_desc: A large frigate sails into view, flying a pirate flag!
description:
This large frigate moves quickly through the waves, despite its size.  A dark
and tattered pirate flag flaps in the breeze, and the leering calls and shouts
from above tell you that the rowdy sailors have caught sight of you.  Perhaps
you could BOARD this ship and see what it holds for you...

long_desc: A large slave galley rows its way through the waves.
description:
A huge slave galley rows its way through the waves.  You hear the sharp cries
of the slavers, yelling and whipping their cargo, trying to get them to row
faster so they can beat their shipping deadline.  Perhaps you could BOARD this
ship and see what it holds for you...

long_desc: A large, ghostly galleon appears in the mist and spray...
description:
Silent as a meditating monk, a large ghostlike galleon has appeared in the
water before you.  You hear nothing that would reveal the presence of any
crew.  The sails of the ship are tattered and torn, and you think you see
battle damage on the ship itself, but it keeps fading while you stare.
Perhaps you could BOARD this ship and see what it holds for you...

long_desc: A small skiff moves quickly through the seas.
description:
A rebel skiff comes shooting over the waves towards you.  The calls of the
rowers can be heard over the noise of the ocean.  Perhaps you could BOARD this
ship and see what it holds for you...

description:
This young lad is happily polishing the brass fittings of the large frigate.
He doesn't look too unhappy to be living a life of piracy on the seas.
Perhaps he figures that life could definitely be worse.

long_desc: This young elf scans the seas with her sharp eyesight, looking for loot!
description:
Standing high in the crows nest, this young elf stares out across the waves,
her golden hair blowing in the salty breeze.  Hoping to sight a fat
merchantman, she also makes sure the frigate doesn't come too close to any
Imperial warships.

long_desc: A rowdy pirate attends to the ship.
description:

his face as he goes about his regular chores on the ship.  The pirate life has
given him many adventures and even more gold coins.  It is definitely a
pirates life for him!

description:
Forgoing a normal life for a dangerous life at sea, this pirate has a grin on
her face as she goes about her regular chores on the ship.  The pirate life has
given her many adventures and even more gold coins.  It is definitely a
pirates life for her!

long_desc: The pirate captain walks the decks, ensuring everyone is doing their jobs.
description:
Ahh, a quite infamous man is Captain Kallisto.  Once the noble son of a family
of famous healers, he grew tired with the quiet life of spells and potions,
and ran away to find adventure.  After serving his time on many a sailing
vessel, he eventually gained control of his own ship, and has sailed the
realms thrice-over, searching for excitement.

long_desc: This old woman is drunkenly cooking a stew for the crew.
description:
Cackling to herself and sipping grog, this old woman is working on a great
smelling fish stew for the crew.  She moves about the galley, getting bits and
pieces of spices and tosses them into the pot.

long_desc: A miserable slave sits at his oar.
description:
Captured by the raiding slavers, this poor slave is doomed to row this boat
from shore to distant shore, until the raiders have a full load.  Then his
only hope is that someone not too cruel will buy him, and not work him into an
early grave.

description:

might take YOU as a slave.  Perhaps he just likes the idea of swinging his
whip at someone stronger than his cargo.

long_desc: The drum-beater scowls as you approach, trying to not lose his rhythm.
description:
This large slaver is trying to ignore you, for he knows if he loses the beat,
the boat will lose speed.  If that happens, he also knows he may very well
become one of the cargo, instead of the crew.

long_desc: This arrogant man struts about the ship, punishing those who don't obey.
description:
A strong warrior struts up and down his galley, beating slaves and guards
alike.  It seems one needs only to look at him to gain his evil favor.  He
eyes you up and down, and calculates how much gold he could get for such a
fine specimen.

long_desc: A moaning ghost of a pirate swoops towards you!
description:
The ghostly visage of a battle-scarred pirate swoops over the rotten decks
towards you, caught in a fight it can never leave.  You are just another
victim in a long line of victims...
