long_desc: The horrible visage of the ghostly captain shrieks as she approaches!
description:
Her ghostly head hanging by...well...nothing, Captain Helena shrieks a
horrible scream as she flies rapidly towards you!  Slain by Imperial sailors
in a sea battle long ago, she is cursed to continue to sail these waters by a
powerful shaman.  The terror of the seas when alive, she will continue to be
the terror of the seas for the rest of time.

long_desc: A rebel sailor moves about the skiff, keeping it sailing straight.
description:
Born for a life on the sea, this sailor cruises from continent to continent,
smuggling war-goods to the various rebel bases, keeping the fight alive.
Knowing his life is over if caught by an Imperial warship, he is a master at
keeping the skiff cruising at top speeds.

description:
This warrior is huge and covered in a series of bamboo and plate armor.
Judging by the double bladed halberd he carries you guess that he is the
legendary Lu Bu, the mercenary warlord.  In the pubs and ale houses of Bazabel
and Sahardin you have heard his name half whispered as a man that fights for
the sheer joy of combat and no other reason.  He watches you with a cold eye,
hoping you will become another memory on his blade.

long_desc: A small orange newt scampers along the rocks.
description:
You spy a bright orange newt quickly moving across the rocks, searching for
bugs or other things to eat.  It looks like a fire newt, but this one is too
young to have the ability to breathe fire.

description:
Sitting amongst a large cluster of orange eggs, the mother fire newt watches
you closely.  Her tongue flickers in and out, small flames rising from her
back as she prepares to protect her young.

long_desc: This scout keeps on eye out for rebel activity.
description:
This man has not bathed in weeks and has probably not slept indoors for just
as long. Hidden along the thick brush that covers the side of the road,  he
seems content on bringing down any rebels he encounters or perhaps warning
others of an impending attack.

long_desc: This poor miner is limping his way home.
description:
The man obviously had a poor day at some mine deeper within the mountains. His
face is covered in soot and his leg seems to have been bandaged rather badly
with a dirty shirt.

long_desc: This beautiful bird is watching for signs of a meal.
description:
The bird is magnificent. It's wingspan must be 3 feet and it's feathers are
each a subtle shade of brown and gray.  It soars effortlessly through the
breeze and keeps it eyes out for any snack it might get.

long_desc: This thin snake seems to have some pretty big fangs.
description:
The snake is thin like a rapier, it's head the only real point of girth on
the creature. It slides easily through the tough rocky dirt and blends in well
to boot. Judging by the fangs on the creature, you can tell that's where it
got it's name.

long_desc: This furry little rat scurries about.
description:
This musk rat is busy trying to find something to eat. It darts by only to
dart by again in some search for greater meaning. It seems to look behind over
bush for a snake and to the sky for a falcon or eagle. It must be nervous.

long_desc: This tall ghoul woman is guarding something.
description:
This woman is one of the few ghouls you've seen here. She is standing watch
over what appears to be a hidden door into the mountain. She does not look
like she will let you pass, nor does it seem like killing her would gain you
entrance into what ever she is guarding.

description:
This woman is doing her best to stay out of sight.  She watches the road for
signs of an imperial force marshaling. From the look of her clothes and the
small amount of bags she carries that she must be from a base or city not far
from here.

long_desc: A circling seagull rides the winds above you.
description:
A seagull circles above you, occasionally letting out a screeching cry.  Every
so often it dips closer to the ground to get a look at various objects that it
spies from above.

long_desc: A young elf travels the road, looking for adventure.
description:
A fairly young elf looks up at you.  She is carrying a small load, mostly
camping gear, but she is also armed with some light weapons.  She watches you
suspiciously.

long_desc: A well-equipped ghoul walks the road.
description:
A ghoul travels down the road.  He is well-armed, and his equipment looks like
it has seen heavy use.  He throws a glance your way, but doesn't seem too
concerned.

long_desc: A dirty human, probably a bandit, watches you closely.
description:
This dirty human watches you closely and you notice him eyeing your goods.
You get a bad feeling that he is trying to decide whether or not you are worth
robbing.

long_desc: A vulture swoops along here, looking for a dead meal.
description:
An ugly vulture swoops down low, taking a look at you.  Saddened by the fact
that you don't look quite dead yet, it takes back off and circles about the
sky.

long_desc: A young male nomad stares at you curiously.
description:
This young nomad must of wandered onto the road from the deserts down south.
He is dressed in tribal robes and carries a strange curved sword.  He watches
you with a curious look in his eye, not knowing it is rude to stare.

long_desc: A young man stands near a rack of strange boards.
description:
The surfer leans up against a wooden rack, which is full of long wooden
boards, shaped a little like boats.  "Hey, I got surfboards right here, if
you're interested.  Some killer waves out there on the break.  The trick is to
head out as far as you can without leaving the break, and then look for the
spots where you see the waves building.  Then just "SURF", and you'll be
riding em home in no time!  Just say 'sure, dude' and I can hook you up."

long_desc: A young sailor stands near a small boathouse.
description:
Looking up from his wood-carving, the sailor greets you.  "Aye matey, ye bee
looking for a way out into the mighty sea?  I gots here what ye need."

description:

bigger.  It wiggles its front legs at you, hoping to warn you away from

description:
Holy cow, this spider is really big!  It's body alone is nearly as big as
yours, and its long legs make it look even larger.  It has fangs about as long
as your hand...they look pretty scary!

long_desc: A large hairy spider jumps from the hole and attacks!
description:
A hug wolf spider, covered in brown bristles, has been tracking the vibrations
of your movement ever since you scaled the first tree.  It leaps at you,
hoping its poison will subdue you enough to provide it with a snack.

long_desc: A large black spider creeps towards you menacingly...
description:
This huge black widow towers above you when she stands up.  The blood red
hourglass on her underbelly would be a big warning to you, if you weren't
already aware of how dangerous this creature is.  Her tough, black carapace
looks like it can absorb quite a bit of damage.

long_desc: A spotted owl peers down at you from its perch.
description: A spotted owl looks at you disdainfully as if you were disturbing its peace.

long_desc: A spotted owl peers down at you from its perch.
description: A spotted owl looks at you disdainfully as if you were disturbing its peace.

long_desc: A young mage messenger tries to look important.
description:
This young lad wanders about the plaza trying to look as if he's on
official Srilaxa business.  He's most likely the son of a true sorcerer or
enchanter with little talent of his own.

long_desc: An animated fire poker is menacing any who approach it.
description: A fire poker?!  Who would animate this and why is it outside the stone walls?

long_desc: A squat wooden stool is floating around.
description:
It looks like an ordinary wooden stool except for the fact it's flying around
under its own power.  Someone must have animated this and forgotten about it.

long_desc: An iridescent lady bug moves along.
description:
The iridescent lady bug is moving along, sometimes flying and other times
crawling along.  She doesn't appear all that dangerous.

long_desc: A book of rudimentary spells is propelling itself along the ground.
description:
What's a spellbook doing wandering around?  Perhaps someone animated it as
a practical joke and forgot all about it.

long_desc: A stinky troll guard patrols the plaza.
description:
A troll guard doesn't seem too pleased to see you.  He sports two tusks that
he keeps nicely sharpened and he smells as if he has an aversion toward
bathing.

long_desc: A fierce troll guard is off duty.
description:
A troll guard doesn't seem too pleased to see you.  She sports two tusks that
she keeps nicely sharpened and she smells as if she has an aversion toward
bathing.

long_desc: A surly troll guard glares at everyone.
description:
The surly troll is a rather large specimen and he scowls as if he has a
terrible toothache.  Many scars cover his rough skin, signs he's been through
many a battle.

long_desc: A fierce troll guard is off duty.

long_desc: A cloth golem ambles about.
description:
This creature, made of burlap, is shaped like a man.  The mage who animated
this golem isn't very skilled for the golem has a misshapen face and limbs
that are uneven.  It doesn't seem very coordinated either.

long_desc: A bronze golem clangs as it moves about.
description:
This creature, made of bronze, is shaped like a man.  It was created as the
result of intricate rituals performed by a moderately skilled mage.  Its
creator didn't imbue it with much grace.  At least its limbed are evenly
matched.

long_desc: A diamond golem is here looking rather sharp.
description:
This creature, made of diamond, is shaped like a woman.  It's obviously the
creation of a master sorcerer for it moves with a fair amount of coordination
for a magical construct.  It has exceedingly sharp nails.

long_desc: A pixie golem maker is working with burlap.
description:
This young pixie hardly notices you for he's been put to work sorting piles of
burlap.  He has a slight build and his wings are constantly in motion.

long_desc: A brawny human mage is pounding on a sheet of bronze.
description:
This man has a physique closer to a blacksmith than one would expect to find
in a mage.  Perhaps the fashioning of metal golems involves a fair amount of
mundane smithing.

long_desc: A master golem maker scrutinizes her latest creation.
description:
The master golem maker is an elderly gnome who probably has been crafting
golems for several decades.  Her hands are covered with little scars, signs
she began as a novice golem maker and worked her way up to her current exalted
status.

long_desc: Zarabess is hawking her magical wares.
description:
Zarabess is a middle aged human dressed in a neat brown robe and comfortable
shoes.  Being a shopkeeper, she's on her feet a lot.

long_desc: Zusel is busy recharging a magical item.
description: Zusel is a middle aged human dressed in a dark, flame resistant robe.

long_desc: Zarppi is holding a light and appears to be singing to it.
description:
Zarppi is a ghoul of undetermined age dressed in a neat brown robe and
comfortable shoes.  It is singing to a light, is it enchanting it or is it
merely insane?

description: Someone has abandoned a new mob here

long_desc: A circling redtail hawk rides the winds and lets out a lonely screech.
description:
This hawk is quite beautiful, soaring amongst the hot winds that rise from the
dunes of the desert.  It looks for smaller game to feed itself, and ignores
you for now.

long_desc: A small lizard, covered in gray scales.
description:
A small, gray-scaled lizard sits in the warmth of the sun.  His eyes watch
your approach, but he doesn't move from his spot.

long_desc: A prickly tumbleweed blows right at you!
description:
This tumbleweed has made itself up out of some very sharp thorny plant.  The
wind launched it right off the dune, right into your face!

long_desc: A small jinn flits about, trying to get your attention.
description:
This little jinn flits about annoyingly, trying to get your attention to tell
you some tale tale or another.  Everyone knows these little genies are nothing
but trouble.

long_desc: A small scorpion scuttles along, his tail held high.
description:
This little scorpion is aware of you and has his tail held up high over his
body, ready to inject you with poison if you try to mess with it.  Perhaps you
should just leave it alone?

long_desc: You barely spot the sand-colored rattlesnake!
description:
Right before you step on it, the sand covered rattlesnake shakes its rattle at
you...a sign of danger!  You should slowly step away, and allow the snake time
to move on.

description:
The rags of the slave mark this skeleton as one who labored hard on the
pyramid.  Its reward for the grueling work was to be walled up inside his own

description:
With a low moan, the mummified priest shuffles along down the corridor.  It
never thought that it's time in the afterlife with his pharaoh would be spent
like this.

long_desc: This mummy's gold and gems jangle as it shuffles along.
description:
This mummy is decorated with a lot of jewelry, it must of been one of the
royal family.  A prince, from the looks of things.

long_desc: A richly dressed female mummy shuffles along.
description:
This mummy must be the queen.  Its easy to tell, with all the gold and gems
that hang from her body.

long_desc: The mighty mummy of the desert pharaoh stands before you!
description:
This huge mummy is dressed in golden armor, and bears a mighty flail at his
side.  As you enter, he stands from his throne to confront you!

long_desc: A mummy garbed as a servant shuffles along the corridor.

long_desc: An old hermit smiles up at you from under his hood.
description:
What appears to be a kindly old hermit smiles up at you from under his hood.
"Stay a while with me, you are safe from any danger here," he tells you,
motioning about his small homecave.

long_desc: A small bandit in a hooded robe watches you closely.
description:
This little bandit stands barely three feet tall, and is so covered by his
hooded robe, that you can't make out any of his features at all.  You think
you might be able to see the gleam of its eyes, but they move so quickly, its
hard to tell.

long_desc: The next thing you notice is the huge brass dragon glaring back at you.
description:
Enjoying the feel of the lightning bolts arcing across her scales, this large
brass dragon is gazing back at you with interest in her eyes.  "Why have you
come to seek me out adventurer?" she growls.  "I have nothing here for you."

cadets in the ways of war.  He shouts out criticisms and tactics to the cadets

simply age, he has been taken off active duty and assigned to instruct the
cadets in the ways of war.  He shouts out criticisms and tactics to the cadets
as they spar and gives a loud victory cheer when one cadet defeats another.

long_desc: This older Templar is making sure no one is slacking off.
description:
This older man has been a Templar for some years.  Either due to an injury or
simply age, he has been taken off active duty and assigned to instruct the
cadets in the ways of war. He patrols the grounds, making sure all the cadets
are doing what they should and that no one is slacking off.

long_desc: This large man is patrolling the private corridors.
description:
This powerfully built man is making his rounds around the private corridors of
the academy.  Numerous powerful artifacts and weapons are housed inside these
halls and his job is to make sure no one finds them.  He sees you and can
easily tell you are no cadet, he calls out the alarm and charges forward!

long_desc: This Templar is upset at his assignment and takes it out on you!
description:
This Templar is constantly mumbling and whining about his assignment. He could
care less about guarding a bunch of weapons and books, he wants to be where
the action is.  He sees you and decides that misery loves company.

long_desc: This Templar is bathed in energy and decides to share some with you.
description:
This Templar is one of the rare Spell-swords, a sect of the Templars dedicated
to the blending of magik and war.  He sees you and notices that you aren't
under escort and certainly not a Templar and decides to show you what mages
and steel can do.

long_desc: This Templar is bathed in energy and decides to share some with you.

long_desc: This huge Templar sees you and screams out a war-cry.
description:
This monstrous man looks to be one of the Templar commanders.  His armor bears
numerous marks of devotion and distinction as well as battle scars from a
hundred different blades.  He sees you and decides he might as well do things
himself.

long_desc: This Templar is charged with defending the Armory.
description:
This Templar has drawn the duty of guarding the door to the Armory.  He seems
almost frozen in his post until he sees you.  He looks over your shoulder for
any sign of an escort but judging by the blood on your armor and weapon, you
weren't invited here.  He screams out a war cry and charges.

long_desc: This Templar is charged with defending the Armory.

almost frozen in his post until he sees you.  He looks over your shoulder for
any sign of an escort but judging by the blood on your armor and weapon, you

long_desc: This Templar is soundly asleep.
description:
This Templar is charged with defending this secret passage.  Instead of
vigilantly watching the door, he is sleeping quite soundly.  He barely stirs
as you step close, despite his lethargy he looks quite large and extremely
powerful.  You wonder if you have a better shot lifting the key from his belt
or trying to take him on.

long_desc: This young cadet looks at you in horror.
description:
This young cadet thought it would be a lark to explore this hidden passageway
but seems you and recoils in horror.  He doesn't want to be punished for
breaking the rules so he decides it is best you don't ever tell somebody that
he was here.

long_desc: This man is cloaked in shadow and obviously neither a cadet nor Templar.
description:
This man is cloaked in shadow and slowly making his way through these tunnels.
Judging by his appearance you would say that he is from the far east and here
on the order of Emperor Zanzen.  He spots you and makes it clear his orders
are that none may know he was here.

long_desc: This older man is handing out rations and equipment.
description:
This man is in charge of the handing out the necessary equipment and rations
to the cadets.  The room is filled with practice weapons and uniforms as well
as some basic rations and water for the cadets. He is much older than any of
the other Templars you have seen and quite a bit heavier. His glory days must
have passed long ago.

long_desc: This older Templar is in charge of the academy.
description:
This Templar is the famed Captain Valhun.  His name is well known among the
ranks of the Alden army.  After a crushing injury during a war with the
Orcs of Glitter Cavern, he retired into this position.  Despite his injury, he
is still renowned as one of the best fighters that Alden can call upon.

long_desc: This large man wears the crest of the Alden Templars.
description:
This is the famous Evanael, one of the greatest human warriors to have lived.
Direct heir to the founder of the Alden Templars and a renowned  warrior
and Paladin.  His hair is cut short around the sides, the thinning strawberry
blonde tucked away under the war-helm he wears.  His armor is slightly dusty
from the road.  He travels everywhere in search of prospective Templars.

long_desc: A grinning imp flies about the room.
description:
The Minion of Paul stands ready to make sure any items stored here get saved
safely in the pit.

long_desc: A tall pale creature flashes a toothy grin in your direction.
description:
The Minion of Ashlyn stands ready to make sure any items stored here get saved
safely in the pit.

long_desc: A kind druid stands near the large tree.
description:
This ancient druid stands over the massive tree that protects all of the
Commune's reserves.  He is kind, an ancient being that is neither elf nor man,
a beautiful blend of a several races.  He bows to you and offers his respects.

long_desc: A featureless man in brown robes stands here.
description:
Here stands Argemis, trying to completely fill a large gold chest.. Instead
the chest only continues to grow deeper. He is doomed to remain here until he
can resist the call of the chest.  Argemis sees the chest as an extension of
himself, and continues to feel it with whatever material possessions are handy
to him in this area. Perhaps he wont notice if you borrow something...

long_desc: Croaker, a former medic and retired Captain stands here.
description:
This burly man of average looks waits patiently. His armor shows many battle
scars. The odd thing about him are the ink stains on his hands from his
recording the Black Company Annals.

long_desc: A walking healer is here
description: White robes surround this lovely vision of healing grace.

long_desc: One-Eye the impish healer hovers here on a bright pink mist.
description:
This small toad like man has huge bulging green eyes. His skin is nearly as
black as tar. His mouth is so wide it seems to stretch from ear to ear. His
teeth look like small little triangles which makes his smile remind one of a
baby alligator. His fingers, however, do not appear like a toad's at all. They
 are long, lanky, and quite adept at healing the unwilling souls that get
brought for him to aid.

long_desc: A beautiful woman hums softly to herself.
description:
Most of her long scarlet hair is hidden by a large white cowl.
A few strands fall in front of her shining green eyes. Her long slender
fingers are disproportionate to her petit frame and features. Light reflects
off of her thin and glossy red lips. Often times she fills the room with her
soft voice by humming.

long_desc: A huge Viking warrior hovers over you and grins.
description:
The massive Viking gazes down on you with his blue eyes. His bronze, tattooed
skin ripples with muscular tension.

long_desc: Kara, the Valkrye healer, tends to the wounded.

This proud wolfen warrior is honored to give their life to the service of
Tenhicoal. They walk with a heavy stride, their powerful shoulders and arms
carry the burden of service with a grim satisfaction.

within the palace, enjoying fine food and wine.  She smiles at you sweetly and
pops another small grape into her mouth.  It's good to be the King.

This fat rat looks both mean and well schooled in the art of surviving the
worst conditions.  It patrols vigilantly, looking for any scrap of food or
perhaps helping you eat that piece of bread you hidden in your bag.

description:
The wolfen has chosen to live in the sewers rather than face the harsh
penalties above.  They live off sewer rats and anything else they can.
Perhaps one day they will try and make it past the guard station and flee from
the city.

long_desc: This wolfen bartender smells as bas as his pub.
description:
This wolfen's fur is matted and stinks of dried ale and other worse things.
He spits into a glass and cleans it with a dirty rag.  He looks at you and
damn near barks for you to order something or go home.

long_desc: This sneaky goblin beckons you over.
description:
This little goblin watches you and invites you over.  He seems to be the one
running this little fight club and offers you a chance to prove yourself among
some of the greatest warriors in the world.  He tells you for the simple fee
of buying a key inside, you have a shot at greatness.

long_desc: This older goblin handles the bar.
description:
This older goblin seems to have seen many an adventurer.  He smiles at you and
tries to entice you to try his homebrew ale.  His body is thin and frail, he
is well into his elderly years yet his eyes sparkle with the gleam of
intelligence and wit.

long_desc: This young goblin brings beer and food to the tables.
description:
This goblin shares an uncanny resemblance to the goblin behind the bar. They
share the same faded blue eyes and thin build.  This young goblin must have
seen many adventurers with his father but judging by his limp, something
forced him to settle in to his job here.

long_desc: This young wolfen attends to the store.
description:
This wolfen has a pelt of pure white and bright emerald eyes.  He smiles at
you and you notice he is barely out of his pup years.  He must run the store
for his family, it is hard to imagine him running a store all on his own.

long_desc: This older wolfen works on making a new cloak.
description:
This old wolfen woman has been in this business for years and has seen many an
adventurer and many a wannabe hero.  She smiles at you while she fashions a
new travelling cloak.

long_desc: This sleek wolfen woman wears the mark a Blade-Master.
description:
This young wolfen woman must have proven her valor in some great manner to
achieve the rank of Blade-Master so early.  She taunts the other warriors,
pushing them harder and harder to achieve perfection.  She looks at you and
offers to help train you in the ways of the warrior.

long_desc: This thin wolfen wears the mark of the Shadow Stalker.
description:
This older wolfen is incredibly thin yet the sinew of his muscles proves he is
no mere fighter. He teaches the other wolfen assassins how to move silently
through the shadows and how to approach a victim.  He promises to teach you
how to strike a man dead before his body touches the floor.

long_desc: This wolfen is trying to convince you to buy a weapon.
description:
This wolfen has been around weapons his whole life and promises to tell you
exactly what weapon would be right for you.  His snout is covered in numerous
scars and left eye is dulled from some brutal attack.

long_desc: This wolfen is working the forge.
description:
This wolfen seems immune to the heat produced from the massive forge. He bangs
out a piece of metal which may become a shield, or a breastplate.  He  smiles
at you and goes back to his work.

long_desc: This pretty young priestess tends the store.
description:
This young priestess has drawn the responsibility of maintain the magical
supply depot of the city.  She offers to demonstrate a scroll or wand for you.
Her fur is a soft brown and appears to be well maintained.  She smiles and
waits for you to make a purchase.

long_desc: This mighty wolfen is a Spirit Speaker and Shaman.
description:
This jet black wolfen seems constantly in conversation with things you cannot
see.  His grey eyes are dulled and he seems to be in some sort of trance.  He
finally notices you and offers you a chance to learn the mysteries of the
past.

long_desc: This elderly wolfen is the high priest of the city.
description:
This elderly wolfen was once a deep black but is now a faded salt and pepper
color.  He looks out among the other priests and will occasionally interrupt
their conversation with his own point of view.  They seem to accept his word
as gospel.  He looks to you and offers you the chance to learn from his
wisdom.

long_desc: This wolfen wears the robes of the Ether Guard.
description:
The Ether Guard have long defended the city of Tenhicoal from the dark
magics and blind zealots of the world.  This wolfen radiates an aura of
power and understanding.  He offers to teach you if your soul is humble
and your mind sharp.

long_desc: This unofficial leader of the residents will send you on a quest.
description:
Chosen for her insight and her intellect, Nagi is the unofficial mayor of the
city.  She is also renowned for sending young wolfen on quests to give glory
to the city and to their clan.  She tells you to use the AQUEST command if you
would like one.

long_desc: This heavy set wolfen bellows and charges!
description:
This heavy wolfen is a combination of both fat and muscle.  His ruddy red
fur is heavily scarred.  He seems to have been beaten numerous times
and is a crowd favorite to lose.  He attacks with brute strength, hoping
to catch a lucky break.

long_desc: This pure white wolfen circles you and attacks!
description:
This beautiful wolfen woman moves with an easy grace, making wide circles
around you before she strikes.  She seems quite used to combat and judging by
the bodies that are still stinking inside this pit, she has won more than a
few fights in her time.

long_desc: This jet black wolfen seems to control the very shadows.
description:
This wolfen has won many a fight and for good reason, he seems to mend the
shadows and the spirits of the world to do his bidding.  His attacks are
brutal and his magiks are of the darkest kind.

long_desc: This scarred goblin appears from nowhere and buries a knife in your back!
description:
This goblin attacks with a very underhanded sensibility.  He dodges your
attacks like water and always manages to find your weakest spot.  His body is
scarred from years of fighting but it is obvious he has felled many a giant
with his blade.

long_desc: This gith has a long shock of white hair and throws an icicle at your heart!
description:
This gith is amazingly beautiful, lithe and long limbed.  She twists the world
around here, bringing the temperature down to an almost unbearable degree. She
wields numerous magics but it is obvious she prefers to freeze you to death.

long_desc: This small pixie has a look of utter madness on her face.
description:
This pixie is a mere blur as she flies across the room, throwing numerous
spells at you that wrack your very body with pain.  She cackles with a madness
that sends shivers down your spine.  You don't know if you can survive this.

long_desc: This massive wolfen is the color night, his claws are sharp too!
description:
The massive wolfen is clearly the largest one you have ever seen.  Despite his
massive frame, he moves with a great amount of speed. It is nearly impossible
to dodge his attacks and the sheer brutality of his fighting is horrifying.

long_desc: This lithe young man moves with a blinding speed.
description:
This human boy is not what you expect for your final fight.  He is thin,
smaller than the average human but the way he moves makes you think death
might be imminent.  You can barely trace his movements and with each strike he
lands, he seems to deliver a spell with it.  There is a reason he is
considered the champion.

long_desc: This mighty wolfen sits on a throne of gold and bone.
description:
This mighty wolfen is the color of a deep storm cloud grey, his eyes a burning
yellow and his teeth glisten.  He drinks heavily from a massive horn in his
hand, numerous chains and rings of nobility and divinity adorn his hands.  He
watches you with a haughty eye, waiting for you to bow and give his name
praise.

long_desc: What you thought was a vine at first is a long brown snake!
description:
Even worse than the vines is the realization that some of the vines are
snakes.  This particular one crawls under the thicket, looking for prey.

description:

work on visitors.

long_desc: A tiny mouse sniffs around the toadstools.
description:
A tiny mouse sniffs about the toadstools, looking for a treat.  Usually used
by the pixies as mounts, this particular mouse is currently on its own.

casting a spooky green light about the Circle.  Several pixies fly around
harassing it, but it seems to ignore them.

long_desc: Corinna sits in her hollow tree, mixing magical liquids together.
description:
Corinna looks a bit like a pixie, but is instead a Blue Fae, quite a
distinction as far as the pixies are concerned.  A bit larger than the normal
pixie, Nadine lets her dwell in the Circle, as long as she keeps making
magical potions for her use.

a boggart, a pixie "gone bad".  While most pixies are all about tricks and
pranks, this one may actually try to cause real harm.

long_desc: A pixie dances around, singing and laughing to herself.
description:
This small pixie is dancing about, singing a bright little tune to herself.
She notices you staring and gives a grin...you hope she hasn't cursed you
along with it!

outfit, he flashes you a quick grin, then disappears!  A second later, you
feel a tug on your ear, and a voice whispers, "Thanks for the gift!"

long_desc: A small firefly keeps the area well lit.
description:
This small firefly belongs to Flutterby. It floats around the toadstool
providing light for the room, which isn't a difficult task since the toadstool
is quite small.

A small house cat pads along the wall, its alert eyes watching you closely,
yet still somehow on the hunt for a little fuzzy snack.

long_desc: Hurrying through her chores, a young servant walks the halls.

long_desc: A wispy spirit floats in front of the large door, watching you closely.
description:
The spirit nods at you.  "You have reached the Tower of Manos.  The Master is
busy and has not requested your presence.  I advise you do not enter without
his permission, especially if you are under level 10."  The spirit looks at
the door, then back at you.  "However, if you do wish to enter, you need but
only salute, and I shall let you pass."

long_desc: A gigantic lizard takes a bite out of your leg!

Leaping out from under a huge plant, this giant lizard attempts to sink its

long_desc: This plant has a huge mouth that snaps at you!
description:
Moving its "head" about on a large green stalk, this thorny plant jets out a

description:
At first you think your eyes might be tricking you, but then you see it

long_desc: A tall, glowing being bows deeply before you, then stands straight.
description:
Before you stands a tall being, seemingly crafted from some type of light or
energy.  Two glowing spots float where its eyes would be, and they track your
movements closely.  The tall Lord moves about, straightening objects and
making sure that everything is where it's supposed to be.

long_desc: A tall glowing being digs through the mess in the chamber.
description:
Before you stands a tall being, seemingly crafted from some type of light or
energy.  Two glowing spots float where its eyes would be, and they track your
movements closely.  The Lord seems to be busy moving things about...and while
at first it appears to be cleaning things up, you soon realize that instead
the being is making more of a mess.

long_desc: A tall glowing being is busy making various objects appear from nowhere!
description:
Before you stands a tall being, seemingly crafted from some type of light or
energy.  Two glowing spots float where its eyes would be, and they track your
movements closely.  With a wave of its glowing arm, a small knickknack is
created!  The being smiles at its creation, then with a fling, the object
disappears, sent off somewhere in the Realm!

long_desc: A tall glowing being looks over at you, then turns back to smashing things up.
description:
Before you stands a tall being, seemingly crafted from some type of light or
energy.  Two glowing spots float where its eyes would be, and they track your
movements closely.  In between busting up the chamber around it, occasionally
this being grabs an object that seems to appear out of mid-air, then smashes
it to pieces.

short_desc: Manos, the Master of the Tower
long_desc: A skinny man with a large mustache looks up from the papers he was studying.
description:
After all the wonderful things you've seen in the Tower, you are surprised to
see that the Master himself is what appears to be an ordinary human man.
Dressed in a long red and black robe, the Master watches you with dark eyes
while playing with his mustache.  He seems to be considering your intentions.

long_desc: An elemental guard crafted from pure magic patrols the halls.
description:
A mighty looking creature made from a ball of pure magical energy walks a
steady patrol around the hallways.  So far it has ignored your presence, but
you are sure if you did something wrong, you would attract its attention.

and his body seems extended and odd.  He sees you and gives a slight
nod.  You are not sure what he is doing out and about but he doesn't
seem to be a threat either.

that her muscles are large and capable. She walks by, carrying a basket of

gather as little attention to herself as possible.

long_desc: This half-troll guard is wandering around the village.

The other citizens seem much more comfortable around him than any of the other
guards that are patrolling the area.  It is clear that he takes the safety and
the protection of the residents far more seriously than the Imperial soldiers
assigned here.

is forced to spend his time here in a city full of half breeds and monsters.

happening around him.  He just wants to go back home.

exceptionally strong half-troll to buy and then sell at Sahardin.  He eyes
children as well as adults for signs of a good sell. He even stops a child to
test their arm strength before frowning and sending them away.

covered in thick scars and despite his age he seems pretty spry. The slave
mark on his forehead has faded with age but apparently time made him useless
to whoever owned him before.

well worn boots,  she definitely doesn't stay still for too long.  She must be
trying to help some of the other half-trolls escape to a rebel city.

controlled village.  He casually walks up to the citizens and begins to talk,
and from a distance you can make out a few words. Most of them are not very
patriotic.

long_desc: A large full-blooded troll is making weapons.
description:
This troll is fashioning a spear out of a stalk of bamboo. He is whistling an
odd tune and his long grey fingers are skillfully brandishing a knife. He
looks up at you and bows.  He mumbles something about not being allowed to
sell any weapons made of metal.

keywords: Shal-on witch doctor old half troll woman
long_desc: This old half-troll woman is mixing herbs and potions.
description:
This old woman must be the witch doctor of the village. She is busy making
potions and odd small bags filled with herbs. She is covered in bright white
tattoos that stand in sharp contrast to her oil colored skin.  She nods at you
and continues to chant in trollese as she works.

long_desc: This large man is wearing imperial armor.
description:
This man is the official imperial outfitter of the village. All of his goods
are  licensed and legal in this village.  He seems to look at the half-trolls
with disgust that wander his shop and it is clear that only other imperials
make use of his store.

long_desc: This scrawny man is lazily tapping on the bar.
description:
This man is small and thin.  He is not a half-troll or even have any troll
blood in him.  It seems that the imperial office decided that he should run a
small pub here. Perhaps he did something wrong and that is his punishment.

long_desc: A large man is here, going over papers.
description:
The prefect of the village has the glorious job of making sure that the rebels
do not gain a foothold and that the slavers have a constant supply of
half-trolls to help out in Sahardin. He seems bored with his job and tired of
having to make his way through the filthy homes of the trolls to make sure the
census is accurate.

long_desc: This older half-troll looks at his people with sorrow.
description:
This half-troll has spent his life ruling over a conquered and exploited
people. The Imperial soldiers and slavers have taken the sons and daughters of
the village for years and the chieftain has been powerless to stop them. This
man only wants his people to flourish and be left alone.

long_desc: A small orange newt scampers along the rocks.
description:
You spy a bright orange newt quickly moving across the rocks, searching for
bugs or other things to eat.  It looks like a fire newt, but this one is too
young to have the ability to breathe fire.

look about the smithy.  From the looks of her, she knows how to use the
weapons she creates.

long_desc: A muscular drow hammers adamantium links together.
description:
Tasked with creating the special armor of the drow, the armorer does not even
pay any attention as you approach.  She must be mighty indeed, to be able to
hammer adamantium into the small links that make up the protective gear.

long_desc: This female wears the robes of House Karanthen.
description:
The matron mother of House Karanthen frowns as you intrude into her private
altar room.  Even though she heads the smallest house in Tyrybblyn, she is
still quite powerful.  Her hand reaches for the dagger at her side.

long_desc: This female wears the robes of House Ssin'urn.
description:
The matron mother of House Ssin'urn frowns as you intrude into her private
altar room.  Her hands drip with blood from the recent sacrifice.  She mutters
a curse as you approach.  Her hand reaches for the dagger at her side.

long_desc: This female wears the robes of House Belaern.
description:
The matron mother of House Belaern frowns as you intrude into her private
altar room.  She fingers the strange whip held at her side as you come closer.
 Her eyes narrow as she tries to decide whether or not to kill you for you
impertinence.

long_desc: This female wears the robes of House Z'Ress.
description:
This powerful looking female wears the elaborate robes of a City Ruler.  A
smile comes to her lips as you approach, but the look in her eye is of pure
evil.  An aura of danger surrounds this woman.

keywords: drow monk Sinzen Ral'thir figure dark
long_desc: This dark figure stops and quietly bows as you step closer.
description:
Normally wary of a drow in the first place, you cautiously observe the dark
figure.  Dressed in a simple robe, and carrying nothing but a waterskin, this
drow must be a monk, or mad to wander the realms unarmed.  You then spy the
diamond glisten on his left hand, and realize you stand in the presence of
Sinzen Ral'thir, master monk of the drow.

description:

pause.  A feeling of peace washes over you, and for just one small minute,
everything seems right in the world.

long_desc: A little blue bird chirps at you from the branches.

You hear a chirping up in the branches of a tree.  Looking up, you spy a small
bird, with brilliant blue feathers.  It hops about and watches you closely.

be careful not to get his large rack of antlers stuck in the lower branches of
the trees.  He watches you closely, ready to protect the herd if it comes to
that.

long_desc: A small red squirrel jumps away from you and scampers up a tree.
description:
The red blur you just saw stops for a moment, and you realize that it is a
small squirrel.  It runs up the side of a tree, and then stops to look back at
you and chatter noisily.

This enormous beast slowly raises her head, and gives what appears to be the
dragon version of a grin.  It would seem friendly, if it wasn't for the
sword-length teeth and fumes of vapour slowing emitting from her throat.

guard of Underhill.  His job is usually fairly simple, as there is not much

description:
Wearing large woolen mitts, this halfling woman pulls out freshly baked bread
and slides more trays of dough into the ovens behind her.  She notices you
enter the bakery and turns to take your order.

long_desc: A young female halfling stands at the bar, smiling.
description:
Clarissa has been the owner of the Golden Lily for some time now, and the
quality of her food and drink is renown throughout the realm.  She also knows
more songs than any other halfling around.

long_desc: An old halfling wipes a ceramic mug clean.
description:
Martin opened the Dancing Cow to serve the purposes of the halfling who wanted
to work hard at drinking the fine Underhill brew.  While songs and tales are
not unheard in the Cow, most times the occupants keep to themselves.

long_desc: The Mayor's receptionist sniffs the flowers on her desk.
description:
Gayle is the receptionist for the Mayor of Underhill.  Her job mostly consists
of sitting behind the desk and trying to remember the Mayors appointments, of
which there are few.  She plays with the flowers on her desk, awaiting the
time to leave the office and enjoy the rest of her day.

long_desc: An armored hobbit struts along the path, eyeing you closely.
description:
Larger than most hobbits, Garin was chosen to be the Shiriffs sergeant more
for his bulk and strength, and less for his brains, of which he has little.
He watches you closely, hoping for a chance to use his legal powers.

long_desc: The Mayor of Underhill parades about the town.
description:
Mayor Grimby walks along the path, his head held high, trying to look as
important as possible.  While theoretically in charge of the goings on of
Underhill, in reality, he is mainly a figurehead at parties and feasts.

long_desc: Shiriff Tomkins patrols his town, smiling at the locals.
description:
Shiriff Tomkins is known throughout the southern lands of the realms as a
mighty warrior and fair lawman.  He alone was responsible for keeping the
nomads of the desert from sacking Underhill in a large raid a few years ago.
He nods at you, memorizing your face as he walks along.

long_desc: A young male halfling cowers in his hobbit hole.
description:
"Are those bees still outside?" questions this young halfling.  "I haven't
been able to go into my garden in weeks without those things swarming all
around me and stinging me!"  He crouches down further behind his couch.

long_desc: A short fat halfling smiles at you and nods as you approach.
description:
At first this halfling looks as harmless as most of their folk appear.  As you
study him further however, you notice the battle worn weapons, the glint of
armor from under his clothing, and the steely look deep in his eyes.  A small
hollyleaf badge on his shoulder reminds you of the tavern tales you've heard
about Winton Hollythorn, the halfling warrior.

long_desc: Placeholder
description: Placeholder

long_desc: Taren Koth, the ghoul NightTracker, eyes you suspiciously...
description:
This huge figure before you is Taren Koth, the ghoul NightTracker.  Many
ghouls who tire of adventuring sometimes turn to the darker arts of death
magic and assassination.  The best are tracked down by Taren Koth and taken
under his wing and trained to be the stealthiest and deadliest hunters in the
Realm, but must always remains anonymous under their hoods.  Taren alone holds
the title of NightTracker, marking him as the personal hunter of Lord Drazuk.
If Taren Koth is on your trail, your days are numbered, for you have truly
angered the Gods!

been shaped by years of labor in the opium and silk fields. Her clothes are
light and her large brimmed hat keeps the sun from her face.

description:
This odd creature looks like a weasel mixed with a rat. It's fur is an ashen
gray and it's eyes a dulled red.  It scitters across the road, looking for
something small and tasty to eat and tries to avoid being seen by anything
else.

long_desc: This sneaky pixie is looking for interesting things.
description:
This small pixie is watching the roads intently for anything that might
be interesting to either the Imperial government or the rebels.  It doesn't
seem that they have any real affiliation other than that which provides
the most gold for their service.

long_desc: This beautiful pixie woman is watching your bags.
description:
This pixie woman is beautiful, almost awe-inspiring. Her wings are a gentle
gossamer accent to her soft brown eyes and flowing honey hair. Her body is
curved in almost haunting proportion and she bats her long eyelashes at you as
you notice her.  She smiles sweetly and tries to hide the fact that she is
watching your gold pouch.

long_desc: This half-orc is trying to remain hidden.
description:
This half-orc is staying hidden among the dense plantlife.  He is watching the
road for signs of imperial soldiers or anything else out of the ordinary. He
is quite large and it seems he is an odd choice for a scout.

long_desc: A strange light bobs about in the dark waters.
description:
A strange light approaches you in the water.  As it gets closer, you realize
that the light comes from a long appendage that hangs off of an ugly fish.  It
opens its mouth and the sharp teeth give you second thoughts about attacking
it.

long_desc: A large fish with a larger mouth attempts to swallow you whole!
description:
With a mouth as big as a full-grown minotaur, this giant grouper swims at you
quickly, sucking in water, algae and smaller fish in an attempt to swallow you
whole!
